https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yusu.body: KANO — Kano State Governor, Abba Kabir Yusuf, has urged Nigerians to be patient with President Bola Tinubu’s economic policies, saying the difficult decisions taken by the administration are aimed at rescuing the economy and stabilising its macroeconomic environment. The governor said the policies had helped stabilise the economy, expressing optimism that the benefits would eventually translate into improved living conditions for Nigerians. Yusuf, who was represented by Muhammad Yusuf Jamu, spoke on Wednesday at the inauguration of campaign coordinators for the presidential, governorship, senatorial, House of Representatives and State House of Assembly elections in Tarauni Local Government Area of Kano State. He said the President had taken difficult decisions to address the country’s economic challenges, adding that economic stability would create a conducive environment for businesses to thrive. “The President’s economic policies have helped rescue the country’s economy and stabilise the macroeconomy. With a stable economy, businesses can go to the markets and carry out their transactions. “We are now at a stage where the economy is growing, and the microeconomy will soon begin to flourish, so that Nigerians can also feel the benefits. “We are in a period where tough decisions have been taken to rescue the country. We urge Nigerians to be patient with the President and his government’s policies. At the end of the day, we will all celebrate,” he said. The governor also urged members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Kano to sustain efforts towards reconciliation and unity within the party ahead of the 2027 general elections. He called on party members to abide by established rules and work collectively towards the success of the APC. “I urge you to continue on this path of reconciliation and strictly adhere to the rules of the game. We have the best candidates to present to the people of Kano,” he said. He further urged party supporters to vote for the APC across all elective positions in the 2027 elections. “On election day, everyone should vote for the APC from top to bottom and from bottom to top,” he added. Also speaking, the APC candidate for Tarauni Federal Constituency, Hon. Nasir Bala Aminu Ja’oji, pledged to expand empowerment programmes and educational support for residents if elected in 2027. Ja’oji said education would remain his priority, alongside youth and women development, healthcare and economic empowerment. He disclosed that he had supported 2,500 beneficiaries across the 10 wards of Tarauni with N125 million in cash grants and distributed 100 motorcycles to constituents. He also said he had paid registration fees for students sitting the West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE), Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) and National Examinations Council (NECO) examinations, as well as provided financial assistance to hundreds of students in tertiary institutions. “If elected, I will redouble my efforts in all these areas. My first, second and third priorities will be education, while healthcare, empowerment and youth and women development will also receive attention,” he said. Similarly, the APC senatorial candidate for Kano Central, Senator Ibrahim Shekarau, urged members of the campaign council to intensify grassroots mobilisation and educate voters on how to identify the party on the ballot. He said voters needed to familiarise themselves with the party’s logo and symbol ahead of the elections. “We must educate voters that on election day, they will see the APC logo on the ballot paper, not the faces of President Bola Tinubu, Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf or other APC candidates. They must therefore be familiar with the party’s logo and symbol,” he said. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yusu.title_zh: 优素福敦促尼日利亚人对蒂努布的政策保持耐心
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yusu.body_zh:
卡诺——卡诺州州长阿巴·卡比尔·优素福敦促尼日利亚人对总统博拉·蒂努布的经济政策保持耐心，称政府作出的艰难决定旨在拯救经济、稳定宏观经济环境。州长表示，这些政策帮助稳定了经济，并乐观认为，其益处最终将改善尼日利亚人的生活条件。优素福由穆罕默德·优素福·贾穆代表，于周三在卡诺州塔拉乌尼地方政府辖区为总统、州长、参议员、众议员和州议会选举竞选协调员就职仪式上发言。他说，总统作出了艰难决定，以应对国家面临的经济挑战，并补充称，经济稳定将创造有利于企业发展的环境。

“总统的经济政策帮助拯救了国家经济，并稳定了宏观经济。经济稳定后，企业才能进入市场开展交易。

“我们现在已进入经济增长阶段，微观经济也将很快开始繁荣，让尼日利亚人同样感受到这些益处。

“我们正处在一个已经作出艰难决定、以拯救国家的时期。我们敦促尼日利亚人对总统及其政府的政策保持耐心。归根结底，我们都将共同庆祝胜利。”他说。

州长还敦促卡诺州全进步大会党（APC）的成员，在2027年大选前持续推动党内和解与团结。他呼吁党员遵守既定规则，共同努力推动APC取得成功。

“我敦促你们继续沿着和解的道路前进，严格遵守游戏规则。我们拥有最适合向卡诺州人民推出的候选人。”他说。

他还进一步敦促党的支持者在2027年选举中，在所有公职选举中投票给APC。

“选举日，每个人都应从上到下、从下到上把票投给APC。”他补充说。

APC塔拉乌尼联邦选区候选人、尊敬的纳西尔·巴拉·阿米努·贾奥吉也表示，如果他在2027年当选，将扩大赋权计划和面向居民的教育支持。贾奥吉表示，教育仍将是他的优先事项，同时关注青年和妇女发展、医疗保健以及经济赋权。他透露，自己曾向塔拉乌尼辖区10个选区的2,500名受益人提供总额1.25亿奈拉现金补助，并向选民分发了100辆摩托车。他还说，他已为参加西非高级中学证书考试（WASSCE）、联合招生与入学委员会（JAMB）及国家考试委员会（NECO）考试的学生缴纳报名费，并为数百名高等教育机构的学生提供经济援助。

“如果当选，我将在所有这些领域加倍努力。我的第一、第二和第三优先事项都是教育，同时也会关注医疗保健、赋权以及青年和妇女发展。”他说。

同样，卡诺中选区APC参议员候选人易卜拉欣·谢卡拉乌敦促竞选委员会成员加强基层动员，并教育选民如何在选票上识别该党。他说，选民需要在选举前熟悉该党的标志和标识。

“我们必须告诉选民，选举日他们将在选票上看到APC的标志，而不是总统博拉·蒂努布、州长阿巴·卡比尔·优素福或其他APC候选人的照片。因此，他们必须熟悉本党的标志和标识。”他说。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Democratic control of the U.S. Congress could make it harder for South Korea to acquire nuclear-powered submarines and limit President Donald Trump's ability to reach a deal with North Korea, even as he may seek another summit with leader Kim Jong-un, according to experts Wednesday. The assessments came after the Democratic Party scored a landslide victory in Tuesday's midterm elections, with the party poised to take control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, dealing a major political blow to Trump. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said Democrats could be more reluctant than Republicans to support South Korea's efforts to acquire nuclear-powered submarines because of concerns about the spread of nuclear technology. "Democrats may hold on to non-proliferation norms more strongly than Republicans, which may create obstacles to Lee's path to acquire nuclear powered subs," Yeo said, referring to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung. Patrick Cronin, chair for Asia-Pacific security at the Hudson Institute, also warned that the submarine plans could face delays or opposition in Congress. "Ambitious commitments, such as cooperation on nuclear-powered submarines, could face delays or obstruction, even as longstanding bipartisan support for core alliance commitments, including extended deterrence, remains comparatively resilient," Cronin said. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, shared a similar view. "Unclear to what extent, if at all, Democrats will be supportive of Trump promises of nuclear-powered subs and enrichment-reprocessing rights for Korea. NPT concerns still weigh heavily," Rapson said, referring to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty. The election results could also affect South Korea's push to regain wartime operational control (OPCON) of its troops from the United States. Yeo said Congress was already reluctant to set a fixed date for the OPCON transfer and that Democratic control could lead to further resistance to Seoul's proposed 2030-or-earlier timeline. "Trump and Hegseth seem to be more open to OPCON transfer by 2030 than other U.S. policymakers, but a Democrat-controlled Congress may raise more questions and resist this move," he said, referring to U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Rapson said it remained unclear where Democrats stood on an early OPCON transfer. On other bilateral issues, Yeo said the Republican election losses could affect expectations about how quickly Seoul moves ahead with its planned $200 billion investment in the U.S., part of a bilateral trade deal signed last year. Rapson said trade and investment agreements reached under pressure from Trump's tariffs could get a second look under Democratic lawmakers. "What that might look like exactly is to be determined." On North Korea, Cronin said Trump could become more eager to pursue a major foreign policy achievement following the Republican losses, but stressed that the new political climate will impose constraints on his ability to reach a deal, such as offering sanctions relief to North Korea. Trump, according to Rapson, could seek renewed talks with North Korea to strengthen his political legacy, but questioned whether Pyongyang would see much benefit in negotiating with a politically-weakened president. "Congress will certainly preclude any efforts by Trump to cut a deal waiving sanctions against the North a la the recent Russia deal," Rapson said. He also said North Korea might see greater advantages in dealing with Trump under the latest circumstances. "For North Korean leaders, the prospect of dealing with a weakened American president may be moderately more enticing than it seemed before the midterms. The question will be whether Pyongyang views it as a unique window of opportunity or as unnecessary to its current strategic needs,' Snyder said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 专家：民主党可能使韩国核潜艇计划及特朗普与金正恩峰会变得更加复杂
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据专家周三表示，民主党掌控美国国会，可能使韩国更难获得核动力潜艇，也会限制唐纳德·特朗普总统与朝鲜达成协议的能力，尽管他可能寻求再次与领导人金正恩举行峰会。上述评估是在民主党于周二中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后作出的。该党有望掌控众议院和参议院，对特朗普造成重大政治打击。布鲁金斯研究所高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，出于对核技术扩散的担忧，民主党可能比共和党更不愿支持韩国获取核动力潜艇。约说：“与共和党相比，民主党可能更加坚定地维护不扩散规范，这可能给李总统获取核动力潜艇之路设置障碍。”他指的是韩国总统李在明。哈德逊研究所亚太安全项目主席帕特里克·克罗宁也警告说，潜艇计划可能遭遇国会延期或反对。克罗宁说：“雄心勃勃的承诺，例如合作建造核动力潜艇，可能面临延期或阻碍，尽管两党对核心联盟承诺的长期支持——包括延伸威慑——相对仍具有韧性。”曾任美国驻韩国大使的罗伯特·拉普森持类似看法。拉普森说：“民主党人在多大程度上会支持特朗普关于向韩国提供核动力潜艇以及核浓缩与后处理权利的承诺，目前尚不清楚。若有支持，程度也未明。NPT方面的担忧仍然产生很大影响。”他指的是《不扩散核武器条约》。选举结果还可能影响韩国从美国收回对其军队的战时作战指挥权（OPCON）的努力。约说，国会本就不愿为移交OPCON设定固定日期，而民主党掌控国会可能导致其进一步反对首尔提出的2030年或更早移交时间表。他说：“特朗普和赫格塞思似乎比其他美国决策者更愿意在2030年前移交OPCON，但由民主党掌控的国会可能提出更多问题，并抵制这一举措。”他指的是美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞思。拉普森说，民主党对提前移交OPCON持何立场仍不清楚。在其他双边问题上，约表示，共和党在选举中失利可能影响外界对韩国多快落实其拟议中的对美2000亿美元投资的预期，这属于去年签署的双边贸易协议的一部分。拉普森说，在特朗普关税压力下达成的贸易和投资协议，可能由民主党议员重新审视。他说：“最终会具体呈现什么样，仍有待确定。”在朝鲜问题上，克罗宁说，共和党败选后，特朗普可能更加急切地寻求取得重大外交政策成就，但强调新的政治环境将限制他达成协议的能力，例如向朝鲜提供制裁解除。拉普森说，特朗普可能寻求重启与朝鲜的谈判，以强化自己的政治遗产，但他质疑平壤是否会认为与一位政治上被削弱的总统谈判有多大好处。拉普森说：“国会肯定会阻止特朗普仿效近期对俄罗斯协议、就放弃对朝鲜制裁达成任何交易。”他还说，在当前最新情况下，朝鲜可能认为与特朗普打交道更具优势。Snyder说：“对朝鲜领导人来说，与一位被削弱的美国总统打交道的吸引力，可能比中期选举前看起来适度提高。关键在于，平壤会把这视为一个独特的机会窗口，还是认为这对满足其当前战略需求并无必要。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Federal Government has disbursed ₦372.62 billion in student loans and provided free technical and vocational training to more than 156,000 beneficiaries under President Bola Tinubu’s education reforms, according to the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council. The council said the reforms had expanded access to education, improved teachers’ welfare and strengthened academic stability in tertiary institutions. In a press statement issued on Wednesday and signed by Dele Alake, spokesperson for the APC Presidential Campaign Council, the council cited the 2026 report of the Nigerian Education Sector Renewal Initiative (NESRI) of the Federal Ministry of Education. According to the report, the reforms span basic, secondary, technical and tertiary education, with interventions targeting six priority areas: technical and vocational education, science and medical sciences, out-of-school children, girl-child education, digitalisation and education quality assurance. The council said the Federal Government allocated ₦3.52 trillion to education in the 2026 budget and secured $552 million for the HOPE-EDU programme, which targets 29 million children, more than 500,000 teachers and 65,000 public schools. It added that the Better Education Service Delivery for All (BESDA) programme had returned more than one million out-of-school children to learning, trained 1,400 Tsangaya teachers and established 200 bilingual centres across 17 northern states. The Adolescent Girls Initiative for Learning and Empowerment (AGILE), it said, had reached 7.19 million girls, with 3.7 million enrolled in secondary schools. More than 10,000 schools had also benefited from improved facilities. The council said the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) had processed 1,659,853 student loan applications and disbursed ₦372.62 billion to beneficiaries across 319 tertiary institutions. The disbursement comprises ₦192.89 billion for tuition and ₦179.73 billion for students’ upkeep allowances. Under the Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) programme, the government reportedly received more than 2.8 million applications, with 156,446 verified trainees benefiting from free training, monthly stipends and start-up support. The statement said more than ₦65.7 billion had been disbursed to trainees, while ₦30.2 billion had gone to training centres. It added that 38 technical colleges had been rehabilitated, while free technical education covered tuition, boarding, textbooks and uniforms. The council said the government had introduced a revised national curriculum, reintroducing Nigerian History and strengthening Civic and Heritage Studies. It also said the National Learning Assessment had been restored to monitor pupils’ performance and identify learning gaps. Under the EduRevamp initiative, 53,553 teachers had registered, while 51,794 had joined the first cohort of the Accelerated Teacher Professionalisation Pathway, a six-month programme offering professional qualifications, certification and licensing. The programme, backed by ₦2 billion, targets 250,000 teachers by 2027. The council further claimed that the Tinubu administration had resolved the longstanding dispute between the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) and implemented an agreement providing a 40 per cent increase in academic staff remuneration and improved welfare benefits. It said the Tertiary Institutions Staff Support Fund had disbursed ₦28 billion to 15,000 workers across 153 public institutions, offering eligible staff loans of up to ₦10 million for housing, healthcare, transportation and education. According to the statement, the Federal Government is investing ₦110 billion to rehabilitate 18 federal medical schools across the six geopolitical zones. Nursing enrolment reportedly increased from 81,480 in 2023 to 114,300 in 2025. The government has also approved 20 STEM-focused tertiary institutions and plans to rehabilitate 12 engineering and technology faculties. On research and innovation, the council said the government had provided ₦365 million annually for the National Laureate Prize. It added that the Student Venture Capital Grant had disbursed more than ₦2.5 billion to 45 student entrepreneurs, with each beneficiary eligible for up to ₦50 million in equity-free funding. Entrepreneurship certification is ongoing in 14 federal universities, while the Diaspora BRIDGE initiative has registered 1,141 Nigerian experts abroad and reached 16,675 students across 107 tertiary institutions. The Minister of Education, Tunji Alausa, said the success of the reforms would be measured by their impact on students, teachers and institutions rather than the amount of money allocated or the number of programmes introduced. “Our measure of success is not merely the amount of money allocated to education or the number of programmes introduced. It is the difference these interventions make in the lives of our children, students, teachers and institutions,” Mr Alausa was quoted as saying
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 蒂努布推进教育改革：联邦政府发放3726.2亿奈拉学生贷款，培训156446名职业技术与教育培训受益者
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 据全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会称，联邦政府已在博拉·蒂努布总统的教育改革下发放了₦372.62 billion学生贷款，并为超过156,000名受益人提供免费的技术与职业培训。该委员会表示，这些改革扩大了教育机会，改善了教师福利，并加强了高等教育机构的学术稳定。委员会于星期三发布新闻声明，由APC总统竞选委员会发言人Dele Alake签署，引用了联邦教育部下属尼日利亚教育部门更新倡议（NESRI）的2026年报告。报告称，改革覆盖基础教育、中等教育、技术教育和高等教育，针对六个重点领域采取干预措施：技术与职业教育、科学与医学科学、失学儿童、女童教育、数字化以及教育质量保障。委员会表示，联邦政府在2026年预算中拨款₦3.52 trillion用于教育，并为HOPE-EDU计划争取到$552 million。该计划面向29 million名儿童、超过500,000名教师和65,000所公立学校。委员会补充说，面向所有人的更好教育服务交付计划（BESDA）已使超过1 million名失学儿童重返学习课堂，培训了1,400名Tsangaya教师，并在北部17个州设立了200个双语中心。青春期女孩学习与赋权倡议（AGILE）已惠及7.19 million名女孩，其中3.7 million名已升入中等学校。另有超过10,000所学校受益于设施改善。委员会表示，尼日利亚教育贷款基金（NELFUND）已处理1,659,853份学生贷款申请，并向319所高等教育机构的受益人发放了₦372.62 billion。拨款包括₦192.89 billion学费和₦179.73 billion学生生活津贴。在技术与职业教育和培训（TVET）计划下，政府据报收到超过2.8 million份申请，156,446名经核实受训者获得免费培训、每月津贴和创业支持。声明称，已向受训者发放超过₦65.7 billion，同时向培训中心拨付₦30.2 billion。委员会补充说，38所技术学院已完成修缮，免费技术教育涵盖学费、住宿、教科书和制服。委员会表示，政府已推出修订后的国家课程，恢复尼日利亚历史课程，并加强公民与文化遗产研究。政府还恢复了国家学习评估，用于监测学生表现并查明学习差距。在EduRevamp倡议下，已有53,553名教师报名，其中51,794名加入加速教师专业化路径首批学员。该项目为期六个月，提供职业资格、认证和执照，政府提供₦2 billion支持，计划到2027年惠及250,000名教师。委员会进一步声称，蒂努布政府解决了大学学术职工联合会（ASUU）之间的长期争议，并落实了一项协议，将学术人员薪酬提高40%，同时改善福利待遇。委员会表示，高等教育机构职工支持基金已向153所公共机构的15,000名工作人员发放₦28 billion，并向符合条件的职工提供最高₦10 million的贷款，用于住房、医疗、交通和教育。据声明，联邦政府正投入₦110 billion，翻修遍布六个政治区的18所联邦医学院。护理专业入学人数据报从2023年的81,480人增加到2025年的114,300人。政府还批准了20所以STEM为重点的高等教育机构，并计划翻修12个工程与技术学院。在研究与创新方面，委员会表示，政府每年为全国桂冠奖提供₦365 million。学生创业资本补助已向45名学生创业者发放超过₦2.5 billion，每名受益人最多可获得₦50 million的无股权资金。14所联邦大学正在开展创业认证，海外人才BRIDGE倡议则登记了1,141名海外尼日利亚专家，并覆盖107所高等教育机构的16,675名学生。教育部长Tunji Alausa表示，改革成效应以其对学生、教师和机构的影响来衡量，而不是看拨款金额或推出计划的数量。Alausa先生被引述说：“衡量成功的标准，不只是拨给教育的资金数额或推出的计划数量。这些干预措施对我们儿童、学生、教师和机构的生活带来了怎样的改变，才是我们的成功标准。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: The presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Alhaji Atiku Abubakar, has promised to restore fuel subsidy, reopen the nation’s borders for legitimate business and end insecurity if elected president. Atiku made the pledge while addressing a mammoth crowd of party supporters that gathered at Ilorin Road, venue of the ADC presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto. He said Nigerians have never had it so bad, stressing that the APC-led government has destroyed the country with anti-people policies. The former Vice President said he meant every word of his promises, urging the people to come out en masse to vote for the ADC and protect their votes on election day. He described Sokoto as significant in Nigeria’s politics because of its strategic position as the seat of the Caliphate, not only in Nigeria but in West Africa as a whole. Atiku said if it had been left to the ruling party, the rally would not have held, as everything was done to stop the flag-off, but for the resilience of party members in Sokoto. On his part, the vice presidential candidate, Rt. Hon. Rotimi Amaechi, said the government of President Bola Tinubu has impoverished the country. Amaechi said corruption under the present government is second to none, alleging that the government borrows money and at the same time loots it. In his remarks, the National Chairman of the party, Senator David Mark, urged the people of Sokoto to vote for the ADC from top to bottom. Mark said the combination of Atiku and Amaechi will solve Nigeria’s problems. Also speaking, the leader of the party in the state, Senator Aminu Waziri Tambuwal, took a swipe at the ruling party in the state for denying them venue and hotel accommodation. Tambuwal said the APC-led government in the state did everything to frustrate the rally, but for the resilience of party members, imploring the people of Sokoto, as enlightened people and home of scholarship, to vote out Governor Ahmed Aliyu for what he described as crude methods of politics. The journey of seven kilometres from the airport to the venue of the rally took Atiku and his entourage three hours because of the mammoth crowd that lined the route. https://www.myjoyonline.com/secret-polic.summary: Hungary has opened communist-era secret police files to the public, in a controversial move the government says will help Hungarian society heal itself from the traumas of 45 years of communist rule. But many names were blacked out, and many files withheld by the post-communist secret services for their own use. Over the past 36 years, there were frequent leaks of data from the files, as successive governments tried to damage their opponents.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/secret-polic.summary_zh: 匈牙利已向公众开放共产主义时期的秘密警察档案。政府称，此举有争议，但将帮助匈牙利社会摆脱45年共产主义统治留下的创伤，实现自我疗愈。然而，许多姓名被涂黑，许多档案则被后共产主义时期的秘密机构扣留，供其自行使用。过去36年里，这些档案的数据频繁泄露，历届政府试图借此损害政治对手。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/secret-polic.body: Hungary has opened communist-era secret police files to the public, in a controversial move the government says will help Hungarian society heal itself from the traumas of 45 years of communist rule. Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and that the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish to family members. The date of the opening is symbolic - on 4 November 1956 Soviet tanks rolled through Budapest and other cities, to crush Hungary's short-lived revolution. "I ask everyone to treat this long overdue publication of documents with dignity and humanity," Prime Minister Péter Magyar told reporters at the state archives in Budapest. "Many families will now face difficult information, often related to a deceased relative," he added. "It is impossible to process a trauma without discussion and asking questions." Magyar defended the move, which was a central promise of his election campaign ahead of his landslide victory in April elections, as the fulfilment of a promise made by those who toppled the Communist party in 1989 in Hungary. In the ensuing decades, conservative, Socialist-Liberal, and Fidesz-led governments have all contemplated, but ultimately refused to open the files. Since 1998, it has been possible to apply for your own file, and for historians to research those of others. But many names were blacked out, and many files withheld by the post-communist secret services for their own use. Over the past 36 years, there were frequent leaks of data from the files, as successive governments tried to damage their opponents. Many files were also shredded, as the Communist party lost its grip in 1988-89. From Wednesday, the names and personal data of around 60,000 people recruited by the communist-era secret services have become available on the nyitottaktak.hu website. A typical entry records the real name of the informer, their codename, date of birth, address and mother's name, their motive for recruitment - whether voluntary or because they were blackmailed or coerced - and the name of their handling officer. Another batch of files, known as the "B-dossiers" are currently being digitalised, and will be made available on 25 February. These will offer much more detail about the recruitment process, and the high or low value of the information they provided. Critics of the opening of the files emphasise this point - that people will be too quick to judge those they find in the files, and unwilling to understand the nuances. Around 150-160,000 people are estimated to have been recruited as informers between December 1944 and February 1990 in Hungary. Many were blackmailed, with threats including loss of work or study opportunities, loss of access to medicines, or the leaking of information about their sex lives or addictions. Such intimate details will be carefully edited out of the current disclosures too. Krisztian Ungváry, a historian who has long campaigned for full public access to the files, says access to information on what is recorded by the state against the citizen is a citizens' right, and should not depend on the whims of those in power. "In the overwhelming majority of surviving agent reports, it isn't even possible to identify the agent, let alone their motives," counters an opponent of today's move, Zsuzsanna Borvendég, a historian and MEP of the far-right Our Homeland party. Publishing the names of informers without fully explaining the circumstances of their recruitment and their activities risks misleading the public, she told Hungarian media
https://www.myjoyonline.com/secret-polic.title_zh: 共产主义政权垮台37年后，匈牙利秘密警察档案解密
https://www.myjoyonline.com/secret-polic.body_zh: 匈牙利向公众开放了共产主义时期的秘密警察档案。、政府称，此举有争议，但将帮助匈牙利社会走出45年共产党统治留下的创伤。批评者说，此举为时已晚，档案本身并不完整，而且可能加剧社会分裂，给相关家庭成员造成不必要的痛苦。开放日期具有象征意义——1956年11月4日，苏联坦克驶入布达佩斯及其他城市，镇压了匈牙利短暂存在的革命。总理彼得·马扎尔在布达佩斯国家档案馆对记者说：“我呼吁everyone以尊严和人情味看待这次姗姗来迟的文件公开。。”“许多家庭现在将面对令人痛苦的信息，这些信息往往与已故亲属有关。”他补充道：“不进行讨论、不提出问题，就不可能消化创伤。”马扎尔为这一举措辩护称，这是履行承诺，即兑现那些在1989年推翻匈牙利共产党的人所作出的承诺；这一举措也是他4月选举竞选活动中的核心承诺，并最终在选举中以压倒性优势获胜。此后数十年间，保守党、社会民主党—自由党以及青民盟领导的政府都曾考虑开放这些档案，但最终都予以拒绝。自1998年起，个人可以申请查阅自己的档案，史学家也可以研究他人的档案。然而，许多姓名被涂黑，许多档案则被后共产主义时期的秘密机构扣留，供其自行使用。过去36年里，随着历届政府试图打击政敌，档案数据频繁泄露。1988年至1989年共产党失去控制期间，许多档案也被粉碎。自周三起，约6万名曾被共产主义时期秘密机构招募人员的姓名和个人资料，已可在nyitottaktak.hu网站上查询。典型的一则记录载有告密者的真实姓名、化名、出生日期、住址和母亲姓名，其受招募的动机——是自愿加入，还是受到勒索或胁迫——以及负责联络他们的特工人员姓名。另一批被称为“B-dossiers”的档案目前正在数字化，将于2月25日公开。这些档案将提供关于招募过程及其所提供情报价值高低的更多细节。批评开放档案的人士强调指出，人们会过快地评判在档案中发现的人，却不愿了解其中的细微差别。据估计，1944年12月至1990年2月期间，匈牙利约有15万至16万人被招募为告密者。许多人受到威胁，包括失去工作或学习机会、无法获得药品，或其性行为及成瘾情况的信息遭到泄露。如今公开的资料也会谨慎地删去此类私密细节。长期争取全面公开档案访问权的史学家克里什蒂安· ungváry表示，查阅国家针对公民所记录的信息是公民权利，不应取决于当权者的意愿。极右翼“祖国党”史学家兼欧洲议会议员Zsuzsanna Borvendég反驳今天此举的反对者说：“在绝大多数留存下来的特工报告中，甚至根本无法辨认特工，更不用说其动机。”她告诉匈牙利媒体，在未充分说明告密者受招募及开展活动的情况时公开其姓名，可能误导公众

Unlock these with Subscription India has secured preliminary investment commitments worth $400 billion across the renewable energy sector, including green hydrogen, energy storage and transmission, among others, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi said on Wednesday. Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo, Mr. Joshi said the commitments were made during a CEO roundtable involving global investors and fund managers. “The fund managers have taken all the details and have given a commitment of $400 billion,” he said, adding that the figures were preliminary and the final details were being worked out. The minister said overseas investors had expressed confidence in India’s investment climate. “I also met the Canadian Investment Fund – they are one of the biggest funds. They also said this (India) was the safest place for investment,” he said. Separately, the government will consult industry stakeholders over the next 10-15 days before deciding whether to extend the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) framework, Mr. Joshi said. The framework, which mandates the use of domestically approved solar module manufacturers for specified projects, was last extended in July until December 31 for solar PV cells. He said India’s solar cell manufacturing capacity currently stood at 41 GW, while manufacturers had committed to adding another 70 GW by the end of the year. Acknowledging divergent views within the industry on extending the ALMM framework, he said the government would hear both sides before taking a decision. “Some people want it to be extended, some people do not want it. We will listen to them, talk to both and we are not in a hurry to take a decision on that, [and] in another 10-15 days we will discuss with both the stakeholder associations,” he said. 印度联邦新能源和可再生能源部长普拉哈德·乔希周三表示，印度已获得整个可再生能源领域价值4000亿美元的初步投资承诺，涵盖绿色氢能、储能、输电等领域。

乔希先生在 Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 期间对记者表示，这些投资承诺是在一次有全球投资者和基金经理参加的首席执行官圆桌会议上作出的。

这位部长表示，海外投资者对印度的投资环境表示了信心。

“我还会见了 Canadian Investment Fund——他们是规模最大的基金之一。他们也表示，（印度）是最安全的投资目的地。”他说。

乔希先生另行表示，政府将在未来10至15天内向行业利益相关方征求意见，然后决定是否延长 Approved List of Models and Manufacturers（ALMM）框架。该框架规定，特定项目必须使用经国内批准的太阳能组件制造商；该框架上次延长至12月31日，适用于太阳能光伏电池。

“有些人希望延长，有些人则不希望延长。我们会听取他们的意见，与双方沟通，并不急于就此作出决定；再过10至15天，我们就会与两个利益相关方协会讨论。”他说。

Unlock these with Subscription The Congress on Wednesday (November 4, 2026) accused Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami of handing over government land and British-era heritage properties to private parties at throwaway prices, and alleged that Mr. Dhami had centralised decision-making powers to facilitate the transfers. The Opposition party demanded Mr. Dhami’s removal and said it would approach the Governor and move the court if no action was taken. At the centre of the State-wide agitation on Wednesday was the proposed transfer of the George Everest estate in Mussoorie, named after Sir George Everest, India’s first Surveyor-General, to private entities. The estate was part of Uttarakhand’s historical and natural heritage, the Congress said, questioning the Uttarakhand government’s decision to transfer such a significant public asset to the hands of private players. Congress general secretary in-charge of Uttarakhand, Kumari Selja, alleged that land and properties at nearly 40 locations across the State were being transferred to private entities, compromising public assets and the interests of the local people. Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters here, Ms. Selja claimed Mr. Dhami had taken away the final authority over land transfers from the Cabinet, and was personally approving major transactions while also chairing the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board. Ms. Selja said 1,080 acres belonging to various government departments had been transferred to the Board via two decisions signed by the Chief Minister. These included 633 acres of the erstwhile Indian Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited facility in Rishikesh, 142 acres in Mussoorie, 25 British-era inspection bungalows, and 190 acres at Dakpathar in Vikasnagar. Tenders had been issued for 14 acres at Patwa Dangar and the Alaknanda Hotel, the Congress leader said, alleging that the Patwa Dangar land was being offered at ₹5 per square metre annually. She also flagged the proposed transfer of forest land in Ramgarh. The allegations came amid protests organised by the Congress across Uttarakhand under the ‘Bhumi Bachao, Dhami Hatao’ (save the land, remove Dhami) campaign. State Congress president Ganesh Godiyal led a demonstration against the transfer of the George Everest estate, alleging the government was compromising the State’s interests by handing over natural resources and public assets to private players. Former Chief Minister Harish Rawat led the protest in Haridwar, alleging that the government was handing over heritage properties, including the Alaknanda Hotel, to favoured industrialists and land interests from outside the State. In Vikasnagar, Chakrata MLA Pritam Singh led a rally against the proposed transfer of around 180 acres at Dakpathar, associated with the Yamuna hydroelectric project, to private companies through the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board. He warned of a sustained agitation on the streets and in the Assembly. A memorandum would be submitted to the Governor and judicial intervention sought, if necessary, the Congress said. Ms. Selja cited Section 28 of the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board Act, arguing that the monetisation of public property required the consent of the concerned departments and the State government. Rejecting the charges, Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) spokesperson Manveer Singh Chauhan said the government’s ownership of the land transferred to the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board would remain intact. The objective, he said, was to attract investment, generate employment and promote sustainable tourism, with the government retaining regulatory control and the right to reclaim the assets after a designated period. 印度国大党周三（2026年11月4日）指控北阿坎德邦首席部长普什卡尔·辛格·达米将政府土地和英国殖民时期的历史建筑以象征性低价转让给私人，并指称达米先生将决策权集中于一身，以促成这些转让。反对党要求达米先生下台，并表示若政府不采取行动，将向总督交涉并在必要时诉诸法院。周三这场全邦抗议活动的核心，是拟将穆索里以印度首任测量总长乔治·埃佛斯特爵士命名的乔治·埃佛斯特庄园转让给私人实体。国大党称，这片庄园是北阿坎德邦历史和自然遗产的一部分，对北阿坎德邦政府将如此重大的公共资产交给私人经营者的决定提出质疑。

负责北阿坎德邦事务的国大党总书记库马里·塞尔贾指称，全邦近40个地点的土地和房产正在转让给私人实体，损害公共资产和当地民众利益。塞尔贾女士在党总部举行的新闻发布会上声称，达米先生已取消内阁对土地转让的最终决定权，而是亲自批准重大交易，同时还兼任北阿坎德邦投资与基础设施发展委员会主席。

塞尔贾女士表示，根据首席部长签署的两项决定，属于多个政府部门的1,080英亩土地已转让给该委员会。其中包括里希克什原印度药品和制药有限公司设施所在的633英亩土地、马苏里的142英亩土地、25座英国殖民时期 Inspection Bungalow（检查小屋），以及比卡斯纳格尔达克帕塔尔的190英亩土地。这位国大党领导人说，帕特瓦丹加尔的14英亩土地和阿拉坎达酒店已发布招标，并指称帕特瓦丹加尔的土地每年仅以每平方米5印度卢比的价格出让。她还特别指出拟转让拉姆加尔森林土地的问题。

这些指控是在国大党以北阿坎德邦全境开展“保住土地、赶走达米”（Bhumi Bachao, Dhami Hatao）运动组织抗议之际提出的。邦国大党主席加内什·戈迪亚尔领导了一场反对转让乔治·埃佛斯特庄园的示威，指称政府把自然资源和公共资产交给私人经营者，损害全邦利益。

前首席部长哈里什·拉瓦特在哈里德瓦尔领导抗议，指称政府正把包括阿拉坎达酒店在内的历史建筑交给受青睐的实业家和来自邦外的土地利益集团。在比卡斯纳格尔，查克拉塔选区议员普里塔姆·辛格领导集会，反对通过北阿坎德邦投资与基础设施发展委员会，将达克帕塔尔约180英亩、与亚穆纳水电项目有关的土地转让给私人公司。他警告称，街头和议会还将持续抗议。国大党表示，将向总督提交备忘录，必要时寻求司法干预。

塞尔贾女士援引《北阿坎德邦投资与基础设施发展委员会法》第28条，主张公共财产变现必须得到相关部门和邦政府的同意。印度人民党发言人曼维尔·辛格·乔汉否认上述指控，称转交给北阿坎德邦投资与基础设施发展委员会的土地仍由政府所有。他说，此举旨在吸引投资、创造就业并促进可持续旅游业，同时政府保留监管权，并有权在约定期限届满后收回这些资产。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/afen.body: Layer 1 The Afenifere and Ndi Igbo Unity Forum have reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening Yoruba-Igbo relations and promoting peaceful coexistence in Lagos State. Chief Deji Wellington, State Chairman of Afenifere, a Yoruba socio-cultural organisation, disclosed this in a statement on Wednesday, after a meeting with leaders of the Igbo community aimed at rebuilding cordial relationships between the two ethnic groups. Wellington said the initiative was designed to change the existing narrative and restore the cordial relationship that previously existed between the Yoruba and Igbo communities. He said it was important for Igbo residents to regard Lagos as their home and maintain peaceful relationships with their host community. “It is our desire that the Ndi Igbo (Igbo people) see Lagos as home, where they are expected to work peacefully with the host community. “They should establish good relationships with the Lagos State Government and subsequently protect their businesses, investments and properties,” he said. Wellington said stronger relationships between the Igbo community, the host community and the state government would promote mutual understanding, security and peaceful coexistence. He said the initiative was also aimed at creating an atmosphere where residents from both ethnic groups could pursue their economic interests without fear or hostility. Wellington said Igbo leaders had pledged their support for President Bola Tinubu’s second-term ambition and the 2027 governorship aspiration of Lagos State Deputy Governor and APC candidate Dr Obafemi Hamzat. He said the forum also promised to collaborate in mobilising support for Tinubu and Hamzat across the state. Wellington said the forum pledged to take the campaign to local government areas, wards and Igbo communities across the state. “The Igbo leaders have promised to join Afenifere in its determination to rally support for the President’s second term and Dr Hamzat as Lagos State Governor in the 2027 election,” Wellington said. He expressed optimism that the partnership would strengthen inter-ethnic relations, deepen political cooperation and promote a more peaceful and inclusive environment in the state. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/afen.title_zh: Afenifere、伊博族论坛寻求加强约鲁巴族与伊博族关系，并支持蒂努布和哈姆扎特
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/afen.body_zh: 第一层 阿菲尼费雷和恩迪伊博团结论坛再次承诺加强约鲁巴人与伊博人之间的关系，并促进拉各斯州的和平共处。阿菲尼费雷这一约鲁巴社会文化组织的州主席德吉·惠灵顿周三在一份声明中透露了上述情况。此前，他与伊博社区领导人举行会议，旨在重建这两个族群之间的和睦关系。惠灵顿表示，此项倡议旨在改变现有的舆论叙事，恢复约鲁巴社区与伊博社区之间曾经存在的和睦关系。他说，伊博居民应把拉各斯视为自己的家园，并与东道社区保持和平关系，这是十分重要的。他说：“我们希望恩迪伊博人（伊博人）把拉各斯视为家园，并在这里与东道社区和谐共事。他们应与拉各斯州政府建立良好关系，进而保护自己的企业、投资和财产。”惠灵顿表示，加强伊博社区、东道社区与州政府之间的关系，将促进相互理解、安全与和平共处。他说，此项倡议还旨在营造一种氛围，使两个族群的居民都能不受恐惧或敌意影响地追求自身经济利益。惠灵顿说，伊博领导人已承诺支持总统博拉·蒂努巴连任竞选，以及拉各斯州副州长兼全尼日利亚进步大会党候选人奥巴费米·哈姆扎特争取在2027年出任州长的愿望。他说，该论坛还承诺在全州范围内协作动员对蒂努巴和哈姆扎特的支持。惠灵顿表示，论坛承诺把竞选活动带到全州各地方政府区、选区以及伊博社区。他说：“伊博领导人已承诺与阿菲尼费雷一道，支持总统争取连任，并支持哈姆扎特博士在2027年选举中当选拉各斯州州长。”他乐观地表示，这一合作将加强族群间关系、深化政治合作，并促进全州形成更加和平、包容的环境。本文所表达的观点不代表《先锋报》及其任何员工的意见

Unlock these with Subscription The Hindu contacted all 20 BLAs registered with the BJP, according to the Election Commission of India’s (ECI) records, who are named as filing the 787 Form 7s, which cite reasons such as “absent/permanently shifted”, “already enrolled” and “death” to seek the deletion of electors’ names. All the applications are against Muslim electors. In all, 16 of the 20 denied having filed or signed any forms since the claims and objections phase began on August 31, 2026. Almost all of them said they had no knowledge of forms being filled out in their names. The 787 applications account for 94% of the 837 deletion applications filed by third parties, according to the publicly available list of Form 7s on the Delhi Chief Electoral Officer’s (CEO) website. Form 7 is used to seek the deletion of existing names from the electoral roll, or to object to the inclusion of names. One such BLA, Ankit Yadav, named as an objector in 32 Form 7 applications, not only denied filing any of them but said he had submitted a complaint and his formal resignation as BLA to party representatives. “I got to know on Sunday that my details have been used to seek deletions of my neighbours belonging to the Muslim community. I know all of them, and we live like family and friends here in this neighbourhood, which has only a couple of Hindu households,” he said. He said the area Booth Level Officer (BLO) had asked him if he had received any OTP, which is not required for offline submissions. “I could see multiple SMS that BLOs have been assigned for form verification, and there were long reference numbers,” he said. “When I called the local BJP councillor, who occasionally convened meetings with party workers, he dismissed my concern, saying I should ignore it and let things be as they are. He said he would take care of it later,” Mr. Yadav said. With the help of the area BLO, The Hindu verified that all the electors concerned live at their registered addresses. The BLO also said he had not received any physical copies of Form 7s. “When I had taken the role of BLA six months ago, I was told that my work would be to help the BLOs and voters in the area. How can they use my details and pose me as ‘fraud’?” Mr. Yadav asked. The Hindu reported on October 30, 2026, that BJP BLAs had been named as objectors in applications seeking the deletion of Muslim electors who were found living at their addresses in Mustafabad during the paper’s visit. One of the objectors, Chandra Shekhar Nainwal, named in applications concerning 28 Muslim electors, had denied filing them and said he was not associated with the BJP. Four other BLAs said they were no longer associated with the BJP in that capacity. Mr. Sharma said he received a call from the Electoral Registration Officer’s (ERO) office on Tuesday (November 3, 2026) seeking clarification about the objections, but denied filing them. The Hindu had accessed a few Form 7s, duly filled and signed in the names of BJP BLAs, including that of Nitin Kumar. Mr. Kumar, while denying filing any of the forms, said he had received SMSs relating to verification. “The area is not even mine where applications in my name are showing,” he said. BJP BLA Robin Singh Dhama, named as an objector in 57 cases, is an exception. He acknowledged filing Form 7 applications and claimed to have submitted “500 of those”. He said: “These people don’t live in the area, so why are they on the voter list? I have so far filed 500 such forms.” The telephone number listed for BJP BLA Shashi was reportedly a wrong number. A person who answered the number and shared his name said: “I have already submitted multiple complaints seeking its removal.” Shashi has been named as an objector in 59 cases, including 10 listed on November 3. Manoj Kumar, named as an objector in 43 applications, and Tribhuvan Dixit, named in 26, could not be reached. All these objections were received after the ECI introduced, on October 9, 2026, a cap of 10 Form 7 applications from an individual elector during the entire claims and objections period. While BLAs are permitted to submit bulk applications of up to 10 forms a day, the provision covers forms filled by other electors and submitted along with an undertaking by the BLA. The forms naming these 20 BLAs as objectors were filed without the prescribed BLA undertaking, or the format prescribed for them, The Hindu has learnt. The District Election Officer (DEO), the Delhi Chief Electoral Officer and the ECI did not respond to questions from The Hindu . In an earlier response, the DEO had said that all deletion claims would be physically verified by the BLO and the ERO/Assistant ERO, and that action would be taken against those found to be false or “mischievous”. 据印度选举委员会（ECI）记录，《The Hindu》联系了在印度人民党（BJP）登记的20名基层联络员（BLA）。这些人的姓名被列为提交787份表格7的异议者，这些表格以“缺席／永久迁居”、“已经登记”和“死亡”等为由，申请从选民名册中删除相关人员。所有申请均针对穆斯林选民。20人中有16人否认，自2026年8月31日进入申报和异议阶段以来，曾提交或签署过任何表格。几乎所有人都表示，他们不知道有人以自己的名义填写了表格。

据德里首席选举官（CEO）网站公开的表格7清单，由第三方提交的837份删除申请中，787份申请占了94%。表格7用于申请从选民名册中删除现有姓名，或对将姓名列入选民名册提出异议。

其中一名基层联络员安基特·亚达夫被列为32份表格7申请的异议者。他不仅否认提交过其中任何一份表格，还表示自己已向党代表提交了投诉，并辞去基层联络员职务。

他说：“周日下午，我得知有人利用我的信息，申请删除我这个社区里穆斯林邻居的姓名。我认识他们所有人，我们在这个社区像家人和朋友一样生活，这里只有两三户印度教家庭。”

他说，当地投票站联络官（BLO）曾问他是否收到过一次性密码，而线下提交并不需要这一验证码。他说：“我看到有多条短信，是分配给基层联络官进行表格核验的，而且附有很长的参考编号。”

他说：“我给当地人民党议员打了电话，他偶尔会召集党员开会。他对我的担忧不予重视，叫我不要管，让事情维持原样。他说他之后会处理。”

在当地基层联络员的协助下，《The Hindu》核实了所有相关选民均居住在其登记地址。该基层联络官还表示，他没有收到过任何表格7的纸质副本。

亚达夫先生问：“我六个月前担任基层联络员时，有人告诉我，我的工作是协助当地基层联络官和选民。他们怎么能利用我的信息，把我塑造成‘骗子’？”

《The Hindu》于2026年10月30日报道称，在该报实地走访马斯特法巴德期间，人民党基层联络员被列为异议者，相关申请要求删除经核实仍居住在其登记地址的穆斯林选民。

异议者之一钱德拉·谢卡尔·奈恩沃尔被列在涉及28名穆斯林选民的申请中，但他否认提交过这些申请，并称自己与人民党没有关系。另有4名基层联络员表示，他们已不再以这一身份与人民党有关联。

夏尔马先生表示，他于周二（2026年11月3日）接到选举登记官（ERO）办公室的电话，要求就这些异议作进一步说明，但他否认提交过相关表格。

《The Hindu》查看了若干份以人民党基层联络员名义填写并签署的表格7，其中包括尼廷·库马尔的表格。库马尔否认提交过任何表格，但他表示收到了与核验有关的短信。他说：“这些申请显示是以我的名义提交的，但这里甚至不是我负责的地区。”

人民党基层联络员罗宾·辛格·达马则是一个例外。他在57起案件中被列为异议者。他承认提交过表格7申请，并称自己已提交“500份这样的表格”。他说：“这些人不住在这个地区，那他们为什么还在选民名单上？迄今我已经提交了500份这样的表格。”

据报道，为人民党基层联络员夏希登记的电话号码是错误号码。接听电话并自称同名的一名人士表示：“我已经提交了多项投诉，要求删除该号码。”夏希在59起案件中被列为异议者，其中包括2026年11月3日列出的10起。

马诺杰·库马尔和特里布万·迪克希特分别被列为43份和26份申请的异议者，但均无法联系上。

所有这些异议均是在印度选举委员会于2026年10月9日出台新规后收到的。新规规定，在整个申报和异议期内，每名选民提交的表格7申请上限为10份。虽然基层联络员每天可以批量提交最多10份表格，但该规定针对的是由其他选民填写、并随基层联络员承诺书一并提交的表格。

《The Hindu》获悉，将这20名基层联络员列为异议者的表格，是在未附规定基层联络员承诺书，或未采用规定格式的情况下提交的。

地区选举官（DEO）、德里首席选举官和印度选举委员会均未回应《The Hindu》的提问。地区选举官此前曾表示，所有删除申请都将由基层联络官和选举登记官／助理选举登记官进行实地核验，并将被认定为虚假或“恶意”的人采取行动。

Kailangan pumunta tayo sa dagat,” Teodoro said during his remarks at the 97th founding anniversary celebrations in Oroquieta City. (The resources we need for development can no longer be found on land. We need to turn to the sea.) “Kaya pinaglalaban natin ang 200 nautical mile exclusive economic zone natin sa West Philippine Sea, sa Pacific Ocean na mas malaki pa, na makuha natin ang fish, ang mga isda, at ang mga oil and gas na nandoon sa ilalim para sa kinabukasan ninyo,” he added. Teodoro warned that others could benefit from these resources if the Philippines failed to protect its maritime rights. “Kung ubusin namin ’yan, hindi namin labanan ang West Philippine Sea, wala na matitira sa atin. Iba na ang makikinabang,” he said. (If we exhaust those resources and fail to defend the West Philippine Sea, nothing will be left for us. Others will benefit instead.) Speaking to reporters afterward, Teodoro described the West Philippine Sea as a key driver of the country’s future development. “The West Philippine Sea is a catalyst for development,” he said. “Ngayon, kung we sit back and relax, eh walang mangyayari. Kailangan ipaglaban natin,” he added. (Now, if we sit back and relax, nothing will happen. We need to fight for it.) His remarks came amid a renewed dispute with Beijing over joint oil and gas exploration in the West Philippine Sea. On Tuesday, Teodoro rejected the Chinese Embassy’s accusation that he had obstructed joint exploration efforts, pointing out that former President Rodrigo Duterte terminated negotiations in 2022 over constitutional concerns. The Philippines and China signed a memorandum of understanding on possible oil and gas cooperation in 2018, but talks ended without a final agreement. Teodoro also reiterated Wednesday that joint exploration with China would be illegal, citing constitutional concerns and the 2016 arbitral ruling, which invalidated the legal basis of Beijing’s sweeping claims to historic rights in the South China Sea. Unlock these with Subscription Ola Källenius, Chairman of the Board of Management, Mercedes-Benz Group AG India will play an important role in Mercedes-Benz Group AG’s global business as the company would source more technology and components from India for it’s global operations before exporting vehicles from the country, Ola Kallenius, Mercedes-Benz’s Group AG Chairman of the Board of Management, said in a select interaction. “We are building strong tech and supply relationships in India, not just for India, also for the rest of the world. So we can, export out of India on a component basis before a full vehicle,” he said. “And these tech partnerships and supply partnerships are going from strength to strength. And the fact that we have the biggest R&D center outside of Germany here in Bengaluru, we also have a very competent production setup since more than 30 years,” he stated. “We have all the ingredients. So this is not a one dimensional play. India in the Mercedes world is a 360 degree play,” he emphasised. Asked when the company would export vehicles from India, he said, “I am an India believer and certainly an India optimist. I think that is more a question of when as opposed to a question of if.” “But I want to make clear we have not made such a decision at this point in time,” he said, adding the company would wait for volumes to grow in India before embarking on exports. “So, the first step on the further journey is what organic growth can we have from this point forward. We believe, based upon projections around GDP growth, what we think that the market in India can be in the next five, six, seven years, that we can significantly grow from that number upwards,” he added. He said R& D in India will play a bigger role and the company would build stronger supply relationships to source components. The company sees energy transition as a reality and being the inventor of automobiles and as an incumbent, it is strengthening it’s capabilities in newer fuels. “The automotive industry is in transition. It’s in transformation, I would say disruption. What’s driving the disruption is the road to zero emissions and we don’t have to discuss the destination. The destination is zero emission. It’s just a question of how long it takes,” he said. “We are reinventing the original invention. So there’s always turbulence when you go through a transformation of that magnitude,” he said adding many new entrants will come in and they of course will go for electric mobility, but the legacy players too will be in the race to succeed. “If you’re an incumbent, you don’t cut off the leg that you stand on right now and you build a new one. So you have to manage a transition that it’s not like with smartphones,” he stated. “The destination is zero emission, that’s where we are going,” he emphasised. Stating that the company has taken diesel to EU7 standards, he said diesel engines will stay in the portfolio for the foreseeable future. The company on Wednesday announced a fresh investment of ₹200 crore in India, taking the total investment to ₹3,200 crore and introduced its electric GLC SUV at a starting price of ₹78.5 lakh. The SUV has 711 kms range in one charge and 300 kms of energy can be charged in 10 minutes. Mercedes-Benz Group AG印度董事会主席Ola Källenius在一场专题交流中表示，在该公司从印度出口车辆之前，将从印度采购更多用于全球运营的技术和零部件，因此印度将在Mercedes-Benz Group AG的全球业务中发挥重要作用。

Mercedes-Benz Group AG董事会主席Ola Kallenius说：“我们正在印度建立稳固的技术和供应关系，这不仅是为了印度，也是为了世界其他地区。因此，我们可以先从印度出口零部件，之后再出口整车。这些技术合作和供应合作正在不断加强。我们在这里拥有德国以外最大的研发中心，而且30多年来也建立了非常 competent 的生产体系。”

他表示：“我们具备所有必要条件。因此，这不是单一维度的布局。在Mercedes-Benz的版图中，印度是一个全方位发展的市场。”

当被问及公司何时会从印度出口车辆时，他说：“我看好印度，也无疑对印度充满乐观。我认为，这更多是一个何时实现的问题，而不是会不会实现的问题。”

他说：“但我想明确说明，我们目前尚未作出这样的决定。”他补充称，公司会等待印度市场销量增长后再启动出口。

他说：“因此，未来征程的第一步，是从现在起实现自然增长。根据我们对GDP增长的预测，以及我们对印度市场未来五、六、七年的判断，我们相信能够在这个数字基础上实现大幅增长。”

他表示，印度的研发将发挥更大作用，公司将建立更紧密的供应关系，以采购零部件。

公司认为，能源转型已是现实。作为汽车发明者和现有市场参与者，公司正在加强自身开发新型燃料的能力。

他说：“汽车行业正处于转型之中。我想说，它正在经历变革。推动这种变革的是通往零排放的道路，而目的地无需讨论。目的地就是零排放。问题只在于这需要多长时间。”

他说：“我们正在重新发明最初的发明。因此，当你经历如此大规模的转型时，总会伴随动荡。”他补充道，许多新进入者将加入竞争，它们当然会转向电动出行，但传统企业也会参与这场竞争，争夺成功。

他表示：“如果你是一家现有企业，就不会砍掉目前支撑自己的那条腿，然后只建一条新腿。因此，你必须管理好这种转型，它不像智能手机行业那样。”

他强调：“目的地是零排放，这就是我们前进的方向。”

他表示，公司已将柴油动力提升至EU7标准，柴油发动机在可预见的未来仍将保留在产品组合中。

公司周三宣布将在印度追加投资₹200 crore，使总投资额达到₹3,200 crore，并推出电动GLC SUV，起售价为₹78.5 lakh。这款SUV一次充电可行驶711 kms，10分钟可充入可支持行驶300 kms的电量。公司表示，在价格公布前预订量已超过1,000辆，这表明印度对电动汽车存在需求。

https://punchng.com/atiku-arrives-sokoto.body: The presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress, Atiku Abubakar, has arrived in Sokoto State ahead of the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled to take place at its state secretariat along Ilorin Road. Speaking with our correspondent, one of the supporters, Abubakar Yusuf, said alleged intimidation by the state government would not discourage them from attending the event. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: KOSPI edges up after volatile session amid US policy uncertainty Korean stocks face growing policy uncertainty after Democrats regained control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in the U.S. midterm elections, according to market analysts, Wednesday. They say obstacles to extending corporate tax cuts and the prospect of stricter oversight of Big Tech and artificial intelligence (AI) could fuel volatility in Korea’s tech-heavy stock market. However, sweeping policy changes remain unlikely given U.S. President Donald Trump’s veto power and ability to issue executive orders, the analysts said. Over the medium term, Korean stocks are expected to be driven more by returns on AI investment, semiconductor demand and foreign investor flows than by the election outcome itself. KOSPI closed slightly higher after a volatile session as investors assessed the implications of the Democrats’ victory. After rebounding 2.24 percent in the previous session, the benchmark opened at 5,786.13, up 137.34 points, or 2.43 percent, and climbed as high as 5,828.13, a gain of 3.17 percent. It then reversed course, falling as much as 4.02 percent to 5,421.72, before recovering to close at 5,683.80, up 35.01 points, or 0.62 percent. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix fell 0.68 percent and 0.14 percent, respectively. The Kosdaq closed at 714.95, up 10.56 points, or 1.50 percent. Lee Ji-seon, an analyst at Toss Securities, said the Democrats’ takeover of Congress could heighten market volatility. “An extension of corporate tax cuts could be harder to secure, while Big Tech and the AI industry could face closer regulatory scrutiny, adding to market volatility,” Lee said. Still, Democrats would face significant hurdles in turning their legislative agenda into law, as Trump could veto bills approved by Congress. “Even after clearing both chambers, legislation requires presidential approval, and Trump is likely to reject bills proposed by Democrats,” said Kim Sung-keun, an analyst at Mirae Asset Securities. “Overriding a veto would require a two-thirds majority in both the House and Senate, which would be difficult without cooperation from Republicans.” He also said the Trump administration could rely on executive orders to keep its current policies in place. Analysts advised investors to watch actual AI spending by major U.S. customers and demand at Korean chipmakers, alongside any policy shifts following the election. Stability in oil prices and the exchange rate will also be key to the market outlook. “Investors are showing signs of fatigue after repeatedly confronting uncertainty over the AI industry since October,” said Han Ji-young, an analyst at Kiwoom Securities. “The pressure on companies to demonstrate profitability will persist with each earnings season.” However, Han said AI-related stocks had already undergone a substantial correction since October, while pressure from oil prices and interest rates had eased. The won-dollar exchange rate has recently fallen to the low 1,300s after breaching 1,500 won per dollar in intraday trading earlier this year. In the Seoul foreign exchange market Wednesday, the won weakened by 0.5 won to close onshore trading at 1,341.5 won per dollar. “Any further correction is more likely to take the form of an extended period of sideways trading than another sharp decline in prices,” Han said. Analysts also view renewed foreign buying as crucial to a market recovery, with overseas investors extending their net selling streak to a seventh month in November. Yet lingering uncertainty surrounding the Middle East and political developments in major economies could keep a sustained return to foreign buying out of reach for at least another three months, according to Lee Kyung-soo, an analyst at Hana Securities. Lee examined periods in 2002, 2008 and 2020 when sharp market declines coincided with prolonged foreign selling. He found that KOSPI tended to rebound after spending about three months establishing a bottom, while foreign investors generally turned net buyers after six months. The proportion of observations in which foreigners became net buyers was just 26 percent after three months, rising to 57 percent after six months and 94 percent after a year. “Our quantitative analysis suggests that a rebound in KOSPI and a sustained return to net buying by foreign investors may be at least three months away,” Lee said. Still, some analysts expect the conclusion of the U.S. midterm elections to remove a source of uncertainty and potentially encourage foreign investors to return. “Reduced political uncertainty following the U.S. elections could support a recovery in global risk appetite,” said Lee Sang-yeon, an analyst at Shinyoung Securities. “Foreign investors turned net buyers of Korean futures last week, while net program buying increased, both positive signals,” Lee said. “This week, attention will be on whether they keep buying futures and scale back their selling in the cash market.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 民主党重新掌控美国国会，首尔股市面临新一轮不确定性
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 在美国政策不确定性笼罩的震荡交易后，韩国综合股价指数小幅走高。据市场分析师周三表示，在美国中期选举中民主党重新掌控参议院和众议院后，韩国股市面临日益上升的政策不确定性。他们说，延长企业减税政策存在障碍，加之大型科技企业和人工智能可能受到更严格监管，这些因素或加剧韩国科技股占比较高的股市波动。不过，分析师表示，鉴于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拥有否决权和发布行政命令的能力，全面改变政策的可能性仍然不高。中期内，预计韩国股市走势将更多取决于人工智能投资回报、半导体需求和外国投资者资金流向，而非选举结果本身。投资者评估民主党胜选的影响之际，韩国综合股价指数在震荡交易后小幅收高。在上一交易日反弹2.24%后，该基准指数开盘报5,786.13点，上涨137.34点，涨幅为2.43%，盘中最高升至5,828.13点，涨幅达3.17%。随后指数急转直下，一度下跌4.02%至5,421.72点，之后回升，收于5,683.80点，上涨35.01点，涨幅为0.62%。三星电子和SK海力士分别下跌0.68%和0.14%。韩国科斯达克指数收于714.95点，上涨10.56点，涨幅为1.50%。Toss Securities分析师李智善说，民主党接管国会可能加剧市场波动。李说：“延长企业减税政策可能更难获得批准，同时大型科技企业和人工智能行业可能面临更严格的监管，从而加剧市场波动。”不过，民主党要将立法议程转化为法律仍面临重大障碍，因为特朗普可以否决国会通过的法案。Mirae Asset Securities分析师金成根说：“即使法案通过参众两院，仍需获得总统批准，而特朗普很可能否决民主党提出的法案。”“推翻否决需要在众议院和参议院均获得三分之二多数，这在没有共和党配合的情况下很难实现。”他还说，特朗普政府可以依靠行政命令维持现行政策。分析师建议投资者关注美国主要客户的实际人工智能支出和韩国芯片制造商的需求，以及选举后可能出现的政策变化。油价和汇率的稳定性也将是市场展望的关键。Kiwoom Securities分析师韩智英说：“自10月以来，投资者反复面对人工智能行业的不确定性，已显现出疲态。”“随着每个财报季到来，企业证明自身盈利能力所承受的压力将持续存在。”不过，韩表示，与人工智能相关的股票自10月以来已经历大幅回调，而油价和利率带来的压力有所缓解。年初韩元兑美元盘中一度突破1,500韩元后，最近已跌至1,300韩元出头的低位。周三在首尔外汇市场，韩元下跌0.5韩元，境内交易收于1美元兑1,341.5韩元。韩说：“进一步回调更可能表现为长期横盘，而非价格再次急跌。”分析师还认为，外国投资者重新买入是市场复苏的关键；11月海外投资者的净卖出已延续至第七个月。然而，Hana Securities分析师李圭洙表示，中东地区持续存在的不确定性以及主要经济体的政治 developments，可能使外国投资者持续回流至少再等三个月。市场分析师李圭洙研究了2002年、2008年和2020年市场大跌与外国投资者长期卖出的同时发生的时期。他发现，韩国综合股价指数通常在约三个月筑底后反弹，而外国投资者一般在六个月转为净买入。三个月后外国投资者转为净买入的观察期占比仅为26%，六个月后升至57%，一年后则达到94%。李说：“我们的量化分析表明，韩国综合股价指数反弹以及外国投资者持续恢复净买入，最早也要再等三个月。”尽管如此，一些分析师预计，美国中期选举结束将消除一个不确定性来源，并可能促使外国投资者回流。Shinyoung Securities分析师李相妍说：“美国选举后政治不确定性降低，可能支撑全球风险偏好回升。”“上周外国投资者转为净买入韩国期货，同时净程序化买入增加，两者都是积极信号。”李说，“本周值得关注的是，他们能否继续买入期货，并减少在现货市场的卖出。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Some expect Trump to press ahead, but Seoul could be sidelined even if talks resume The Democrats’ victory in both the House and Senate in Tuesday's (local time) U.S. midterm elections has made a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un even less likely, analysts said Wednesday, though others argued that Trump’s tendency to shrug off political pressure means he may keep pursuing a meeting regardless. A Trump-Kim meeting had been floated as a possible diplomatic surprise around the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, scheduled for Nov. 18 and 19 in Shenzhen, China. The two leaders met three times during Trump’s first term from 2017 to 2021, but a fourth meeting was already in doubt before the elections, given Kim’s lukewarm response to renewed U.S. outreach. Some analysts said the prospect has also lost some of its appeal as a headline-grabbing event, with attention shifting to a possible U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen. “I think a Democratic victory would put serious brakes on both Trump’s efforts to meet Kim and the South Korean government’s outreach to North Korea,” Ahn said. “Even if they meet for the sake of the event, there would be limits on what could follow,” Shin said. “Would Kim want to meet a weakened Trump?” Shin noted the prospect of a U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen could matter more than the midterm result. If Trump had a chance to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, he said, the U.S. president “would have less reason to pursue a separate encounter with the North Korean leader.” Others argued that closer congressional scrutiny of his administration and fewer allies on Capitol Hill could lead Trump to spend more time on foreign policy and step up his outreach to Kim and Xi. Andrew Yeo, a professor of politics at the Catholic University of America, said Democratic efforts to scale back Trump’s war in the Middle East could draw attention away from North Korea. But he said the decision to meet would still rest with the two leaders. “If Kim Jong-un states that he’s prepared to meet Trump, Trump will make that meeting happen,” Yeo said. Fred Fleitz, a former chief of staff of the U.S. National Security Council and vice chair of the America First Policy Institute, said Democratic criticism of a Trump-Kim meeting could intensify, but he expected Trump to disregard it. “I think Trump’s going to do what he wants to do,” Fleitz said. Sean King, a senior vice president at Park Strategies, said pressure at home could make Trump more inclined to pursue personal diplomacy. “Facing congressional investigations, and with fewer friends on Capitol Hill, President Trump is now sure to spend more time on foreign policy,” King said. “I suspect he’ll sadly go out of his way, even more than he already has, to court and placate the likes of Kim Jong-un and Xi Jinping.” The election results come as President Lee Jae Myung has urged Trump to serve as a “peacemaker” on the Korean Peninsula while offering himself as a “pacemaker," hoping U.S. outreach can create an opening for inter-Korean dialogue. Ahn said Seoul could “find itself sidelined” even if the summit goes ahead, with Washington seeking to retain control of its dealings with Pyongyang. “We should be very careful about assuming that better relations between the U.S. and North Korea will improve our own relations with the North,” he said. Shin said the U.S. midterm elections would have little immediate effect on Lee’s outreach because Pyongyang was already unwilling to engage with Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 分析师称，民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜，使特朗普与金正恩峰会的前景更加黯淡
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
有人预计特朗普会继续推进，但即使谈判恢复，首尔也可能被边缘化。分析人士周三表示，民主党在周二（当地时间）举行的美国中期选举中同时赢得众议院和参议院，这使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性进一步降低。不过，也有人认为，特朗普无视政治压力的倾向意味着他可能无论如何都会继续寻求会面。

此前曾有人提出，特朗普与金正恩可能会在定于11月18日至19日于中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间实现一次出人意料的外交会晤。特朗普在2017年至2021年第一任期内曾与金正恩会面3次，但在此次选举之前，第四次会面就已存在疑问，因为金正恩对恢复美国方面的接触反应冷淡。

一些分析人士称，随着焦点转向可能在美国、中国和俄罗斯于深圳举行的峰会，特朗普与金正恩会面作为吸引头条事件的吸引力也有所下降。“我认为，民主党的胜利会严重阻碍特朗普试图与金正恩会面的努力，也会严重阻碍韩国政府与朝鲜接触的尝试。”安说。“即使双方为了活动本身而会面，后续能取得什么成果也会受到限制。”申说。“金正恩会想见一个处于弱势的特朗普吗？”

申指出，在深圳举行美国、中国和俄罗斯峰会的可能性，可能比中期选举结果更重要。他说，如果特朗普有机会会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，那么这位美国总统“就更没有理由单独与朝鲜领导人会面”。

另一些人认为，国会对其政府的更密切审查以及其在国会山盟友减少，可能促使特朗普投入更多时间处理外交政策，并加强对金正恩和习近平的接触。美国天主教大学政治学教授安德鲁·约奥说，民主党为缩减特朗普在中东战争上的投入而作出的努力，可能会使人们的注意力从朝鲜问题上移开。但他说，是否会面的决定仍将由两位领导人作出。“如果金正恩表示他准备与特朗普会面，特朗普就会让这次会面成为现实。”约奥说。

美国国家安全委员会前幕僚长、美国优先政策研究所副主席弗雷德·弗莱茨说，民主党对特朗普与金正恩会面的批评可能会加剧，但他预计特朗普会不予理会。“我认为特朗普会做他想做的事。”弗莱茨说。

Park Strategies高级副总裁肖恩·金说，国内压力可能使特朗普更倾向于推行个人外交。“面对国会调查，而且在国会山的朋友更少，特朗普总统现在肯定会投入更多时间处理外交政策。”金说。“我担心，他会刻意迎合和安抚金正恩、习近平之类的人物，而且这种倾向甚至会比现在更强。”

选举结果公布之际，李在明总统已敦促特朗普在朝鲜半岛问题上充当“调停者”，同时自我定位为“协调者”，希望美国方面的接触能为朝韩对话创造契机。安说，即使峰会如期举行，首尔也可能“发现自己被边缘化”，因为华盛顿寻求继续掌控与平壤的交涉。“我们在假定美朝关系改善会带动我们与朝鲜的关系改善时，必须非常谨慎。”他说。

申说，美国中期选举对李的接触政策不会产生太大即时影响，因为平壤已经不愿与首尔展开接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Korean won to strengthen against dollar following Democrats' midterm sweep
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Democratic control of US Congress raises prospect of weaker dollar, experts say The Korean won is expected to strengthen against the U.S. dollar after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, as political tensions in Washington and a potential sell-off in U.S. equities could weigh on the dollar, experts said Wednesday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 专家称，民主党掌控美国国会增加了美元走弱的可能性。专家周三表示，在民主党于美国中期选举中横扫国会两院后，韩元预计将兑美元走强，因为华盛顿的政治紧张局势以及美国股市可能出现的抛售都会对美元构成压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Democratic control of US Congress raises prospect of weaker dollar, experts say The Korean won is expected to strengthen against the U.S. dollar after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, as political tensions in Washington and a potential sell-off in U.S. equities could weigh on the dollar, experts said Wednesday. Democratic control of Congress is expected to complicate U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to advance his economic agenda, including tax cuts and expanded government spending, while giving lawmakers greater power to scrutinize his administration's policies. The prospect of a prolonged standoff between the White House and Congress could unsettle investors and undermine confidence in U.S. financial markets, said Shin Se-don, an economics professor at Sookmyung Women's University. "A fierce confrontation between Congress and the Trump administration will be inevitable. Trump's economic policy initiatives could face setbacks as Democrats step up opposition to the administration's policies, potentially slowing growth across the broader U.S. economy," Shin said. The political fallout could spill over into financial markets, particularly U.S. technology stocks tied to artificial intelligence (AI) and digital infrastructure. Shin said concerns over excessive investment in AI had already put technology stocks under pressure, and that political turmoil could further weigh on the broader U.S. stock market. "Market correction would make U.S. financial assets less attractive to investors. A slowdown in investment could weaken the dollar and give the Korean won room to further appreciate," the professor said. Shin also noted that the won-dollar exchange rate could be influenced more heavily by domestic factors, including Korea's current account balance and exporters' dollar selling. The won has strengthened in recent months, with the won-dollar exchange rate falling from the 1,500 won range in June to the 1,300 won range in October. The monthly average rate declined from 1,527.95 won per dollar in June to 1,488.92 won in July, 1,404.35 won in August, 1,358.75 won in September and 1,335.70 won in October, according to the Bank of Korea. Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University, also expects the won to strengthen further in the near term following the U.S. midterm results, citing constraints on the Trump administration's economic policies. "With Democrats controlling Congress, it will be harder for the Trump administration to borrow heavily to finance government spending or push through further tax cuts," Kim said. "That could ease pressure on U.S. Treasury yields and the won-dollar exchange rate." A weaker dollar would lower Korea's import costs for crude oil and raw materials, helping ease inflationary pressure on energy and food prices, he said. But the stronger won could hurt Korean exporters by reducing the value of their dollar-denominated earnings when converted into won. Kim, however, warned that the won could reverse course and weaken over the longer term if the momentum in the semiconductor export boom fades. In recent months, strong chip exports, particularly memory semiconductors used in AI infrastructure, have been a major source of dollar inflows and helped support the won. "In the longer term, a potential loss of momentum in the Trump administration's AI support policies under a Democratic-controlled Congress could dampen global investment sentiment toward AI and semiconductor markets, ultimately weighing on Korea's chip exports," Kim said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 民主党横扫中期选举后，韩元兑美元料走强
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 专家称，民主党掌控美国国会为美元走弱带来可能前景。专家周三表示，在美国中期选举中民主党横扫国会两院后，韩元预计将兑美元走强，因为华盛顿的政治紧张局势以及美国股市可能出现的抛售都会令美元承压。民主党掌控国会，预计将使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普更难推进其经济议程，包括减税和扩大政府支出，同时也赋予议员更大的权力审查其政府的政策。梨花女子大学经济学教授申世敦说，白宫与国会长期僵持的前景可能令投资者不安，并削弱对美国金融市场的信心。申说：“国会与特朗普政府之间的激烈对抗不可避免。随着民主党加强对政府政策的反对，特朗普的经济政策举措可能遭遇挫折，从而可能拖慢美国整体经济的增长。”政治局势的冲击可能外溢至金融市场，尤其是与人工智能和数字基础设施相关的美国科技股。申说，对人工智能过度投资的担忧已经令科技股承压，而政治动荡可能进一步拖累美国整体股市。这位教授说：“市场调整会降低美国金融资产对投资者的吸引力。投资放缓可能削弱美元，并为韩元进一步升值创造空间。”申还指出，韩元兑美元汇率可能更多受到国内因素影响，包括韩国经常账户余额以及出口商抛售美元的行为。韩国央行数据显示，韩元近几个月持续升值，兑美元汇率从6月的1,500韩元区间降至10月的1,300韩元区间。月均汇率从6月的每美元1,527.95韩元降至7月的1,488.92韩元、8月的1,404.35韩元、9月的1,358.75韩元和10月的1,335.70韩元。世宗大学工商管理学教授金大中预计，美国中期选举结果公布后，韩元近期也将进一步走强，原因是特朗普政府的经济政策受到制约。金说：“民主党掌控国会后，特朗普政府将更难大举借债为政府支出融资，也更难推动进一步减税。这可能缓解美国国债收益率和韩元兑美元汇率承受的压力。”他说，美元走弱会降低韩国进口原油和原材料的成本，有助于缓解能源和食品价格的通胀压力。不过，韩元走强也可能损害韩国出口商，因为其以美元计价的收益折算成韩元后价值会下降。然而，金警告称，如果半导体出口热潮的势头消退，韩元可能逆转走势并在更长期内走弱。近几个月来，强劲的芯片出口，特别是用于人工智能基础设施的存储半导体，是美元流入的重要来源，并帮助支撑韩元。金说：“从长期来看，在民主党掌控国会的情况下，特朗普政府的人工智能支持政策可能失去动力，进而削弱全球投资者对人工智能和半导体市场的信心，最终拖累韩国的芯片出口……”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title: Tinubu Slashes External Borrowing Request to $7.7bn, Seeks Senate Approval
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary: The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary_zh: 参议院议长戈德斯维尔·阿克帕比奥星期三在全会上宣读蒂努布最新信函时透露，这项新请求实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。阿克帕比奥在解释这封修订函的重要性时说，这项新请求实际上取消了他于10月27日代表蒂努布宣读的早期方案；该方案寻求批准 205.2 亿美元和 10.45 亿欧元的外部借款。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: New proposal replaces earlier $20.52bn and €1.045bn borrowing plan, says Akpabio Funds to finance 2026 budget deficit, support reserves, stabilise naira President Bola Tinubu has revised the Federal Government’s external borrowing plan for 2026, seeking Senate approval for a fresh $7.707 billion (N10.79 trillion) loan to finance part of the budget deficit, replacing an earlier request for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion. The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. The revised request, dated October 26, 2026, seeks legislative authorisation for the Federal Government to raise the equivalent of N10.79 trillion in external financing as part of the funding arrangements for the 2026 Appropriation Act. The president explained that the proposed external borrowing formed part of the N29.2 trillion new borrowing provision in the 2026 budget, designed to finance the country’s estimated N31.4 trillion budget deficit. Under the revised financing arrangement, the Federal Government plans to raise N10.79 trillion externally, while N18.4 trillion would be sourced from the domestic debt market. Tinubu said the external financing would be mobilised through several channels, including Eurobond issuance, concessional and commercial loans from multilateral and bilateral institutions, International Monetary Fund (IMF) facilities and bridge financing arrangements. However, he indicated that the government would place greater emphasis on Eurobond issuance because of its relatively faster processing time and capacity to generate substantial funds at comparatively lower costs. The president said: “All the options will be pursued simultaneously, considering the costs and related benefits to the country and the time required to access the funds. “In view of this, emphasis will be on the issuance of Eurobonds, which is typically faster to conclude. Additionally, a large amount can be raised through Eurobonds at a relatively lower cost.” He explained that the final terms and conditions of the proposed facilities would be determined by prevailing market conditions when the loans were being priced. According to him, the Federal Ministry of Finance and the Debt Management Office (DMO) would work together to ensure that the country secured the most favourable borrowing terms. Tinubu said the proposed funds would finance projects and programmes captured in the 2026 Appropriation Act, particularly in critical sectors considered essential to economic growth and national development. He identified defence and security, transportation, agriculture, power, education and healthcare as priority areas expected to benefit from the proposed external financing. The president explained that the borrowing was necessary to sustain the implementation of the administration’s economic reform agenda and consolidate the gains recorded over the past few years. “The new external borrowings are required to implement the items, programmes and projects in the 2026 Appropriation Act, which are designed to consolidate and strengthen the macroeconomic reforms and gains recorded by this administration in the past few years,” he said. Beyond financing budgetary obligations, Tinubu said the proposed borrowing would also strengthen Nigeria’s external reserves and provide additional support for exchange-rate stability. He explained that the foreign currency proceeds would be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby increasing the country’s foreign reserves. “It is also important to add that the process will increase the accretion to the external reserves, since the funds will be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby supporting the naira exchange rate,” he stated. The president anchored his request on Sections 21(1) and 27(1) of the Debt Management Office (Establishment, etc.) Act, 2003, which provide for legislative approval of external borrowing and empower the National Assembly to approve the terms and conditions of such facilities. He specifically asked the Senate to approve the proposed N10.79 trillion borrowing, equivalent to $7.707 billion, based on the 2026 budget exchange rate of N1,400 to the dollar. Tinubu also sought the Senate’s authorisation for the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, in collaboration with the DMO, to take the necessary steps to implement the borrowing arrangement. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing. He said the latest letter was more explicit about the government’s financing requirements and provided greater flexibility in sourcing funds from different international markets and institutions. Akpabio said: “I believe this letter effectively cancels the earlier request that was sent for $20-something billion. But this is much more explicit.” The Senate President explained that the revised arrangement recognised that the Federal Government would not necessarily obtain all the required funds from a single source, but would explore different financing opportunities to secure competitive terms. According to him, “This also takes cognisance of the fact that the borrowing is not going to take effect from only one location. So we have to go out there and search for the best terms, what we may call a willing-seller, willing-buyer approach.” Following the presentation of the presidential communication, Akpabio referred the request to the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts for further legislative scrutiny. He asked the committee to examine the proposed borrowing arrangements and report back to the Senate for consideration, “as soon as practicable”. The revised borrowing request comes amid continuing concerns over Nigeria’s rising public debt obligations, the growing cost of debt servicing and the government’s dependence on borrowing to finance budgetary commitments. With the 2026 budget providing for substantial new borrowing, the Senate’s consideration of Tinubu’s request is expected to focus not only on the proposed financing arrangements but also on the country’s capacity to manage additional external debt and ensure that borrowed funds are deployed for the purposes stated by the government. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title_zh: 蒂努布将外部借款申请削减至77亿美元，并寻求参议院批准
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body_zh: 阿克帕比奥称，新方案取代此前205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的借款计划，将为2026年预算赤字融资、补充储备并稳定奈拉。总统博拉·蒂努布已修订联邦政府2026年对外借款计划，正寻求参议院批准一笔新的77.07亿美元（10.79万亿奈拉）贷款，用于填补部分预算赤字，取代此前提出的205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元贷款申请。参议院议长戈斯威尔·阿克帕比奥本周三在全会上宣读蒂努布的一封新信时披露了此事，并解释说，新的申请实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。修订后的申请日期为2026年10月26日，请求立法机构授权联邦政府筹集相当于10.79万亿奈拉的对外融资，作为2026年拨款法案资金安排的一部分。总统表示，拟议的对外借款是2026年预算中292万亿奈拉新增借款额度的一部分，旨在填补该国预计高达31.4万亿奈拉的预算赤字。根据修订后的融资安排，联邦政府计划从外部筹集10.79万亿奈拉，其余18.4万亿奈拉则从国内债务市场筹集。蒂努布表示，对外融资将通过多个渠道筹措，包括发行欧洲债券、从多边及双边机构获取优惠贷款和商业贷款、国际货币基金组织（IMF）融资工具以及过桥融资安排。不过，他指出，政府将更加重视发行欧洲债券，因为其处理周期相对较短，且能够以相对较低的成本筹集大量资金。总统说：“我们将同时考虑所有方案，综合考量相关成本及其对国家的好处，以及取得资金所需的时间。鉴于这些因素，我们将重点发行欧洲债券，因为通常完成得更快。此外，通过欧洲债券可以以相对较低的成本筹集巨额资金。”他解释说，拟议融资工具的最终条款和条件将在贷款定价时根据当时的市场状况确定。据他介绍，联邦财政部和债务管理办公室（DMO）将协同合作，确保国家获得最优厚的借款条件。蒂努布表示，拟议资金将用于实施2026年拨款法案所列的项目和计划，尤其是对经济增长和国家发展至关重要的一些关键领域。他列举的优先受益领域包括国防与安全、交通、农业、电力、教育和医疗。总统解释说，借款对于持续推进政府经济改革议程以及巩固过去几年取得的成果至关重要。他说：“新的对外借款对于落实2026年拨款法案中的事项、计划和项目至关重要，这些事项、计划和项目旨在巩固和加强本届政府过去几年实现的宏观经济改革与成果。”蒂努布表示，除履行预算义务外，拟议借款还将增强尼日利亚的外汇储备，并为汇率稳定提供额外支持。他解释说，外币所得将由尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）代表联邦政府接收，从而增加国家外汇储备。他说：“此外还必须强调，这一过程将增加外汇储备，因为资金将由尼日利亚中央银行代表联邦政府接收，从而为奈拉汇率提供支撑。”总统以《2003年债务管理办公室（设立等）法》第21(1)条和第27(1)条为申请依据。这些条款规定，对外借款须经立法机构批准，并授权国民议会批准此类融资工具的条款和条件。他特别请求参议院批准拟议的10.79万亿奈拉借款，按2026年预算中1奈拉兑1美元的汇率计算，相当于77.07亿美元。蒂努布还请求参议院授权财政部长兼经济协调部长与DMO协作，采取必要措施落实借款安排。阿克帕比奥在解释修订后函件的重要性时表示，新的申请实际上取消了他于10月27日代蒂努布宣读的此前方案；该方案请求批准205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的对外借款。他说，最新函件更明确地说明了政府的融资需求，也为从不同国际市场和机构筹集资金提供了更大灵活性。阿克帕比奥说：“我认为，这封函件实际上取消了此前提交的200多亿美元申请。但这封函件明确得多。”参议院议长解释说，修订后的安排确认联邦政府未必会从单一来源取得全部所需资金，而是将寻求不同的融资机会，以获得有竞争力的条件。据他介绍，“这也考虑到借款不会只从一个地方取得。因此，我们必须走出去寻找最佳条件，也就是我们所谓的卖方愿意、买方也愿意的方式。”在介绍总统函件后，阿克帕比奥将申请交由参议院地方债务和对外债务委员会进一步审议。他要求该委员会审查拟议借款安排，并“尽快”向参议院提交报告供其审议。修订后的借款申请出台之际，尼日利亚公共债务负担不断上升、偿债成本持续增加，政府依赖借款履行预算承诺所引发的担忧仍在持续。由于2026年预算安排了规模庞大的新增借款，参议院审议蒂努布申请时，预计不仅会关注拟议融资安排，也会关注国家管理新增对外债务的能力，以及确保借入资金按照政府所述用途部署。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY
