https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Massive US investment offers little protection against shifting trade policies Hyundai Motor Group's massive investment in the United States could leave it with less leverage in future trade negotiations, as Washington's push to revive domestic manufacturing is expected to continue regardless of the outcome of the Tuesday (local time) U.S. midterm elections, a trade expert said in an interview on Wednesday. The automaker is increasingly vulnerable to changes in U.S. tariff and trade policies, particularly with its factories and supply chains fully established there, as political pressure on Korean manufacturers is likely to persist under either Republican or Democratic control of Congress, according to Shin Won-kyu, head of the global economic research team at the Federation of Korean Industries (FKI). "The biggest risk is weakened bargaining power after the investment is made," Shin said in a written interview with The Korea Times. "Plants cannot easily be moved once built, while tariff rates or calculation methods can change with a single proclamation." Hyundai Motor Group is considered one of the hardest hit corporations by the U.S. Donald Trump administration's tariffs, which have been in effect since April last year. Its heavy reliance on exports to the U.S. has left it particularly exposed to the impact of auto tariffs. Identifying the tariff-sparked trade uncertainty as a long-term risk, Hyundai Motor Group has pledged to commit $26 billion (35 trillion won) for investment in the U.S. between 2025 and 2028 with a focus on expanding localized production there. The carmaker is building an extensive U.S. manufacturing network, spanning steel production and finished vehicles. Its planned Louisiana steel mill, scheduled to begin operations in 2029, is part of the group's effort to establish a more localized supply chain. Such investments, however, do not necessarily guarantee favorable trade treatment, Shin said. Instead, Korean companies must demonstrate how their operations contribute to U.S. manufacturing, employment and domestic sourcing to strengthen their position in negotiations with Washington. "Hyundai Motor Group should quantify its contribution to U.S. sourcing and jobs, and make the case to both parties that it is part of American manufacturing," he said. The U.S. midterm elections are unlikely to fundamentally change this policy environment, even if Democrats regain control of the House of Representatives, according to Shin. He said, while the two parties favor different instruments, both support rebuilding U.S. manufacturing capacity in industries considered critical to national and economic security. Republicans have relied more heavily on tariffs to encourage domestic production, while Democrats have favored subsidies and stricter labor and origin requirements. But the underlying objective remains largely the same, Shin said. "The two parties differ in their tools, but there is a bipartisan consensus on reviving U.S. manufacturing, centered on economic security industries," he said. This means Korean companies should not expect a significant reduction in trade pressure simply because congressional power shifts. A Republican victory would likely sustain pressure for tariffs and greater local production, while a Democratic takeover could strengthen congressional oversight without necessarily reversing the administration's trade measures. The trade expert said that even if Democrats gain control of both chambers, their ability to overturn major trade policies would remain limited. For Korean automakers and steelmakers, the distinction between tariff levels and the way tariffs are administered will be particularly important. The 15 percent tariffs on Korean automobiles and 50 percent duties on steel remain significant burdens. Shin said changes in congressional control would be more likely to affect how such measures are implemented than to bring substantial near-term reductions. "Companies should prepare for an environment where tariffs swing less, but the rules become more demanding," Shin said. He pointed to stricter origin requirements and export controls on advanced artificial intelligence chips as areas where bipartisan agreement could sustain regulatory pressure on foreign manufacturers. For Korean steelmakers, Shin recommended emphasizing their role in addressing global overcapacity driven by China, while differentiating their products through high-grade automotive steel and stronger origin-tracking systems. More broadly, he said Korea should use sectors in which Washington also depends on Korean expertise, including shipbuilding, power equipment and batteries, to rebalance bilateral economic relations. Rather than relying solely on tariff negotiations, Seoul should push for a framework based on reciprocal investment and industrial cooperation, he said. At the same time, Korean companies must avoid weakening their domestic industrial foundations through excessive overseas expansion. Shin advocated what he called a "just-in-value" approach, under which research and development, core materials and high-value components remain in Korea, while production facilities requiring direct access to the U.S. market are established locally. He also stressed the need for Washington to facilitate the implementation of existing investment commitments by addressing practical obstacles, including visas for skilled Korean workers and delays in permits. "The Korea-U.S. alliance should be emphasized as a relationship of trust that goes beyond short-term political interests," he said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 现代汽车集团在美国的大规模投资难以有效抵御贸易政策变化。一名贸易专家周三接受采访时表示，无论当地周二举行的美国中期选举结果如何，华盛顿推动重振国内制造业的努力预计都会持续。现代汽车集团在美国投入巨资，这可能使其在未来贸易谈判中拥有的筹码减少。据韩国产业联合会（FKI）全球经济研究团队负责人申元圭介绍，随着其工厂和供应链完全在美国落地，现代汽车集团日益容易受到美国关税和贸易政策变化的影响；无论国会由共和党还是民主党控制，针对韩国制造商的政治压力都可能持续。申元圭在接受《韩国时报》书面采访时说：“最大的风险是投资完成后议价能力被削弱。工厂一旦建成便无法轻易搬迁，而关税税率或计算方式可能仅凭一项公告就发生改变。”自去年4月起实施的美国唐纳德·特朗普政府关税，使现代汽车集团成为受冲击最严重的企业之一。该集团高度依赖对美出口，因此尤其容易受到汽车关税的影响。现代汽车集团将关税引发的贸易不确定性列为长期风险，并承诺在2025年至2028年期间向美国投资260亿美元（35万亿韩元），重点是在当地扩大本地化生产。这家汽车制造商正在美国建设覆盖钢铁生产和整车制造的庞大制造网络。其位于路易斯安那州的钢铁厂计划于2029年投产，是该集团建立更加本地化供应链努力的一部分。然而，申元圭表示，此类投资未必能确保获得有利的贸易待遇。相反，韩国企业必须说明其运营如何为美国制造业、就业和国内采购作出贡献，以增强自身在与华盛顿谈判中的地位。申元圭说：“现代汽车集团应量化其对美国采购和就业的贡献，并向两党说明，它是美国制造业的一部分。”申元圭表示，即使民主党重新控制众议院，美国中期选举也不太可能根本改变这一政策环境。他说，两党虽然偏好的政策工具不同，但都支持重建美国在被视为国家安全和经济安全关键产业中的制造能力。共和党更依赖关税鼓励国内生产，而民主党则倾向于补贴以及更严格的劳工和原产地要求。但申元圭表示，两者背后的目标总体上仍然相同。他说：“两党使用的工具不同，但在重振美国制造业方面存在两党共识，重点是以经济安全产业为核心。”这意味着韩国企业不应指望国会权力归属发生变化，就会显著减轻贸易压力。共和党获胜可能使关税和扩大本地生产的压力持续，而民主党接管国会则可能加强国会监督，但未必推翻政府的贸易措施。这名贸易专家表示，即使民主党拿下两院控制权，推翻重大贸易政策的能力仍将有限。对韩国汽车制造商和钢铁制造商而言，关税水平与关税实施方式之间的区别尤为重要。对韩国汽车征收15%的关税以及对钢铁征收50%的关税，仍是沉重负担。申元圭表示，国会控制权的变化更可能影响这些措施的实施方式，而非在短期内带来大幅下调。申元圭说：“企业应做好关税波动幅度缩小、但规则更加严格的准备。”他指出，更严格的原产地要求以及对先进人工智能芯片的出口管制，可能成为两党达成共识并维持对外国制造商监管压力的领域。对于韩国钢铁制造商，申元圭建议强调其在应对中国引发的全球产能过剩方面的作用，同时通过高品质汽车用钢和更完善的原产地追踪系统实现产品差异化。更广泛地说，他表示，韩国应利用华盛顿同样依赖韩国专业知识的产业，包括造船、电力设备和电池，来重新平衡双边经济关系。他说，首尔不应仅仅依赖关税谈判，而应推动建立以相互投资和产业合作为基础的框架。与此同时，韩国企业必须避免因过度向海外扩张而削弱本国产业根基。申元圭主张采用他所谓的“即时价值”模式，即把研发、核心材料和高价值零部件留在韩国，同时在需要直接进入美国市场的地区设立生产设施。他还强调，华盛顿需要为现有投资承诺的落实提供便利，解决熟练韩国工人签证和许可延误等实际障碍。申元圭说：“应强调韩美同盟，将其塑造成一种超越短期政治利益的信任关系。”

Mr. Ramaswamy, 41, lost to 60-year-old Ms. Acton, who became the first woman to be elected Governor of the state. Ms. Acton bagged over 51% of the votes while Mr. Ramaswamy won over 45%. In concession remarks in Ohio after losing the Governor's race, Mr. Ramaswamy said: "It was a tough race. It was bitter at times in both directions... All of us in this room should be rooting for the success of her administration," C-SPAN quoted him as saying. The billionaire also thanked his parents, his wife and her parents for their support. Mr. Ramaswamy lost despite having top strategists from his and Vice President JD Vance’s political teams advising him, NBC News reported. Mr. Ramaswamy, who made an unsuccessful bid against Trump for the Republican presidential nomination in 2024, pumped more than $36 million in loans from his personal fortune into the race, The Washington Post reported. He also received millions of dollars in donations from fellow billionaires Elon Musk and Jeffrey Yass, NBC News reported. Days ahead of the election, Mr. Ramaswamy drew criticism for the decision to air an ad in which Acton’s mother, Donna Arthur, called her daughter a liar and urged Ohioans not to vote for her, the report said. Ms. Acton said she has not seen or spoken with Arthur in nearly 50 years and has accused her mother’s then-husband of sexually abusing her as a child, it said. Mr. Ramaswamy helped Elon Musk plan President Donald Trump’s Department of Government Efficiency initiative to overhaul the federal government. After quitting the post, Mr. Ramaswamy received an endorsement from Mr. Trump. The President travelled to Ohio to lend his support to Mr. Ramaswamy. 获美国总统唐纳德·特朗普支持的印度裔美国人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米在俄亥俄州州长选举中败给民主党人艾米·阿克顿。41岁的拉马斯瓦米败给了60岁的阿克顿，后者成为该州首位当选州长的女性。阿克顿获得超过51%的选票，拉马斯瓦米则赢得超过45%的选票。

C-SPAN援引拉马斯瓦米的话说，在俄亥俄州败选后，他表示：“这是一场艰难的竞选。双方有时都打得/bitter……在座的每个人都应该支持她的政府取得成功。”这位亿万富翁还感谢了父母、妻子以及岳父母的支持。

报道称，选前几天，拉马斯瓦米因决定播放一则广告而受到批评。广告中，阿克顿的母亲唐娜·阿瑟称女儿是个骗子，并敦促俄亥俄州选民不要投票给她。阿克顿说，她近50年来一直没见过阿瑟，也没有与她交谈，并指控母亲当时的丈夫在她还是孩子时对其实施性侵。

拉马斯瓦米曾帮助埃隆·马斯克规划唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府效率部计划，以彻底改革联邦政府。辞去该职务后，拉马斯瓦米获得了特朗普的背书。特朗普前往俄亥俄州为拉马斯瓦米助阵。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary: US President Donald Trump has identified a range of factors he believes have contributed to Republicans’ losses in Tuesday’s midterm elections. Mr Trump also acknowledged that the Iran war played a role in his party’s midterm losses. “Otherwise I’d just veto everything, and they’re not gonna want that.” Mr Trump’s comments came after the Democratic Party gained control of both houses of Congress.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普列举了他认为导致共和党在周二中期选举中失利的一系列因素。特朗普先生还承认，伊朗战争在其所属政党中期选举失利中发挥了作用。“否则我就会否决一切，而他们不会希望那样。”特朗普发表这些评论之前，民主党已取得国会两院的控制权。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: US President Donald Trump has identified a range of factors he believes have contributed to Republicans’ losses in Tuesday’s midterm elections. During an interview with Fox News on Wednesday, Mr Trump attributed the loss to his absence on the ballot, the Iran war, the coverage given to Democrats by Fox News and the ‘good job’ done by Democrats. “I feel that I wasn’t on the ballot, and there was nothing that could be done about that,” he said. “If I was, we would have won.” He had earlier expressed a similar view about not being on the ballot in an early Wednesday post on Truth Social. “I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP,” he wrote. However, Mr Trump had repeatedly urged his supporters to “pretend I’m on the ballot,” with the results now showing his rally cry prior to the election failed. Mr Trump also acknowledged that the Iran war played a role in his party’s midterm losses. The president said voters were probably unwilling to accept the short-term consequences of petrol and diesel prices, largely caused by the Iran war he started. “I think the Democrats did a good job. I really do. I think they did a good job. They fought hard,” Trump told Fox News on Wednesday morning, adding that there was a “mood in the air” and that “I shouldn’t feel guilty.” He also accused Fox News of giving prominent airtime to Democrats to reach out to Fox audience, who are largely Republicans. He had previously said he would be “Mr Veto” should Democrats win, meaning he would veto any bill passed by Congress that he disagrees with. “I think they’re gonna want to work with me,” he said. “Otherwise I’d just veto everything, and they’re not gonna want that.” Mr Trump’s comments came after the Democratic Party gained control of both houses of Congress. The latest projections put the Democrats as having 53 Senate seats and 226 seats in the House of Representatives. Before the election, Republicans controlled the outgoing 119th Congress, with a 53-seat majority in the Senate. The Democrats had 45 seats, with two independents in their caucus. In the House, the Democrats had won 226 seats to 131 by the Republicans, with many seats yet to be called as of early Wednesday. Democratic candidates won Republican-held seats in North Carolina, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, South Carolina, and Kansas, where the president had personally chosen the nominees or tried to rally voters on their behalf with campaign stops
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 我的政党为何在美国中期选举中失利
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普列出了一系列他认为导致共和党在周二中期选举中失利的因素。周三接受福克斯新闻采访时，特朗普先生将失利归因于自己没有出现在选票上、对伊朗的战争、福克斯新闻对民主党的报道，以及民主党“表现良好”。他说：“我觉得自己不在选票上，这一点无法改变。如果我在，我们就会获胜。”此前，周三早些时候，他在Truth Social发布的一则帖子中也表达了类似看法。他写道：“我没有出现在选票上，但如果我在，我们会以压倒性优势获胜！感谢大家对这件事的关注。唐纳德·J·特朗普总统。”然而，特朗普先生此前曾反复敦促支持者“假装我在选票上”，如今结果显示，他在选举前发出的这一号召未能奏效。特朗普先生还承认，伊朗战争在其所属政党中期选举失利中发挥了作用。总统表示选民可能不愿接受汽油和柴油价格的短期后果，而这些价格在很大程度上是由他发动的伊朗战争造成的。周三上午，特朗普告诉福克斯新闻：“我认为民主党做得很好。确实如此。我认为他们做得很好。他们努力拼杀了。”他还补充说，空气中弥漫着一种“氛围”，而且“我不应该感到内疚”。他还指控福克斯新闻给民主党安排了大量播出时间，让民主党接触以共和党人为主的福克斯观众。他此前曾说，如果民主党获胜，他会成为“否决先生”，意思是他将否决国会通过的任何一项他不赞成的法案。他说：“我认为他们会希望与我合作。否则，我就否决一切，而他们不会希望看到那种情况。”特朗普先生发表这些言论之际，民主党已经赢得国会两院的控制权。最新预测显示，民主党将拥有53个参议院席位和226个众议院席位。选举前，共和党控制着即将卸任的第119届国会，在参议院拥有53席多数。民主党拥有45个席位，另有两名独立人士加入其 caucus。众议院方面，民主党以226席对共和党131席占据优势，截至周三早些时候，许多席位尚未最终确认。民主党候选人在北卡罗来纳州、俄亥俄州、爱荷华州、得克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州和堪萨斯州赢得了共和党守住的席位；在这些州，总统要么亲自挑选了提名人，要么通过竞选行程为其 rallies 争取选民支持

MANILA, Philippines — With over a week to go before world leaders converge in Manila for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian (ASEAN) Summit, the Philippines and China sought to ease bilateral tensions — at least diplomatically — through a call between its foreign ministers. In a statement on Wednesday, November 4, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Foreign Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro and Chinese Foreign Ministers Wang Yi had a “frank, pragmatic, and constructive” phone call to discuss “the state of bilateral ties at length.” Lazaro and Wang last spoke formally in July 2026, on the sidelines of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers meeting. That meeting was preceded by a confrontation in Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal that injured a Filipino soldier. This time, the phone call is backdropped by what’s arguably the tensest time in bilateral relations yet. Chinese Ambassador to Manila Jing Quan started a maelstrom after he said the Philippines should be “fortunate” that China does not use force in its disputes with the Philippines. Lazaro summoned Jing after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr . said the remarks were a “threat.” But the maelstrom raged on after that meeting. Philippine officials and the Chinese embassy in Manila, which Jing heads, continued exchanging tirades on social media and in media interviews. At the ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) Plus, China sent only its Manila-based defense attache, who was then not received personally by China-sanctioned Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. Beijing accused Teodoro of supposedly getting in the way of their participation in the highest defense diplomacy engagement within ASEAN. Teodoro himself had told the media on October 23 that the invitation to China — issued by Defense Undersecretary Ignacio Madriaga — had just been sent out. The meetings, hosted in Cebu, started on October 28. Manila will be hosting the 49th ASEAN Summit — the biggest of all events under its chairmanship — from November 16 to 18. Marcos had signaled early on in 2026 — as Manila took on ASEAN chairmanship — that he wanted a “reset” in ties with China. “The Philippines remains committed to a stable, predictable, mutually respectful, and mutually beneficial relationship with China, in accordance with the national interest and in pursuit of an independent foreign policy as enshrined in the Philippine Constitution,” the DFA said on Wednesday. Marcos’ desire for a reset past the midway point of his presidency made sense especially with the ASEAN chairmanship. The bloc’s goal, set by its foreign ministers in 2023, was to finish South China Sea code of conduct (COC) talks by 2026. The Philippines, under Marcos, started pushing back stronger against China’s encroachments in the South China Sea. It also expanded its defense network and deepened existing ties with traditional partners — moves that, at times, ruffled China’s feathers. Delimitation talks with Japan in waters north of the Philippines are believed to have, among other things, spurred Beijing’s new claims over Batanes and the waters of the Philippine province. The President had hoped for President Xi Jinping to visit Manila , if the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea had concluded. Xi typically does not participate in the ASEAN Summit and Related Summits. The DFA said that according to Wang, China is “anticipating” Marcos’ participation in the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen. “Both ministers assured each other that their respective leaders would be accorded the proper courtesies and assistance during these meetings,” said the DFA. The COC is not expected to conclude by the ASEAN Summit in Manila. According to the Xinhua report, Wang claimed that “China-Philippines relations are facing malicious interference at present” and that “a few Philippine politicians, out of political prejudice and self-interest, have repeatedly attacked and smeared China,” a barely-veiled allusion to Teodoro. “Such deeds are irrational and intolerable, and damaging to the Philippines’ own international image, Wang said, adding that Manila should exercise greater restraint over the individuals concerned and ensure that its policy toward China reflects a rational and unified voice,” said Xinhua in its report. The DFA press release, titled “DFA Statement on Stable and Predictable Philippines-China Relations,” focused on assurances that Manila wants to calm ties with Beijing. “The discussion also covered other matters of concern, including maritime issues, but focused on returning the relationship to an even keel and on upholding the 1975 Joint Communiqué, which remains the enduring basis of Philippines-China cooperation and of the Philippines’ One China Policy,” said the DFA. Yet as attempts at a reset commenced, confrontations in the West Philippine Sea, an area that includes the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone, continued to happen. China’s political pressure also stepped up, with the sanction of Teodoro and his family over his statements against Beijing. The Chinese embassy in Manila continued with strong, sometimes inflammatory statements on its social media accounts against Philippine officials, including nationally-elected legislators. – Rappler.com Upgrade to Rappler+ for exclusive content and unlimited access

Theresa Lazaro与中国外长Wang Yi进行了“坦诚、务实和建设性”的电话交谈，“详细讨论了双边关系的状况”。Lazaro与Wang上一次正式通话是在2026年7月东盟外长会议期间。那次会议之前，阿永金（Second Thomas）浅滩发生冲突，造成一名菲律宾士兵受伤。此次通话正值双边关系可以说最为紧张的时候。中国驻马尼拉大使Jing Quan曾引发一场风波，称菲律宾应当感到“幸运”，因为中国在与菲律宾的争端中没有使用武力。Lazaro召见了Jing，此前总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.称这番言论是一种“威胁”。但在那次会面之后，风波仍未平息。菲律宾官员与由中国驻马尼拉大使Jing负责的中国大使馆继续在社交媒体和媒体采访中相互激烈指责。在东盟国防部长会议（ADMM）Plus上，中国只派出了驻马尼拉的防务随员，而此人当时并未受到遭中国制裁的国防部长Gilberto Teodoro Jr.亲自接见。北京指责Teodoro妨碍中国参加东盟最高级别的国防外交活动。Teodoro本人10月23日曾对媒体表示，交给中国的邀请——由国防部副部长Ignacio Madriaga发出——刚刚送达。10月28日，系列会议在宿务开始。马尼拉将于11月16日至18日主办第49届东盟峰会，这将是菲律宾担任东盟轮值主席国期间举办的最大规模活动。2026年初，随着马尼拉出任东盟轮值主席国，Marcos便表示希望同中国的关系实现“重启”。菲律宾外交部星期三表示：“根据菲律宾宪法所规定的国家利益，菲律宾致力于同中国建立稳定、可预测、相互尊重和互利的稳定关系，并以此追求独立外交政策。”在马尼拉担任东盟轮值主席国期间，推动菲律宾在马尼拉任期过半后重启对华关系显得尤其合理。该组织的外长于2023年设定的目标，是到2026年完成南海行为准则（COC）谈判。在Marcos领导下，菲律宾开始更强有力地反对中国在南海的侵犯行为。菲律宾还扩大了防务网络，并加深与传统伙伴的既有联系——这些举措有时会触怒中国。据信，菲律宾与日本就菲律宾北部水域举行的划界谈判，除其他事项外，还促使北京对巴丹群岛及菲律宾该省周边水域提出新的主张。总统原本希望，如果《南海行为准则》能够完成谈判，习近平主席将访问马尼拉。习近平通常不出席东盟峰会及相关峰会。菲律宾外交部表示，据Wang介绍，中国“期待”Marcos参加在深圳举行的第33届亚太经合组织（APEC）经济领导人会议。菲律宾外交部称：“两位部长相互保证，双方领导人将在这些会议期间获得应有的礼遇和协助。”预计《南海行为准则》不会在马尼拉东盟峰会前完成。据新华社报道，Wang声称，“目前中菲关系正受到恶意干扰”，“少数菲律宾政客出于政治偏见和私利，一再攻击和污蔑中国”，这几乎是在影射Teodoro。新华社在报道中称，Wang说：“这种行为是不理性、不可容忍的，也会损害菲律宾自身的国际形象。马尼拉应当对有关人员施加更多克制，并确保其对华政策体现理性、统一的声音。”菲律宾外交部题为“菲律宾外交部关于稳定和可预测的菲中关系的声明”的新闻稿，重点强调马尼拉希望缓和与北京的关系。菲律宾外交部表示：“此次讨论还涉及其他值得关注的事项，包括海洋问题，但重点是使双边关系重回平稳正轨，并维护1975年联合公报；该公报仍是菲律宾与中国合作以及菲律宾奉行一个中国政策的持久基础。”然而，就在双方开始尝试重启关系之际，西菲律宾海仍不断发生对抗事件；该海域包括菲律宾专属经济区。中国施加的政治压力也在加大，Teodoro及其家人因其反北京言论而遭到制裁。中国驻马尼拉大使馆继续在其社交媒体账号上针对菲律宾官员发表强硬、有时颇具煽动性的声明，包括攻击经全国选举产生的议员。——Rappler.com 升级至Rappler+，即可获取独家内容和无限访问权限

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/1092.body: Democratic gains in Tuesday's US midterm elections could bring tougher congressional scrutiny of US President Donald Trump's trade and industrial policies, adding uncertainty for South Korean companies investing billions of dollars in American manufacturing. According to US media outlets, Democrats had secured control of the Senate and were closing in on a House majority as of press time in Seoul on Wednesday, with several races still undecided as vote counting continued. The emerging results pointed to stronger congressional checks on the Trump administration, potentially complicating tariffs, subsidies and major investment projects. For South Korea, the biggest concern is not necessarily a reversal of its trade and investment commitments to Washington, but possible delays and changes in how projects are implemented. Experts say the two countries' investment agreement is likely to remain intact, given bipartisan support for rebuilding US manufacturing and reducing reliance on China. But projects requiring congressional funding, new legislation or environmental approvals could face greater scrutiny. "The Trump administration has governed through executive orders," said Shin Won-kyu, head of the Global Economic Research team at the Korea Economic Research Institute. "The Republican majority Congress simply followed." A stronger Democratic presence could challenge that approach, although Trump's executive powers and presidential veto would limit Congress' ability to reverse existing policies. "Democrats are not against reviving US manufacturing," Shin said. "But Congress will check the methods, such as whether a project harms the environment or raises energy costs." South Korea's $350 billion investment pledge to the US includes $200 billion for strategic industries and $150 billion for shipbuilding cooperation. The shipbuilding package covers corporate investment, guarantees and ship financing, rather than direct government spending alone. Experts expect the overall framework to survive changes in congressional control. "The US does not overturn existing policy when power changes hands, as long as it does not harm national interests," said Hwang Yong-sik, a business professor at Sejong University. "The current structure for US investment is likely to be maintained." Still, individual projects could face different political pressures. One is the Alaska LNG project, which would transport natural gas from northern Alaska to an export terminal on the state's southern coast. Trump has urged South Korea to participate, but Seoul has maintained that any investment must be commercially viable. Stronger Democratic opposition to fossil fuel development on environmental grounds could complicate the project, potentially giving Seoul more time to assess its economic feasibility. Under the Make American Shipbuilding Great Again, or MASGA, initiative, South Korea and the US are seeking to expand cooperation in shipyard investment, vessel construction and maritime technology. But the House's 2027 defense bill, passed in July, includes a provision restricting the use of defense funds for foreign-built warships. The measure, led by Democratic Rep. Jared Golden, could complicate plans to allow companies investing in US shipyards to build the first two vessels of each type overseas. "A Democratic win could make it harder to build US warships in Korean shipyards," said Koo Ki-bo, a professor at Soongsil University. Even so, broader shipbuilding cooperation is expected to continue, as both parties view rebuilding US maritime capabilities and countering China's dominance as strategic priorities. Tariffs may be another source of friction. Many of Trump's trade measures rely on Sections 232 and 301 of US trade law, which give the executive branch broad authority to impose tariffs on national security and unfair trade grounds. Democrats could intensify scrutiny of how those powers are used, particularly their impact on consumer prices and US businesses, but reversing the measures would be difficult without sufficient votes to overcome a presidential veto. Shin said pressure to exempt smaller US businesses from certain tariffs could also benefit Korean exporters. The election's implications extend to major Korean investments already underway in the US. Samsung Electronics has committed more than $37 billion to its Texas semiconductor operations, while SK hynix is developing a chip packaging facility in Indiana worth more than $4 billion. Hyundai Motor Group has pledged $26 billion in US investment through 2028, LG Energy Solution is building a $5.5 billion battery complex in Arizona, and Hanwha is pursuing a $5 billion expansion of its Philly Shipyard operations. For these multiyear projects, relationships with Congress and state governments are becoming increasingly important, particularly when companies need permits, tax incentives or government procurement contracts. Battery and solar manufacturers may benefit if Democrats resist further cuts to clean-energy incentives. Restoring benefits already withdrawn, however, would require new legislation. For semiconductor companies, a key question is whether Congress will extend the construction-start deadline for semiconductor investment tax credits beyond 2026. Senate Finance Committee leaders from both parties support an extension, but passage remains uncertain. Existing grants under the CHIPS Act are more closely tied to previously negotiated funding agreements. Bipartisan efforts to reduce US dependence on China could also benefit Korean companies supplying American manufacturers, although restrictions on Chinese materials may increase production costs. The growing US artificial intelligence industry presents another challenge for Korean technology companies. Trump's December 2025 executive order sought to override certain state-level AI regulations, but left much of the approval process for data center infrastructure under state and local authority. Democrats could push for stronger federal oversight of data centers amid concerns about rising electricity prices, while local opposition could slow construction and permitting. Such delays could affect Korean semiconductor makers by slowing the expansion of AI infrastructure and demand for advanced chips, Shin warned. For Korean companies, experts say the best response is to emphasize the benefits their investments bring to the US economy, regardless of which party controls Congress. "They should highlight that these are products made in America for Americans. That is something both parties want," Shin said. He also urged Korean companies to secure skilled-worker visas and necessary state-level permits to prevent political and regulatory delays from disrupting their US operations. https://www.koreaherald.com/article/1092.body_zh: 民主党在美国周二的国会中期选举中取得进展，可能使国会对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的贸易和产业政策实施更严格的审查，从而给在 美国制造业投资数十亿美元的韩国企业增添不确定性。据美国媒体报道，截至首尔时间周三发稿时，民主党已确保控制参议院，并正逼近众议院多数席位；随着选票统计仍在继续，多场竞选尚未决出。初步结果显示，国会加强对特朗普政府的制约力度有所增强，复杂化关税、补贴和大型投资项目的情况可能随之出现。对韩国而言，最大的担忧未必是韩国对华盛顿作出的贸易和投资承诺发生逆转，而是项目实施方式可能延迟并发生变化。专家表示，鉴于两党均支持重建美国制造业并降低对中国依赖，两国投资协议很可能继续有效。不过，需要国会拨款、新立法或环境审批的项目可能面临更严格审查。韩国经济研究院全球经济研究团队负责人申元奎说：“特朗普政府一直通过行政命令施政。”“共和党占多数的国会只是照做。”民主党在国会中占据更大影响力，可能挑战这种做法，但特朗普的行政权和总统否决权将限制国会推翻现行政策的能力。申说：“民主党并不反对重振美国制造业。”“但国会会审查具体做法，例如某个项目是否损害环境或推高能源成本。”韩国向美国作出的3500亿美元投资承诺，包括向战略产业投资2000亿美元，以及在造船合作方面投入1500亿美元。造船合作方案涵盖企业投资、担保和船舶融资，并非仅指政府直接支出。专家预计，尽管国会控制权发生变化，整体框架仍将得以保留。世宗大学商学教授黄永植说：“只要不损害国家利益，美国不会因权力更迭而推翻现行政策。”“目前美国投资的基本结构很可能维持不变。”尽管如此，各具体项目可能面临不同的政治压力。其中之一是阿拉斯加液化天然气项目，该项目将把阿拉斯加州北部的天然气输送到该州南岸的出口码头。特朗普已敦促韩国参与，但首尔坚持任何投资都必须具有商业可行性。民主党基于环保理由更强烈反对开发化石燃料，可能使该项目复杂化，并让首尔有更多时间评估其经济可行性。根据“让美国造船业再次伟大”倡议，韩国和美国正寻求扩大在船厂投资、船舶建造和海事技术方面的合作。不过，众议院于7月通过的2027年国防法案包含一项条款，限制将国防资金用于外国建造的军舰。这项由民主党众议员贾里德·戈尔登主导的措施，可能使允许投资美国船厂的企业在海外建造每种舰艇前两艘的计划复杂化。成均馆大学教授具基宝说：“民主党获胜可能使在韩国船厂建造美国军舰更加困难。”即便如此，预计更广泛的造船合作仍将继续，因为两党都把重建美国海上能力和制衡中国主导地位视为战略重点。关税可能是另一摩擦来源。特朗普的许多贸易措施依据美国贸易法第232条和第301条，这些条款赋予行政部门以国家安全和不公平贸易为由征收关税的广泛权力。民主党可能加强对这些权力使用方式的审查，尤其是其对消费者价格和美国企业的影响；但如果没有足够票数克服总统否决权，推翻这些措施将十分困难。申表示，要求让美国较小企业免受某些关税约束的压力，也可能有利于韩国出口商。此次选举的影响还延伸至韩国正在美国推进的重大投资。三星电子已承诺向其得克萨斯州半导体业务投入超过370亿美元，SK海力士则正在印第安纳州建设一座价值超过40亿美元的芯片封装设施。韩国现代汽车集团承诺到2028年在美国投资260亿美元，LG新能源解决方案正在亚利桑那州建设一座价值55亿美元的电池综合体，韩华则正推进对其费城造船厂业务扩张50亿美元的计划。对于这些多年期项目而言，与国会和州政府的关系正变得愈发重要，尤其是在企业需要许可证、税收优惠或政府采购合同时。如果民主党抵制进一步削减清洁能源激励措施，电池和太阳能制造商可能从中受益。然而，要恢复已经取消的优惠，仍需制定新法律。对半导体企业而言，一个关键问题是，国会是否会把半导体投资税收抵免的动工期限延长至2026年以后。参议院财政委员会两党领导人支持延长该期限，但能否通过仍不确定。《芯片法案》下现有的补助则与此前谈妥的资助协议联系更为紧密。两党为减少美国对中国依赖而作出的努力，也可能让向美国制造商供货的韩国企业受益，尽管针对中国材料的限制可能推高生产成本。美国日益壮大的人工智能产业给韩国科技企业带来另一项挑战。特朗普于2025年12月发布的行政命令试图推翻部分州级人工智能监管规定，但数据中心基础设施审批流程的大部分仍由州和地方主管部门负责。民主党可能在担忧电价上涨的情况下，推动加强联邦政府对数据中心的监督，而地方反对力量可能拖慢建设和审批。申警告称，此类延迟可能因人工智能基础设施扩张和先进芯片需求放缓而影响韩国半导体制造商。专家表示，无论哪个党派控制国会，对韩国企业而言，最佳应对办法都是强调其投资为美国经济带来的益处。申说：“它们应突出强调，这些产品是在美国为美国人制造的。这是两党都希望看到的。”他还敦促韩国企业取得技术工人签证和必要的州级许可，避免政治和监管延误扰乱其在美国的业务。韩国肉毒素热潮引发技术限制之争

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has warned Sokoto State Governor Ahmed Aliyu that it will hold him responsible for any violence against its members as the party prepares to launch its presidential campaign in the state on Wednesday. The warning came on Tuesday, a day after the state government sealed an ADC campaign office along Ahmadu Bello Way in Sokoto, citing a property ownership dispute and security concerns. In a statement signed by its National Publicity Secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, the ADC accused the state government of political intimidation and demanded an end to interference with its activities. “The Sokoto State Government must understand that governing a State does not confer ownership,” the statement said. The party warned that public officials who obstruct lawful political activities should be prepared to face legal consequences. Commissioner for Lands and Housing Nasiru Dantsoho said government records showed that the sealed property belonged to Savannah Bank, with no documented transfer of ownership. He said the government had written to the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC) for clarification and would keep the premises sealed until it responds. Mr Dantsoho also cited a disturbance involving political supporters near the property as a reason for the closure. Aminu Abdullahi, spokesperson for ADC governorship candidate Manir Dan’iya, alleged that the government demanded ₦30 million for a venue for the campaign launch. He said the party agreed to the amount but was not provided with payment details. PREMIUM TIMES has not independently confirmed the alleged demand or obtained a government response. The office closure followed an alleged attack on Mr Dan’iya’s convoy near Sokoto airport on 30 October. The governorship candidate accused personnel linked to state security outfits of obstructing his convoy and damaging his vehicle. The All Progressives Congress (APC) disputed allegations of politically motivated violence, while police said they were investigating the incident. Separately on Tuesday, Atiku Abubakar accused the State Security Service of recruiting protesters to disrupt Wednesday’s campaign launch. He alleged that the protesters were being mobilised to create disorder that could justify a curfew and stop the event. PREMIUM TIMES has not independently established the allegation. The SSS had not responded to earlier enquiries at the time of that report. The ADC said it would proceed with the launch despite the dispute. “Let there be no misunderstanding. The ADC will campaign in Sokoto State. We will not be intimidated, obstructed or pushed out of any part of Nigeria,” the party said. It urged its supporters to remain peaceful and called on security agencies to protect the rights of all political parties
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: ADC 警告索科托州州长，反对派遭遇暴力袭击
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）警告索科托州州长艾哈迈德·阿里尤，表示该党准备于周三在该州启动总统竞选活动，任何针对其成员的暴力行为都将由他负责。警告发布于周二。就在此前一天，该州政府以产权纠纷和安全隐患为由，封闭了位于索科托市Ahmadu Bello Way的ADC竞选办公室。该党全国公共事务书记博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希签署声明，指责州政府进行政治恐吓，并要求停止干预该党的活动。声明称：“索科托州政府必须明白，治理一个州并不意味着拥有该州。”该党警告称，阻碍合法政治活动的公职人员应做好承担法律后果的准备。土地与住房专员纳西鲁·丹措霍表示，政府记录显示，被封存的物业属于Savannah Bank，且没有所有权转让的书面记录。他说，政府已致函尼日利亚存款保险公司（NDIC）要求澄清，并将在对方作出回应前继续封闭该场所。丹措霍还提到，该物业附近曾发生涉及政治支持者的骚乱，这是关闭办公室的原因之一。ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·丹亚的发言人阿米努·阿卜杜拉希指称，政府就竞选启动活动所需的场地索要₦3000万。他说，该党同意了这个金额，但没有获得付款详情。PREMIUM TIMES尚未独立核实这项索要指控，也未获得政府的回应。办公室被封之前，10月30日据称曾有人在索科托机场附近袭击丹亚先生的车队。这名州长候选人指控，与州安全机构有关联的人员阻挠其车队，并损坏他的车辆。全进步大会党（APC）否认了有关出于政治动机的暴力行为的指控，警方则表示正在调查此事。同样在周二，阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔指控州安全局招募抗议者，企图扰乱周三的竞选启动活动。他称，有人正在动员抗议者制造混乱，以便为实施宵禁和阻止活动提供理由。PREMIUM TIMES尚未独立证实这项指控。截至报道发布时，SSS尚未回应此前的询问。ADC表示，尽管存在争议，仍将推进启动活动。该党说：“不要有任何误解。ADC将在索科托州开展竞选。我们不会受到恐吓、阻挠，也不会被赶出尼日利亚的任何地区。”该党敦促支持者保持和平，并呼吁安全机构保护所有政党的权利

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/four.body: Four Nigerian-Americans have won elective positions in the November 3 midterm elections in the United States, while the outcome of another candidate, Segun Adeyina, remained pending in Georgia as votes were being counted. The winners are Will Jawando, Junior Ezeonu, Oye Owolewa and Carol Kazeem, who secured positions in local government and state legislatures across Maryland, Texas, Washington, DC, and Pennsylvania. In Maryland, Jawando, the Democratic candidate, won the race for Montgomery County executive, defeating Republican candidate Esther Wells. Results published by NBC Washington on Wednesday showed Jawando polling 237,383 votes, representing 78.15 per cent, against Wells’s 66,383 votes, or 21.85 per cent, with 72 per cent of the expected votes counted. Jawando, who previously served on the Montgomery County Council, is the son of a Nigerian father and an American mother. His Nigerian heritage and political career have featured in reports by The Baltimore Banner and The Washington Post. In Texas, 27-year-old Ezeonu secured a seat in the state House of Representatives for District 101. He had defeated incumbent Chris Turner in the Democratic primary and was the only candidate on the ballot for the November general election after no Republican entered the race. According to his campaign biography, Ezeonu was born in Onitsha, Anambra State, and moved to Texas at the age of two. He was elected to the Grand Prairie City Council in 2021 and later became the city’s youngest mayor pro tempore. In Washington, DC, Owolewa, the Democratic candidate, won an at-large seat on the District of Columbia Council. Local publication, The 51st, reported that Owolewa secured 69 per cent of the vote, against 21 per cent recorded by independent candidate Elissa Silverman. Owolewa, a pharmacist and son of Nigerian immigrants from Kwara and Osun states, previously served as the District’s elected shadow representative. The position allows its holder to advocate for Washington, DC, statehood but does not confer voting rights in the US Congress. Meanwhile, Kazeem, also a Democrat, retained her seat in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, representing District 159. The result of Adeyina’s contest in Georgia had yet to be called as of Wednesday, with votes still being counted. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/four.title_zh: 四名尼日利亚裔美国人赢得美国中期选举
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/four.body_zh: 4名尼日利亚裔美国人在美国11月3日中期选举中赢得了民选职位；另一名候选人Segun Adeyina在佐治亚州的选举结果仍未公布，当时选票仍在统计。获胜者是Will Jawando、Junior Ezeonu、Oye Owolewa和Carol Kazeem，他们分别在马里兰州、得克萨斯州、华盛顿哥伦比亚特区和宾夕法尼亚州的地方政府及州议会中取得职位。在马里兰州，民主党候选人Jawando击败共和党候选人Esther Wells，赢得蒙哥马利县行政长官竞选。NBC Washington于周三公布的结果显示，Jawando获得237,383票，占78.15%；Wells获得66,383票，占21.85%；预计选票已有72%完成统计。Jawando此前曾任蒙哥马利县议会议员，他的父亲是尼日利亚人，母亲是美国人。他的尼日利亚血统和政治经历曾被《The Baltimore Banner》和《The Washington Post》报道。在得克萨斯州，27岁的Ezeonu在第101选区赢得州众议院席位。他曾在民主党初选中击败现任议员Chris Turner；由于没有共和党人参选，他成为11月普选选票上唯一的候选人。据其竞选履历，Ezeonu出生于阿南布拉州奥尼察，两岁时移居得克萨斯州。他于2021年当选大草原市议会议员，后来成为该市最年轻的代理市长。在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，民主党候选人Owolewa赢得了哥伦比亚特区议会的全市席位。当地出版物《The 51st》报道，Owolewa获得69%的选票，独立候选人Elissa Silverman获得21%的选票。Owolewa是一名药剂师，父母是来自夸拉州和奥孙州的尼日利亚移民；此前曾担任该区的民选影子代表。该职位允许任职者倡导华盛顿哥伦比亚特区成为州，但不赋予其在国会投票的权利。与此同时，同为民主党人的Kazeem保住了她在宾夕法尼亚州众议院代表第159选区的席位。截至周三，佐治亚州Adeyina竞选的结果尚未公布，选票仍在统计。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri will pay a two-day visit to Kathmandu on November 4 and 5, the Ministry of External Affairs announced on Monday (November 2, 2026). This will be the first visit by Mr. Misri to Nepal since Prime Minister Balendra Shah took charge in March this year following the election that was conducted under an interim government. A visit to India by Mr. Shah is understandably part of the agenda that will be discussed when Mr. Misri meets officials in Kathmandu. “Foreign Secretary’s upcoming visit continues the tradition of regular high-level exchanges between the two countries and will help further enhance the comprehensive bilateral partnership,” said the Ministry in an announcement. The visit by Mr. Misri to Kathmandu will be keenly watched as it comes amid a slew of reforms that Nepal’s post-Gen-Z uprising government is in the process of rolling out. Apart from Mr. Shah’s visit to India, Mr. Misri’s conversations in Kathmandu are likely to feature the appointment of a new Ambassador of Nepal to New Delhi. Nepali Embassy has been without an Ambassador for several months since the previous Ambassador, Shankar Prasad Sharma, returned home. Nepali diplomatic sources told The Hindu earlier that Kathmandu was waiting for the agrément (diplomatic approval) for new envoy Nischal Nath Pandey to take charge in the embassy here. India’s continued assistance to the disaster in Bhote Koshi river is also expected to be on the agenda. Even as Mr. Misri's visit was being announced by the Ministry, a welfare association of former Indian Army soldiers took out a protest in Kathmandu on Monday (November 2) demanding that Gurkha recruitment into the Indian Army be resumed. Recruitment of Gurkha soldiers remains suspended since the Agnipath scheme was introduced by the Government of India. The Hindu had earlier reported that Mr. Misri was expected to visit Nepal in May, but the visit was postponed ostensibly because Mr. Shah had prioritised domestic challenges. The India visit by Mr. Shah, if it materialises, will be the first bilateral visit abroad by the leader who came into prominence during the September 2025 Gen-Z uprising that overthrew the government of Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli. Mr. Misri had visited Kathmandu previously for two days in August 2025 and had met Mr. Oli. In the past few months, India has hosted Nepal’s Foreign Minister Sisir Khanal, Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle, and Home Minister Sudan Gurung, who visited Delhi to participate in the first BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) meet held on October 13, 2026. India has also hosted the head of the ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) Rabi Lamichhane in the first week of June when he met Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Mr. Lamichhane paid a personal visit to India last week to pray at the pilgrimage centres in Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand and the Kamakhya temple in Guwahati. Mr. Lamichhane had described this visit as “personal and not political”. “There are no political meetings planned. Since this is a personal visit, I urge people not to read politics into it,” said Mr. Lamichhane before starting the visit. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 印度外交部长兼常秘vikram Misri将于11月4日至5日对加德满都进行为期两天的访问。印度外交部于11月2日（星期一）宣布了这一消息。这将是Misri先生自总理Balendra Shah今年3月在临时政府主持的选举后就任以来首次访问尼泊尔。

可以理解，Misri先生在加德满都会见官员时，Shah先生访印将是讨论议程的一部分。印度外交部在公告中表示：“外交部长即将进行的访问延续了两国定期开展高层互动的传统，将有助于进一步提升两国全面双边伙伴关系。”

Misri先生此次访问加德满都将受到密切关注，因为尼泊尔“Gen-Z”起义后的政府正在推行一系列改革。除了Shah先生访印外，Misri先生在加德满都的会谈预计将涉及任命尼泊尔新任驻新德里大使。自上一任大使Shankar Prasad Sharma回国后，尼泊尔大使馆已数月没有大使。尼泊尔外交消息人士此前告诉《The Hindu》，加德满都正在等待新任特使Nischal Nath Pandey获准（外交批准）赴任这里。印度继续援助Bhote Koshi河流灾后重建，预计也将列入议程。

在印度外交部宣布Misri先生访尼行程之际，一名前印度陆军士兵福利协会于11月2日（星期一）在加德满都举行抗议，要求恢复为印度陆军招募廓尔喀士兵。自印度政府推出Agnipath计划以来，廓尔喀士兵招募一直处于暂停状态。

《The Hindu》此前报道称，Misri先生原定于5月访问尼泊尔，但此次访问表面上是因Shah先生优先处理国内挑战而推迟。

如果Shah先生访印成行，这将是这位领导人在2025年9月推翻总理K.P. Sharma Oli政府的“Gen-Z”起义中崭露头角后首次出访外国进行双边访问。Misri先生此前曾于2025年8月访问加德满都两天，并会见了Oli先生。

过去几个月，印度接待了尼泊尔外长Sisir Khanal、财政部长Swarnim Wagle和内政部长Sudan Gurung，他们赴德里参加了10月13日举行的首届BIMSTEC（孟加拉湾多部门技术经济合作倡议）会议。

印度还在6月第一周接待了执政的Rastriya Swatantra Party（RSP）领导人Rabi Lamichhane，期间他会见了总理Narendra Modi。Lamichhane先生上周还对印度进行私人访问，前往北阿坎德邦Kainchi Dham的朝圣中心和古瓦哈提的Kamakhya寺祈祷。Lamichhane先生将此次访问描述为“私人访问，并非政治访问”。

Lamichhane先生在出发前表示：“目前没有安排任何政治会谈。由于这是一次私人访问，我呼吁人们不要对此作政治解读。”

Unlock these with Subscription Weeks before the expiry of the Ganga Water Treaty in December, the Ministry of External Affairs on Tuesday (November 3, 2026) reiterated that India and Bangladesh have a “structured mechanism” to deal with the treaty’s requirements. Addressing the bi-weekly media briefing, MEA official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal reiterated that India has invited Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit New Delhi but that there is neither any “update” on the treaty’s renewal nor on the dates for the trip. Also read | Ganga Water Treaty is ‘flawed’, needs to be updated: Bangladesh river expert “Between India and Bangladesh, we have a Joint Rivers Commission which is the structured mechanism for discussion on all cross-boundary rivers, including the Ganga,” said Mr. Jaiswal, adding that India wishes to have a “positive relationship” with Bangladesh. The bilateral Ganga Water Treaty is set to expire on December 12. The treaty was signed in 1996 between India and Bangladesh when Sheikh Hasina of Awami League became Bangladesh’s Prime Minister for the first time. The three-decade old agreement for river water sharing requires expert-level and political consultations for renewing the pact. It is understood that since the treaty was signed at the level of Prime Ministers (Ms. Hasina and then Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda), a renewal of the agreement would happen at a meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. However, Mr. Rahman who has visited China, Japan, Malaysia and the United States so far, has not yet responded to the invites from India though he was invited to both bilateral and multilateral events during the BRICS Summit in New Delhi in September. “As far as India-Bangladesh relationship is concerned we want to work towards a positive, forward looking and constructive relation,” said Mr. Jaiswal reiterating India’s invites to Prime Minister Rahman. Diplomatic sources from the Bangladeshi side had informed earlier that they are expecting an automatic short-term renewal of the treaty after the expiry on December 12, though the Indian officials have not indicated at that till now. Mr. Jaiswal also took note of the protests by the readymade garment industry workers in Bangladesh who have been hitting the streets demanding fair wages as the country faces high inflation and electricity crisis. “Yes, we have been following the situation in Bangladesh. There have been developments there and we will continue to follow the developments,” he said in response to a question on the protests by the workers in the garments sector. Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said. Good corporate earnings and the attractive valuations in large-caps is providing the fundamental support to the rally, he said adding that weakening of the AI trade also has facilitated the return of the FIIs. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body: Layer 1 The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has vowed to proceed with its scheduled campaign in Sokoto State despite what it described as attempts by the state government to intimidate the opposition and obstruct its political activities. The party also warned that Governor Ahmed Aliyu would be held responsible if any violence was directed at opposition members or supporters in the state. The ADC National Publicity Secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, stated this in a statement issued on Tuesday, accusing the Sokoto State Government of undermining democratic rights and deliberately frustrating the party’s activities ahead of the 2027 general elections. Abdullahi said the party would not be deterred by the alleged intimidation, insisting that no governor had the authority to prevent any political party from campaigning or presenting its candidates to voters. “The Sokoto State Government must understand that governing a state does not confer ownership. Public office is a temporary mandate from the people, not a licence to suppress political competition,” the statement read. The ADC spokesperson called on the state government to immediately stop what he described as efforts to frustrate its lawful political activities and guarantee a level playing field for all political parties. He also reminded security agencies and other public institutions that their responsibility was to the Constitution and the Nigerian people, rather than the political interests of the ruling party. Abdullahi warned that public officials who abused their authority to obstruct lawful political activities would face the legal consequences of their actions. “Let there be no misunderstanding. The ADC will campaign in Sokoto State. We will not be intimidated, obstructed or pushed out of any part of Nigeria simply because those in power are afraid of political competition,” he said. He maintained that democratic participation was a constitutional right and not a privilege to be granted by elected public officials. The ADC spokesperson further accused the ruling party of displaying intolerance towards opposition activities, challenging it to submit itself to an open contest if it believed it had performed well in government. “If the ruling party believes it has served the people well, it should have nothing to fear from an open contest,” he said. “Intimidation cannot manufacture public support, and obstruction cannot take away the people’s right to choose their leaders. The people of Sokoto, like all Nigerians, deserve the opportunity to listen to competing ideas and make their own decisions.” He urged party members, supporters and residents of Sokoto State to remain peaceful and law-abiding, while assuring that the ADC would continue to defend its right to campaign freely across the country. “The future of Sokoto belongs to the people of Sokoto, not to any governor or political party. No government has the right to veto democracy,” Abdullahi added. The development follows the sealing of the ADC’s campaign office in Sokoto over an alleged ownership dispute. The state’s Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Nasiru Dantsoho, had announced the sealing of the building on Monday, saying the action followed a recent clash involving supporters of different political parties. The ADC had earlier accused the state government of using the police to intimidate opposition politicians and demanded the immediate reopening of the premises. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body_zh: 第一层 非洲民主大会（ADC）誓言，尽管该州政府被指试图恐吓反对派并妨碍其政治活动，但该党仍将在索科托州按计划开展竞选活动。该党还警告称，如果该州针对反对派成员或支持者实施任何暴力行为，州长艾哈迈德·阿里尤都将承担责任。ADC全国宣传秘书博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希周二发表声明，控指控索科托州政府破坏民主权利，并蓄意阻挠该党在2027年大选前的活动。阿卜杜拉希表示，该党不会被所谓恐吓吓倒，坚持认为任何州长都无权阻止任何政党开展竞选活动或向选民提出候选人。声明称：“索科托州政府必须明白，治理一个州并不意味着拥有该州。公职是人民授予的临时使命，而不是压制政治竞争的许可证。”ADC发言人呼吁州政府立即停止其所谓妨碍该党合法政治活动的行为，并确保为所有政党提供公平竞争的环境。他还提醒安全机构和其他公共机构，其责任是对宪法和尼日利亚人民负责，而非迎合执政党的政治利益。阿卜杜拉希警告，任何滥用职权、妨碍合法政治活动的公职人员都将承担其行为产生的法律后果。他说：“不要产生误解。ADC将在索科托州开展竞选。我们不会因为执政者害怕政治竞争而受到恐吓、阻挠或被赶出尼日利亚的任何地区。”他坚持认为，参与民主是宪法赋予的权利，而非民选公职人员可以授予的特权。ADC发言人进一步指控执政党对反对派活动表现出不宽容，并要求该党在公开竞争中接受检验，以证明自己相信自己治理有方。他说：“如果执政党认为自己很好地服务了人民，它就无须害怕公开竞争。恐吓无法制造公众支持，阻挠也无法剥夺人民选择领导人的权利。索科托人民和所有尼日利亚人一样，应有机会听取不同理念，并自行作出决定。”他敦促该党党员、支持者和索科托州居民保持和平并遵守法律，同时保证ADC将继续捍卫其在全国各地自由开展竞选的权利。阿卜杜拉希补充道：“索科托的未来属于索科托人民，而不属于任何州长或政党。没有任何政府有权否决民主。”这一事态发展发生在ADC位于索科托的竞选办公室因所谓产权纠纷被查封之后。该州土地与住房专员纳西鲁·丹措霍周一宣布查封该建筑，称此举是针对近期不同政党支持者发生冲突后采取的措施。ADC此前指控州政府利用警察恐吓反对派政治人物，并要求立即重新开放该场所。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

Unlock these with Subscription The rupee strengthened by 14 paise to 94.61 against the U.S. dollar in early trade on Wednesday (November 4, 2026), supported by receding crude oil prices, a weaker U.S. dollar and inflows of foreign funds. Buying momentum in the domestic equities market also favoured the Indian currency even as investors awaited the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections, according to forex traders. In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.61 and went up to 94.50 before paring some gains to trade at 94.61 against the greenback, up 14 paise from its previous session's closing level. The Indian currency rose 9 paise to close at 94.75 against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday (November 3, 2026). Meanwhile, the dollar index, which gauges the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was trading at 101.17, lower by 0.54%. Also, U.S. Treasury yields declined amid expectations of a favourable outcome for the Democratic Party in the midterm elections. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading lower by 0.49% at $103.09 per barrel in futures trade even as geopolitical uncertainties continued. On the domestic equity market front, Sensex surged 435.10 points or 0.57% to 77,352.95 in early trade, while Nifty climbed 115.90 points or 0.49% to 23,925.10. Both the indices ended over 1.5 per cent higher in the preceding session. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net buyers for the third consecutive day on Tuesday and purchased equities worth Rs 6,836.81 crore, according to exchange data. 订阅可享受《高端故事》《社论》《观点》等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。民主党人翻转了美国首个参议院席位。在早期中期选举结果中，民主党人取得优势，推动其争夺国会控制权，这将是对唐纳德·特朗普总统的一次尖锐否定。据媒体预测，广受关注的民主党籍前州长罗伊·库珀在北卡罗来纳州击败了特朗普总统亲自挑选的参议员候选人，而冉冉升起的民主党新星乔恩·奥索夫在佐治亚州赢得参议院连任选举。美国中期选举的投票于周二（2026年11月3日）开始，首先开放投票的是佛蒙特州以及纽约州、新泽西州、弗吉尼亚州和肯塔基州等其他东海岸州。此次投票将决定唐纳德·特朗普总统在剩余任期内拥有多大权力。众议院全部435个席位、参议院100个席位中的35个，以及36个州的州长职位均将改选，约有2.1亿人登记投票。媒体预测显示，民主党将从共和党手中夺取美国众议院控制权。这一剧变意味着特朗普总统任期后半段将面临对抗。民主党周二在美国中期选举中连获早期胜利，翻转一个共和党控制的参议院席位，并在保守派控制的众议院选区取得进展；与此同时，特朗普总统面临选举惨败的可能。随着特朗普遭遇严重挫折，民主党在美国中期选举中扩大优势，佐治亚州州长选举也重塑政治格局。据媒体报道，民主党人丽贝卡·贝内特击败新泽西州联邦众议员汤姆·基恩，翻转一个共和党控制的席位。基恩先生是新泽西州国会代表团中最脆弱的共和党人。他在2022年翻转了一个民主党控制的席位，但在选举年有数月时间未公开露面，直到今年夏天才披露自己与抑郁症抗争的消息。尽管民主党取得早期胜利并给特朗普总统造成打击，白宫内部气氛仍“坚定不屈”。一名白宫官员告诉法新社：“白宫的气氛是坚定不屈的。”该官员在要求匿名的情况下说，无论结果如何，特朗普先生都将阻止“激进左翼”掌权，并警告说：“大家做好准备。”印度裔美国人皮娅·丹迪亚在佛罗里达州第22选区赢得美国众议院选举，击败海军陆战队退伍军人凯西·阿斯卡。据公布的结果，曾任高中校长的丹迪亚女士获得51.9%的选票，成为最新的印度裔美国国会议员。她的对手阿斯卡先生获得49.1%的选票。皮娅·丹迪亚以51.9%的得票率胜选，成为来自佛罗里达州的首位第一代印度裔美国国会议员，并赢得佛罗里达州第22选区。媒体预测显示，民主党人、前亚特兰大市市长基沙·兰斯·博托姆斯当选佐治亚州州长，成为美国首位当选该职位的黑人女性。博托姆斯击败了以共和党人身份参选的医疗保健行业亿万富翁里克·杰克逊。现任州长布赖恩·肯普受到任期限制，无法再次参选。曾担任巴拉克·奥巴马总统顾问的苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆再次当选美国众议员。苏布拉马尼亚姆先生现年40岁，在弗吉尼亚州第10选区以超过61.5%的得票率击败共和党人戴夫·贝克威思；贝克威思获得36.4%的选票。他出生于休斯敦，父母是印度人，在新奥尔良杜兰大学就读期间接受服务意识教育，并帮助组织志愿者重建受卡特里娜飓风影响的社区。苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆在弗吉尼亚州第10选区赢得连任，成为美国众议员。这位民主党人苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆在弗吉尼亚州第10选区赢得连任，其两党服务经历以及在奥巴马政府时期担任政策职务的经历受到关注。随着食品和能源价格上涨成为竞选议题，而特朗普总统的认可率下降，罗伊·库珀这位知名的前两届任期州长击败了特朗普总统亲自挑选的候选人。美国中期选举：民主党人罗伊·库珀翻转北卡罗来纳州共和党控制的参议院席位。在食品和能源成本高昂引发争论、特朗普时代紧张局势持续的背景下，民主党人罗伊·库珀赢得北卡罗来纳州参议员选举， flipping了一个共和党席位。据媒体预测，民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯赢得新罕布什尔州空缺的美国参议院席位，击败共和党人约翰·苏努努，并在该党争夺参议院控制权之际保住了这一关键民主党席位。帕帕斯先生的胜利使共和党无法在这个寒冷地区州夺取席位；特朗普总统与伊朗的战争期间，高昂能源价格成为当地的主要议题。他将接替任期届满退休的民主党人珍妮·沙欣。39岁的乔恩·奥索夫曾说，自己对竞选总统“毫无兴趣”，但他在佐治亚州的胜利增强了他在民主党内的地位；距离下次总统选举还有两年。美国选民参加了影响最深远的美国中期选举。早期调查曾预测，这次选举将否定唐纳德·特朗普总统的执政，并显示社会情绪正在发生变化。超过2.1亿美国人有资格参加此次选举。投票于周二（2026年11月3日）美国东部时间上午6:00开始，涉及美国众议院435个席位、美国参议院37个席位、36个州州长职位以及大量地方公共职位。印第安纳州和肯塔基州的投票于周二美国东部时间下午6:00（周三印度时间凌晨4:30）结束，而美国不同时区的其他投票站将错峰开放，持续至午夜过后。美国中期选举的首批投票站已经关闭。民主党希望确保国会控制权，而特朗普总统的未来议程也悬而未决。印第安纳州和肯塔基州部分地区率先于下午6:00（格林尼治标准时间2300）关闭投票站。中期选举将决定众议院全部435个席位、参议院三分之一席位以及大量州和地方职位。华尔街股市多数收高；随着油价继续回落，市场等待美国中期选举结果，这次选举可能重塑唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的最后两年。原油价格周一因美伊和平前景重现讨论而大幅下跌；数小时后，特朗普坚持称与德黑兰达成协议“可能实现”，油价小幅下挫。交易员还援引未经证实的西亚媒体报道，称伊朗在核计划和冻结资金方面取得进展。能源成本有望缓解，这帮助华尔街在连续数个交易日的下跌后企稳，尤其是科技股占比较高的纳斯达克指数，在连续三日下跌后迎来上涨。琳达·琼斯在佐治亚州亚特兰大一处投票站附近架起折叠椅，警惕任何可能阻碍人们在美国中期选举中投票的因素。这位七旬老人首次担任选举观察员。他说：“我想帮助人们应对投票；投票过程变得越来越复杂。”他和另外两名志愿者将密切关注这处设在公共图书馆内的投票站周边活动，并报告任何问题。她说：“在如今这个国家的情况下，存在错误信息，也有人采取行动阻止部分人投票，包括人口中的某些群体。”美国中期选举投票开放前数小时，联邦法官连续作出裁决，限制特朗普政府以前所未有的力度向州选举官员施压，要求其处理所谓非公民投票问题。过去数月，特朗普总统的共和党同僚准备捍卫其在国会两院的多数席位，政府则加大了打击非公民投票的力度。特朗普的盟友称这是一个重大问题，尽管证据显示这种情况极其罕见。这项行动屡次在法院遭到抵制。联邦法官认定，特朗普政府介入选举管理超出了权限。美国宪法将选举管理职责赋予各州。政府生成的所谓非公民登记投票者名单并不准确，可能导致归化美国公民失去投票权。周二，纽约州一场竞争激烈的众议院选举中，投票机发生故障。右翼网络影响者随即抛出毫无根据的美国中期选举舞弊指控，地方选举官员则坚称所有选票都会得到统计。唐纳德·特朗普总统及其盟友此前多次传播未经证实的投票机说法，声称投票机存在故障或不可靠。Westchester县选举委员会表示，已知悉一项涉及纸质选票的问题，该问题导致全县投票站的投票机无法接收选票。委员会在声明中表示，选票将改放进应急袋，并“希望让每一位选民放心：您的选票很重要，选票将得到妥善保管，您的投票将被统计”。投票日当天，唐纳德·特朗普突然宣布，美国从明年起将停止向以色列提供40亿美元援助。民主党人罗·卡纳将此形容为阻挡“蓝色海啸”的绝望努力。选举前夕，美国对伊朗霍尔木兹海峡的Qesham岛发动有限规模的打击。官员表示，此举是对伊朗向美国飞机开火的回应。美国摇滚传奇人物、坚定民主党人布鲁斯·斯普林斯廷周二敦促选举官员抵制政府干预投票，因为外界担忧唐纳德·特朗普政府可能介入中期选举。77岁的斯普林斯廷在Instagram发布的视频中说：“我是在选举日对选举官员和政府代表讲话。你们已经宣誓维护、保护和捍卫我们的宪法。这意味着你们肩负着确保我们的选票得到安全统计的庄严职责。”他说：“你们作为我们的代表，绝不能同意任何破坏我们享有自由公正选举这一宪法权利的指令。”身穿棕色法兰绒衬衫的斯普林斯廷补充道：“我们的选票就是我们的声音，你们有责任确保我们的声音被听见。”周二，欧洲基准股指下跌。市场对西亚可能达成和平协议的疑虑令投资者在美国中期选举前保持谨慎，同时也在评估一系列企业财报。泛欧洲STOXX 600指数收低0.58%，报645.66点，铜价走弱导致矿业股领跌。一名伊朗高级官员告诉路透社，伊朗与美国距离达成结束战争的协议仍很远。夜间，美国对其所称的伊朗Qeshm岛实施了“防御性打击”。负责美国选举事务的州官员已为唐纳德·特朗普政府可能干预周二中期选举做好准备。他们担心联邦当局可能扰乱投票、质疑选票统计结果，或试图阻止对其不利的结果。特朗普先生的共和党人正艰难争取维持国会控制权。他多次质疑美国选举的完整性，并敦促本党至少在15个地方将投票“全国化”。白宫表示，政府正在维护选举安全，人们担忧的许多情形仍属假设。美国宪法没有赋予总统直接管理选举的角色，法院迄今也已驳回政府的主要法律挑战。三名NASA宇航员周二在距地球400多公里轨道上运行的国际空间站参加美国中期选举投票，其中包括Anil Menon先生。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: A senior North Korean ruling party official has arrived in China, the North's state media confirmed Wednesday, a visit that underscores deepening cooperation between Pyongyang and Beijing. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜国家媒体周三证实，朝鲜执政党一名高级官员已抵达中国，此访凸显平壤与北京之间日益加深合作。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，朝鲜劳动党政治局委员、党中央书记Kim Song-nam于周二率党代表团开启访华行程。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A senior North Korean ruling party official has arrived in China, the North's state media confirmed Wednesday, a visit that underscores deepening cooperation between Pyongyang and Beijing. Kim Song-nam, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and a party secretary, embarked on a trip to China on Tuesday, leading a party delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). His visit came at the invitation of China's Communist Party's Central Committee. The delegation's arrival came just 10 days after North Korean leader Kim Jong-un made a surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong — an indication that the two countries are stepping up efforts to reinforce high-level exchanges and traditional ties. North Korea and China have been deepening their cooperation after bilateral relations had chilled amid Pyongyang's closer ties with Russia over the Ukraine war. Upon arrival at a Chinese airport, Kim and his delegation were greeted by Deputy Head Sun Haiyan and other officials of the International Liaison Department of the Chinese party and North Korean Ambassador to China Ri Ryong-nam, the KCNA said. In a separate dispatch, the KCNA reported that Xie Chuntao, executive vice president of the Party School of the Chinese party's central committee, and his delegation arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Xie's delegation met Ju Chang-il, a party secretary of the North, and visited the Central Cadres Training School

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但出于自身利益，目前并无必要；与此同时再次强调，美方指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang. Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the remarks, saying the continued "hostile signal" by Washington was compelling the regime to reconsider the "true nature" of the U.S. "The choice for peace includes dialogue of course, but this is not surely equated with national interests for us," Kim said in a statement carried by the North's official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). The remarks came a day after she rejected the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's (FBI) findings that the regime was behind the theft of more than US$6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. She earlier called the accusation a "grave political provocation" against the North. "The so-called 'cryptocurrency hacking case by the DPRK' is no more than a tip of iceberg that shows the essence of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK," Kim reiterated Wednesday, referring to the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Kim pointed to a recent trilateral meeting between the top diplomats of South Korea, the U.S. and Japan, where they reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea, along with various joint military drills, as other examples of U.S. hostility. "The U.S. abandonment of its hostile policy" toward Pyongyang "is a major premise and key to solving all problems," she said, adding that North Korea has no reason to engage in talks with the U.S. unless that happens. "It is our clear stand that we have no need to sit face to face with such unreliable and hostile persons who refuse to abandon their policy of confrontation," she said. She further warned that Pyongyang would respond to what it views as continued U.S. hostility. "In the present reality when new records are being set in the implementation of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, it is natural that new records should be created in our reflective counteraction." She did not specify what counteractions Pyongyang would take
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜称，与美国对话是选项，但国家利益并非必须选择对话
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国进行对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但这对朝鲜自身利益而言并无必要；朝鲜再次强调，美国指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。朝鲜领导人金正恩权势强大的妹妹金与正发表上述言论。她说，华盛顿持续发出“敌对信号”，迫使该政权重新审视美国政策的“真正本质”。金与正在朝鲜官方朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）播发的声明中说：“实现和平的选择当然包括对话，但这肯定不等同于我们的国家利益。”此前一天，她否认了美国联邦调查局（FBI）认定该政权策划从全球最大加密货币交易平台币安窃取超过60亿美元加密货币的结论。她早些时候称，这项指控是对朝鲜的“严重政治挑衅”。周三，金与正再次表示，所谓“朝鲜加密货币黑客案件”不过是冰山一角，揭示了美国对朝鲜敌对政策的实质。她以朝鲜正式国名朝鲜民主主义人民共和国指代朝鲜。金与正指出，韩国、美国和日本三国外交部长最近举行了三边会议，会上重申推动朝鲜半岛完全无核化的承诺，并举行各种联合军事演习；这些也是美国敌意的其他例证。她说，美国放弃对平壤的“敌对政策”是解决所有问题的重要前提和关键；除非这种情况发生，否则朝鲜没有理由与美国谈判。她说：“我们立场鲜明，无需与那些拒绝放弃对抗政策、既不可靠又充满敌意的人坐下来谈判。”她还警告，平壤将回应其所认定的美国持续敌意。她说：“在落实美国对朝鲜敌对政策不断刷新纪录的当下，我们作出反思性反制并刷新纪录也是理所当然的。”她没有说明平壤将采取何种反制措施

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准SK海力士在中国扩大生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，令这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划面临变数。两名人士表示，SK海力士旗下Solidigm部门计划投资约$45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座NAND工厂，投资额未来可能增至约$100 billion。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. SK Hynix is seeking U.S. export licenses to equip its Dalian plant, arguing that increased production there would help fund its planned U.S. expansion. But the Commerce Department has yet to approve the new licenses, the people said. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time. NAND is memory that retains data even when power is turned off and is used for storage in data centers. The negotiations raise questions about how far the Trump administration is willing to bend national security guardrails established to keep U.S. technology from aiding China's military, in order to bring foreign investment and chipmaking onshore. "Ultimately, none of this is going to go forward without a green light from the White House," said Leland Miller, a member of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, a bipartisan panel created by the U.S. Congress. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Negotiations are continuing, the people said, with approval for the Dalian expansion central to SK Hynix's plans in New York. Executives from SK Hynix's U.S. subsidiary, Solidigm, have met nearly 10 times with officials from the Commerce Department since late August, one of the people said. The company needs to ramp up production and develop more sophisticated NAND chipmaking in China to generate revenue to build a U.S. facility and to stay competitive, the people said. In a meeting last week, Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler held to his position that the U.S. would not allow more American chipmaking tools to upgrade or expand capacity, the person said, though the department has not formally denied a license to export American equipment to fill empty clean space in Dalian. The two sides are also negotiating a separate license for 2027 for equipment to keep up the Dalian facility, the person said. A spokesperson for the Department of Commerce did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a statement last week, Solidigm said: "As a U.S.-founded and headquartered company, Solidigm regularly evaluates strategic alternatives to best serve its customers and enhance its long-term competitiveness. The company is currently exploring options for building a NAND memory fab at potential locations around the world. No decision regarding any specific course of action has been made." Solidigm stuck to its statement from last week. SK Hynix did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside business hours
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 消息人士称，SK海力士的纽约芯片计划因美国对华限制而受阻
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准 SK Hynix 扩大在华生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，使这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划复杂化。SK Hynix 正寻求美国出口许可，为其大连工厂配备设备，并主张增加当地产量将有助于为其计划中的美国扩张提供资金。不过，知情人士表示，美国商务部尚未批准这些新许可。两名知情人士称，其旗下 Solidigm 部门计划投资约 $45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座 NAND 工厂，日后投资额可能达到约 $100 billion。NAND 是一种即使断电也能保留数据的存储器，用于数据中心的数据存储。相关谈判引出了一个问题：特朗普政府究竟愿意在多大程度上突破为防止美国技术协助中国军事而设立的国家安全底线，从而吸引外国投资并将芯片制造转移到美国。美国国会设立的两党联合机构美中经济与安全审查委员会成员 Leland Miller 表示：“归根结底，没有白宫点头，这一切都不会推进。”白宫没有立即回应置评请求。知情人士表示，谈判仍在继续，大连扩产能否获批是 SK Hynix 纽约计划的关键。知情人士之一称，自 8 月底以来，SK Hynix 美国子公司 Solidigm 的高管已与商务部官员会面近 10 次。知情人士表示，公司需要提高产量并在中国开发更先进的 NAND 芯片制造技术，以创造收入建设美国设施并维持竞争力。该人士称，在上周的一次会议上，商务部副部长 Jeffrey Kessler 坚持原有立场，即美国不会允许更多美国芯片制造工具用于升级或扩大产能，尽管商务部尚未正式拒绝向大连出口美国设备的许可，以为当地尚未启用的洁净生产空间补充设备。该人士称，双方还在谈判一项单独的 2027 年许可，用于维持大连工厂运营的设备。商务部发言人也未立即回应置评请求。Solidigm 上周在一份声明中表示：“Solidigm 是一家在美国创立并设于美国总部的公司，经常评估各种战略方案，以更好地服务客户并增强其长期竞争力。公司目前正在探索于全球各地潜在地点建设 NAND 存储芯片晶圆厂的方案。公司尚未就任何具体行动方案作出决定。”Solidigm 上周重申了这份声明。非营业时间外，SK Hynix 未立即回应置评请求

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea's Hanwha Group has appointed a new president of its Philadelphia shipyard in the United States, as the conglomerate seeks to expand its U.S. naval shipbuilding operations, according to the company. Kim Hyuk has been named president of Hanwha Philly Shipyard, effective Monday, succeeding David Kim, who helped oversee Hanwha's acquisition of the facility in 2024 and a near doubling of its workforce since then, the shipyard said in a press release. The new president brings more than 25 years of experience in commercial and naval shipbuilding, including senior positions at Hanwha Ocean Co. and its predecessor, Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering. The appointment comes as Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA), a subsidiary of South Korean defense giant Hanwha Aerospace Co., takes majority ownership of the Philadelphia shipyard as part of efforts to transform the facility into a dual-use shipyard capable of building both commercial and military vessels. Kim will report directly to Tom Anderson, president of U.S. shipbuilding at HDUSA, who oversees the company's shipbuilding operations in the United States. "By building on the strong foundation established in the months since Hanwha acquired the yard, we will focus on strengthening operational excellence, expanding shipbuilding capacity, and developing the workforce needed to support both commercial and naval programs," Kim said. Recently, HDUSA was selected by U.S. maritime services firm Tote Services to build one medium landing ship at Hanwha Philly Shipyard, with options to construct three additional vessels

https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.title: Voter Register Scandal: Ezekwesili Demands Independent Probe, Says INEC Cannot Investigate Itself
https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.summary: In an open memorandum dated November 3, 2026, in Abuja, Ezekwesili demanded the establishment of a Citizens’ Electoral Rescue Team to take over the clean-up of the voter register ahead of the 2027 general elections. She called on the National Assembly to enact a law under what she described as a “Doctrine of Necessity” to empower the proposed team to independently investigate the allegations, clean up the voter register and oversee citizens’ observation and verification of the 2027 elections.
https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.summary_zh: 在一份日期为2026年11月3日、于阿布贾发布的公开备忘录中，Ezekwesili 要求成立“公民选举救援团队”，在2027年大选前接管选民登记册的清理工作。她呼吁国民议会根据她所称的“必要性原则”制定法律，赋予拟议团队独立调查相关指控、清理选民登记册以及监督公民对2027年选举进行观察和核验的权力。
https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.body: In an open memorandum dated November 3, 2026, in Abuja, Ezekwesili demanded the establishment of a Citizens’ Electoral Rescue Team to take over the clean-up of the voter register ahead of the 2027 general elections. She called on the National Assembly to enact a law under what she described as a “Doctrine of Necessity” to empower the proposed team to independently investigate the allegations, clean up the voter register and oversee citizens’ observation and verification of the 2027 elections. Ezekwesili said the allegations had raised serious concerns about the credibility of the electoral process and INEC’s ability to guarantee credible elections. She cited statements allegedly made by INEC’s Director of Information and Communication Technology, Dr Lawrence Bayode, during television appearances on October 30 and November 1. According to Ezekwesili, Bayode disclosed that registration officers had used their official credentials to introduce AI-generated photographs, duplicate records and fabricated entries across several states. She argued that the allegations required an independent investigation, warning that an inquiry conducted by the electoral commission itself would not inspire public confidence. “The question of whether Nigeria can conduct a credible 2027 election is already answered. Nigeria cannot conduct a credible 2027 election under the leadership of INEC,” she said. Ezekwesili said public trust in the commission had fallen sharply, warning that failure to address the allegations could undermine the 2027 elections before voting begins. She proposed that the Citizens’ Electoral Rescue Team should conduct an independent forensic audit of the voter register, identify and remove fraudulent entries, investigate possible wrongdoing and ensure that Nigerians have access to relevant electoral information. She also called for the public disclosure of officers implicated in the alleged manipulation and urged that anyone found responsible should be held accountable following a credible investigation. The proposed team, she said, should include independent forensic, cybersecurity and biometric experts, civil society organisations, the Nigerian Bar Association, relevant professional bodies, academics, religious and traditional leaders, political party observers and international election observers. Under her proposal, political parties would be allowed to observe the process but would have no control over the team’s activities. Serving and former INEC officials, public office holders, candidates and party officials would be excluded from membership to protect its independence. Ezekwesili described the voter register as the foundation of a credible election, warning that any manipulation could compromise the entire process before ballots were cast. “The register of voters is the first ballot. If it is rigged, every ballot that follows is rigged before it is cast,” she said. She also called on civil society organisations, professional bodies and other stakeholders to support the proposal, saying urgent action was needed to restore public confidence in the electoral process. Ezekwesili said the team should operate transparently, make relevant election information available to Nigerians and report directly to the public. She urged stakeholders to act while evidence relating to the allegations remained available. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.title_zh: 选民登记簿丑闻：埃泽克韦西利要求独立调查，称独立国家选举委员会不能调查自身
https://leadership.ng/voter-register-sca.body_zh: 在一份日期为2026年11月3日、于阿布贾发布的公开备忘录中，Ezekwesili要求成立一个公民选举救援小组，在2027年大选前接管选民登记册的清理工作。她呼吁国民议会依据她所称的“必要性原则”制定法律，授权拟议小组独立调查相关指控、清理选民登记册，并监督公民对2027年选举的观察与核验。Ezekwesili表示，这些指控已引发对选举进程可信度以及独立国家选举委员会（INEC）能否确保可信选举的严重关切。她援引了据称由INEC信息与通信技术主任Dr Lawrence Bayode于10月30日和11月1日电视露面时发表的言论。Ezekwesili称，Bayode透露，登记官员曾利用公职身份，在多个州引入人工智能生成的照片、重复记录和捏造的登记信息。她认为，这些指控需要独立调查，并警告由选举委员会自行开展的调查无法赢得公众信心。她说：“尼日利亚能否举行可信的2027年选举，这一问题已经有了答案。在独立国家选举委员会（INEC）的领导下，尼日利亚无法举行可信的2027年选举。”Ezekwesili表示，公众对选举委员会的信任已大幅下降，警告若不处理这些指控，可能在投票开始前就损害2027年选举。她提议，由公民选举救援小组对选民登记册进行独立的法证审计，识别并删除欺诈登记，调查可能的违法行为，并确保尼日利亚民众能够获取相关选举信息。她还要求公开与涉嫌操纵行为有关的工作人员名单，并敦促任何被发现负有责任的人都应在可信调查后被追究责任。她说，拟议小组应包括独立的法证、网络安全和生物识别专家、公民社会组织、尼日利亚律师协会相关专业机构、学者、宗教和传统领袖、政党观察员以及国际选举观察员。根据她的提案，政党可以观察相关程序，但无权控制小组的活动。现任和前任独立国家选举委员会（INEC）官员、公职人员、候选人和政党官员均不得加入，以维护小组的独立性。Ezekwesili称选民登记册是可信选举的基础，警告任何操纵行为都可能在选票投出前破坏整个选举进程。她说：“选民登记册就是第一张选票。如果它被操纵，接下来的每一张选票在投出之前就已经被操纵了。”她还呼吁公民社会组织、专业机构和其他利益相关方支持该提案，表示必须采取紧急行动，以恢复公众对选举进程的信心。Ezekwesili表示，该小组应透明运作，向尼日利亚民众提供相关选举信息，并直接向公众报告。她敦促各方在有关指控的证据仍可获取时采取行动。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候更新 →

https://leadership.ng/us-midterms-7-thin.summary: More than 57 million Americans had already cast their ballots as of Monday, according to the University of Florida Election Lab, exceeding the 46 million votes recorded during early voting in the 2022 midterm elections. Here are seven key things to know as Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections.
https://leadership.ng/us-midterms-7-thin.summary_zh: 据佛罗里达大学选举实验室统计，截至周一，已有超过5700万美国人完成投票，超过2022年中期选举提前投票阶段记录的4600万张选票。以下是在美国参加2026年中期选举投票时需要了解的七件关键事项。
https://leadership.ng/us-midterms-7-thin.body: The elections, held halfway through a four-year presidential term, will determine the composition of the US House of Representatives and Senate, as well as the governors of 36 states. Although President Donald Trump is not on the ballot, the elections are expected to serve as a major test of his administration’s performance and the Republican Party’s grip on power, with Republicans currently controlling both chambers of Congress. More than 57 million Americans had already cast their ballots as of Monday, according to the University of Florida Election Lab, exceeding the 46 million votes recorded during early voting in the 2022 midterm elections. The 2026 elections are also projected to be the most expensive in American history, with the nonpartisan campaign finance watchdog OpenSecrets estimating that candidates and outside political groups will spend about $11.9 billion. Billionaire businessman Elon Musk alone had reportedly spent approximately $366 million supporting Republican candidates as of three weeks ago, according to campaign finance records. Here are seven key things to know as Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections. One of the major issues in the 2026 US midterm elections is whether Democrats can secure majority control of Congress from Republicans. Republicans currently hold a 218-214 majority in the House of Representatives, with two vacant seats and an independent member who caucuses with the Republicans. To take control of the House, Democrats must secure a net gain of four seats. The battle is also intense in the Senate, where Republicans hold a 53-47 majority. Democrats need a net gain of four seats to take control of the upper chamber. About 12 Senate races, including contests in traditionally conservative states such as Kansas and Texas, could determine which party controls the chamber. A change in congressional leadership could significantly affect Trump’s legislative agenda and the direction of US domestic policy. Although Trump is not contesting any position in the midterm elections, the outcome could have significant consequences for his administration. Historically, midterm elections have often proved challenging for the political party occupying the White House, with voters using the polls to assess the president’s performance and express dissatisfaction with government policies. The outcome could force Trump to reconsider aspects of his administration’s policies, particularly if Republicans lose seats in Congress. A Democratic victory could also make it more difficult for the president to push through his legislative priorities, as opposition lawmakers would have greater influence over congressional proceedings. The results could also provide early indications of voter sentiment ahead of the 2028 presidential election, with potential presidential aspirants expected to study the outcome for insights into campaign strategies and voter preferences. Opinion polls suggest that Trump and the Republican Party are facing challenges ahead of the elections. Economic concerns, particularly rising consumer prices and the cost of living, are expected to influence voters’ decisions in several competitive races. Democrats also appear to have an enthusiasm advantage, with more supporters reportedly expressing interest in voting and a higher number of their voters already participating in early voting, according to the University of Florida Election Lab. Meanwhile, there are indications that some Latino voters who supported Trump in the 2024 presidential election may be reconsidering their political allegiance. Frustration over economic conditions and aspects of the administration’s immigration enforcement policies could push some of these voters back towards the Democratic Party. However, a major Democratic victory is not guaranteed. Republicans could benefit from their campaign spending advantage, continued scepticism among some voters towards the Democratic Party and concerns among moderate voters over the victories of left-wing candidates in Democratic primaries. Previous US midterm elections offer an indication of how dramatically the political balance of power can change halfway through a presidential administration. In the 2010 midterm elections, Republicans recorded significant victories during the presidency of Democrat Barack Obama. The party gained 63 seats in the House of Representatives, ending the Democrats’ majority, amid economic difficulties and opposition to Obama’s healthcare reform legislation. Democrats, however, retained control of the Senate despite losing six seats. Reacting to the Republican victories, Obama described the outcome as a “shellacking.” In 2018, Democrats returned the favour during Trump’s first presidency, gaining a net 40 seats in the House of Representatives and taking control of the chamber. Republicans, however, maintained their Senate majority after Democrats lost a net two seats. Beyond Congress, the 2026 elections will also determine governorships in 36 states and involve contests for seats in state legislative chambers across almost the entire country. According to Ballotpedia, Republicans currently control approximately 55 per cent of state legislative seats nationwide, while Democrats hold 43.8 per cent. The outcome of the House elections will determine which party controls the powerful office of Speaker of the House. If Democrats win control of the chamber, Democratic Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York is widely expected to emerge as a leading contender for the position. Jeffries, who currently serves as House Democratic leader, would become the first Black American to occupy the powerful office if elected Speaker. The position would give him considerable influence over legislative proceedings, congressional committees and investigations into the activities of the Trump administration. He has also outlined the party’s legislative priorities, including efforts to make healthcare, groceries, housing, energy and other essential expenses more affordable. A Republican victory would keep the speakership within the party, potentially retaining current Speaker Mike Johnson or producing another Republican candidate if he faces a challenge. Several closely contested congressional races are attracting national attention as both parties fight for control of Congress. Among the notable House contests is Republican Representative Mike Lawler’s re-election bid in a New York district won by Democratic presidential candidate Kamala Harris during the 2024 election. Another closely watched contest is an open House seat in a competitive Nebraska district, where concerns over rising fuel prices are expected to feature prominently in the campaign. The economic pressure on farmers and truckers, particularly following the impact of the US war against Iran on fuel costs, could influence voters in the district. Democrats are also targeting two Republican-held House seats in Pennsylvania and another in New Jersey as part of their efforts to secure a congressional majority. The outcomes of these contests could prove decisive in determining the balance of power in the House of Representatives. Questions surrounding the integrity of the US electoral process are also emerging as a major issue during the midterm elections. Trump has repeatedly claimed, without evidence, that widespread cheating occurred during previous US elections, particularly the 2020 presidential election, which he lost to Joe Biden. His repeated allegations have raised concerns about the possibility of attempts by his administration to interfere with the electoral process. US elections are primarily administered by individual states, with election officials responsible for organising and overseeing voting. State election authorities and Democratic lawmakers have reportedly been preparing for possible legal challenges should the Trump administration attempt to intervene in the conduct of the elections. The issue is expected to remain a major point of political contention as Americans cast their ballots. We’ve got the edge.
