https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Nine Korean picture books have been selected for the 2026 Korea Picture Book Award, with the government pledging export support to help winning authors reach readers worldwide. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said Tuesday that nine works were chosen from 506 entries for the fourth annual awards, established in 2023 to promote the development of Korean picture books and expand their presence in overseas markets. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 2 p.m. Tuesday at Ferrum Tower in central Seoul. The two grand prizes went to Jeon Mi-hwa's "To the Fish in the Sea, to the Birds in the Sky, to the Animals in the Forest, and to Humans" in fiction and Kim Ji-won's "Raising Earthworms" in nonfiction. Each grand prize winner will receive 15 million won ($10,350) and the Culture Minister's Award. Baek's work and the book by Kim Bok-hee and Lee Myung-ae will each receive 10 million won, while the other four will each receive 7 million won. Yeo Seo-yoon received the newcomer award for "I Have a Song I Want to Sing for You," along with a 7 million won prize. The nine publishers behind the winning books will also receive 3 million won each. The ministry said winners will receive sample translations, promotional support, reviews and opportunities to showcase their books at major international events, including the Bologna Children's Book Fair. "Picture books are publishing content that combines writing, illustrations and design to deliver emotion and imagination to a wide range of readers, from children to adults," said Choi Seong-hee, the ministry's director general for content industry policy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】比亚迪海狮6 DM-i在静谧性和续航方面表现出色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.summary: Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction.

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction. Also read | Defence pacts with India being amended, says Maldives Mr. Shahid, who is running for the leadership of the opposition Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP) ahead of the Presidential elections in 2028, alleged that Mr. Muizzu, who has had a cordial relationship with New Delhi for most of his tenure, would revive the “India Out” campaign of 2023. “The President [Mr. Muizzu] is trying to make India the issue again, because for him, he hasn’t been able to perform. He hasn’t been able to provide any development or deliver on any of the promises, and therefore, come next election again, he will try to create some narrative on hate,” Mr. Shahid, who was Foreign Minister during the tenure of the previous President Ibrahim Solih (2018-2023) and won a term as the President of the UN General Assembly with India’s support in 2021, told The Hindu in an interview here. The Maldives government spokesperson did not reply to a request for a response to Mr. Shahid’s comments. Mr. Shahid called for more transparency about 20 MoUs signed between the Maldives and Pakistan when President Muizzu went on a three-day visit to Islamabad from October 20 to 22, the first such visit by a Maldives President since 2015. After talks between Mr. Muizzu and Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the two sides announced agreements in a number of areas, including defence and maritime security, combating illicit trafficking and narcotics, information technology, cybersecurity and AI. They agreed to start direct flights between Male and Islamabad. In particular, Mr. Muizzu’s meeting with Pakistan’s Field Marshal and Army chief General Asim Munir had raised eyebrows in Delhi. Mr. Muizzu also called for the revival of SAARC, on hold since 2016 when India pulled out of the summit in Islamabad over cross-border terrorism. “We do not want Maldives to be drawn into disputes within our neighbours,” said Mr. Shahid, demanding that the Muizzu government make a statement in Parliament about the nature of the agreements signed with Pakistan. “We must aim for expanding our relationship with everyone who has goodwill to the Maldives, but it should not come at the cost of our own friends, our established relationships,” he added. When asked about Mr. Muizzu’s Pakistan visit on Friday, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that the government kept a “close watch” on such developments and would “take whatever appropriate steps may be necessary”. In response to the comments on SAARC, Mr. Jaiswal said that it was “one country”, indicating Pakistan, that had “stalled” the functioning of SAARC, and India was keen to strengthen regional cooperation. Mr. Shahid’s comments to The Hindu indicate that ties with India may once again become an issue in the Maldivian elections. Mr. Solih lost the elections in 2023 due to the “India Out” campaign of the People’s National Congress (PNC), led by Mr. Muizzu, against what he alleged was undue Indian influence in the island chain, especially accusing the Solih government of allowing India to build military bases in infrastructure projects that India had constructed. Mr. Muizzu had also demanded that Indian Air Force personnel stationed at three locations in the Maldives, including Gan Island and Hanimadhoo Atoll, who operated aircraft that India had provided to the Maldives, be removed. While the beginning of Mr. Muizzu’s tenure saw tensions with the Modi government, and he chose to travel to Turkiye, the UAE, and China before visiting India, relations improved after India agreed to withdraw military personnel and replace them with civilian personnel instead. In June 2024, a month after the final batch of 89 Indian personnel had been withdrawn, Mr. Muizzu visited India to attend Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s swearing-in ceremony, and then returned in October 2024 for a bilateral visit, when India offered the Maldives several economic support measures, including a currency swap agreement to help Maldives avoid a debt failure. Mr. Shahid, who is standing for the primary elections in the MDP next year, is expected to face some tough competition from his other former colleagues in the cabinet as well, including former Economic Minister Fayyaz Ismail, who has the backing of the current MDP chief and former Maldivian President Mohamed Nasheed. Mr. Shahid and Mr. Solih were rivals of Mr. Nasheed during the previous government, but the opposition has come together within the MDP in order to fight against the ruling PNC. The run-up to the 2028 elections has heated up after the PNC confirmed Mr. Muizzu for the 2028 ticket, and the MDP held its party congress, endorsing the “Big Change” ticket for constitutional reform proposed by Mr. Ismail. Mr. Shahid is in India to attend the Words Beyond Borders International Literature Festival and is expected to affirm a campaign more friendly to India. When asked whether he would back an “India-first” campaign like Mr. Solih did, Mr. Shahid said his outreach would always be “first to India” on foreign policy, but not on domestic issues, which were sovereign. “India has always been our first responder. India has always been a generous partner in development. India is our immediate neighbour, who has been consistent in its relationship with the Maldives. So, our history proves the relationship right,” he said, referring to close ties between India and the Maldives since 1965, when the Maldives won its independence from British rule. Hindu》采访时说：“总统［穆伊祖］试图再次让印度成为议题，因为对他而言，他没有取得成绩。他没有带来任何发展，也没有兑现任何承诺，因此下次选举再次到来时，他会试图制造某种仇恨叙事。”马尔代夫政府发言人没有回应置评请求。10月20日至22日，穆伊祖总统对伊斯兰堡进行为期三天的访问，这是自2015年以来马尔代夫总统首次进行此类访问。访问期间，马尔代夫与巴基斯坦签署了20份谅解备忘录。沙希德呼吁提高这些协议的透明度。穆伊祖与巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫会谈后，双方宣布在防务、海上安全、打击非法走私和毒品、信息技术、网络安全和人工智能等多个领域达成协议，并同意开通马累与伊斯兰堡之间的直航。尤其是穆伊祖与巴基斯坦陆军元帅兼陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔会面，引发新德里的关注。穆伊祖还呼吁恢复南亚区域合作联盟（SAARC）。该联盟自2016年以来一直处于暂停状态，当时印度因跨境恐怖主义问题退出在伊斯兰堡举行的峰会。沙希德说：“我们不希望马尔代夫被卷入邻国之间的争端。”他要求穆伊祖政府就与巴基斯坦签署协议的性质在议会发表声明。他补充说：“我们必须努力与所有对马尔代夫抱有善意的人扩大关系，但这不应以损害我们的朋友和我们既有关系为代价。”当被问及穆伊祖周五对巴基斯坦的访问时，外交部发言人兰德希尔·贾伊斯瓦尔表示，政府对此类动态保持“密切观察”，并将“采取任何必要的适当措施”。谈及有关SAARC的言论，贾伊斯瓦尔先生说，是“一个国家”，即巴基斯坦，导致SAARC的运作“陷入停滞”，而印度希望加强区域合作。沙希德先生对《The Hindu》发表的言论表明，与印度的关系可能再次成为马尔代夫选举中的议题。2023年，索利赫在穆伊祖领导的国民大会党（PNC）发起“印度离开”运动后输掉选举。该党指责印度对马尔代夫群岛施加不当影响，尤其指责索利赫政府允许印度在印度出资建设的基础设施项目中修建军事基地。穆伊祖还要求撤走驻扎在马尔代夫三个地点的印度空军人员，包括甘岛和哈尼马杜环礁；这些人员使用印度提供给马尔代夫的飞机。穆伊祖任期初期与莫迪政府关系紧张，他先访问了土耳其、阿联酋和中国，之后才访问印度。但在印度同意撤走军事人员并以文职人员取代后，双边关系有所改善。2024年6月，在最后一批89名印度人员撤离一个月后，穆伊祖访问印度，出席总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的就职宣誓仪式，并于2024年10月再次进行双边访问。印度当时向马尔代夫提供了多项经济支持措施，包括一项货币互换协议，以帮助马尔代夫避免发生债务违约。沙希德先生计划明年参加MDP初选，预计将受到内阁其他前同僚的激烈竞争，其中包括前经济部长法亚兹·伊斯梅尔，后者得到现任MDP党首、马尔代夫前总统穆罕默德·纳希德的支持。上一届政府时期，沙希德先生与索利赫先生都曾是纳希德先生的竞争对手，但反对派已在MDP内部联合起来，共同对抗执政的PNC。PNC确认穆伊祖参加2028年选举后，竞选活动逐渐升温；MDP召开党代会， 支持伊斯梅尔提出的宪法改革方案及“大变革”竞选主张。沙希德先生目前身在印度，参加Words Beyond Borders国际文学节，预计将公开支持一项对印度更友好的竞选活动。当被问及是否会像索利赫先生那样支持“印度优先”运动时，沙希德先生说，在外交政策上，他的对外联络将始终“首先面向印度”，但在国内问题上不会如此，因为国内事务属于主权范畴。他说：“印度始终是我们的第一响应者。印度始终是发展领域慷慨的伙伴。印度是我们的近邻，与马尔代夫保持着一贯的关系。因此，我们的历史证明双方的关系是正确的。”他指的是，自1965年马尔代夫摆脱英国统治获得独立以来，印度与马尔代夫一直保持密切关系。评论必须以英文提交，并且使用完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. Police officers and other security operatives at the venue intervened and rescued Haidara from the crowd. The primary is a contest between Senator Sahabi Ya’u and Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura for the APC ticket to represent Zamfara North, which comprises Kaura Namoda, Birnin Magaji, Shinkafi and Zurmi local government areas. Calm had been restored at the venue as of the time of filing this report, although security operatives maintained a heavy presence. Efforts to obtain Haidara’s reaction were unsuccessful, as his telephone was switched off. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body_zh: 在索科托，州政府下令无限期关闭人民民主大会党（ADC）竞选办公室，而距离该党原定于11月4日举行的总统竞选启动仪式已不足48小时。据Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →

It said the agreements covered countries accounting for more than half of global gross domestic product (GDP), including Korea, Japan, China, the European Union and Britain. The investigation centered on certain dynamic random access memory (DRAM) devices, products containing them and related components, according to the USITC notice published in the U.S. Federal Register. The case was launched in July following a complaint from Netlist, which alleged that certain memory products infringed its patents. Other companies named as respondents in the case included Google, Nvidia Corp., Broadcom Inc. and Super Micro Computer Inc. The notice said Netlist and Samsung, including its two U.S. subsidiaries, jointly requested the termination of the investigation on Aug. 18 based on a settlement agreement between the companies. Netlist develops advanced memory and storage technologies, including server memory and HBM solutions for AI computing. In 2021, Netlist sued Samsung, alleging that the Korean tech giant's memory products used in cloud computing servers, along with other data technologies, infringed its patents. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会在与Netlist达成和解后终止对三星芯片专利的调查
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 华盛顿——据周一刊登的一份联邦通知，美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）已正式终止一宗涉及Samsung Electronics Co.及多家美国大型科技公司的专利侵权调查。此前，韩国芯片制造商已与美国芯片企业Netlist Inc.达成和解。根据刊登于《美国联邦公报》的USITC通知，此次调查涉及某些动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）设备、包含这些设备的产品及相关零部件。该案于7月启动，起因是Netlist提出投诉，指控某些存储产品侵犯其专利。案件中被列为被调查方的其他公司包括Google、Nvidia Corp.、Broadcom Inc.和Super Micro Computer Inc.。通知称，Netlist与Samsung及其两家美国子公司依据双方达成的和解协议，于8月18日共同申请终止调查。在8月达成的和解中，Samsung与Netlist签署了一份为期五年的协议，以获得对这家公司专利组合的访问权，包括与服务器双列直插式存储模块（DIMM）以及用于人工智能（AI）服务器和高性能计算系统的高带宽存储器（HBM）相关的技术。Netlist开发先进的存储器和数据存储技术，包括用于AI计算的服务器存储器和HBM解决方案。2021年，Netlist起诉Samsung，指控这家韩国科技巨头的存储产品以及其他数据技术侵犯了其专利；这些存储产品被用于云计算服务器。Samsung则主张，Netlist的专利无效，且其技术的运行方式不同于专利涵盖的技术

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强周二中期选举前对非公民投票的打击，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选举选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，包括韩裔美国人社区在内，绿卡持有人讲述了自己尽管不是美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. Across online forums and social media discussions, including Korean-American communities, green card holders have shared accounts of receiving ballots or voter-registration materials despite not being U.S. citizens. "I'm a green card holder, but ballots come to my house every time," one user wrote. Another said she and her husband, both green card holders, had received jury summonses, and that her husband had also received election-related mail. The accounts have prompted discussions about how noncitizens end up receiving election materials and whether mistakes involving voter registration could jeopardize their green cards or future citizenship applications. Some users expressed concern that they may have been registered without realizing it, while others questioned how permanent residents could be unaware that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote. The concerns come as federal authorities pursue criminal cases against green card holders accused of voting illegally. On Oct. 19, the Justice Department announced charges against 28 permanent residents in California for offenses including fraudulent voter registration, unlawful voting and false statements during naturalization proceedings. Among them was Jennifer Jung, a 31-year-old Korean woman with Canadian citizenship living in San Diego, according to Korean-language broadcaster Radio Korea. Federal prosecutors allege that Jung falsely claimed to be a U.S. citizen when registering to vote, cast a ballot in the November 2024 election and later made false statements about her voting history during a naturalization interview. The cases have also raised questions about California's voter registration system, which automatically registers eligible applicants during Department of Motor Vehicles transactions unless they opt out. State officials say applicants who indicate they are ineligible are not registered through the system. However, California has previously acknowledged cases of people being registered erroneously. Receiving election-related mail does not necessarily mean someone is registered to vote, and simply receiving a ballot is not a voting offense. But knowingly making a false claim of U.S. citizenship or voting illegally can have serious immigration consequences. The consequences depend on the circumstances, including how the person became registered, whether a ballot was cast and whether any false claim of citizenship was made. California allows people who were registered by mistake to cancel their registration through their county elections office, although cancellation does not necessarily eliminate potential immigration consequences from past violations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国严打投票问题令持有韩国绿卡的选民担心收到非预期选票
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强打击非公民投票，并赶在周二中期选举前展开行动，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在包括韩裔美国人社群在内的网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，持有绿卡的人士讲述了自己尽管并非美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。一名用户写道：“我是绿卡持有者，但每次都有选票寄到我家。”另一名用户表示，她和丈夫都持有绿卡，却收到了陪审团传票，她丈夫还收到了与选举有关的邮件。这些经历引发了讨论：非公民为何会收到选举材料，以及选民登记方面的失误是否可能危及他们的绿卡或未来的公民身份申请。一些用户担心自己可能在不知情的情况下被登记为选民，另一些人则质疑，永久居民怎么会不知道只有美国公民才有权投票。联邦当局目前正对被控非法投票的绿卡持有者追究刑事责任。10月19日，美国司法部宣布对加利福尼亚州的28名永久 residents 提出指控，罪名包括欺诈性选民登记、非法投票以及在入籍程序中作虚假陈述。据韩语广播机构Korea Radio报道，被指控者中包括31岁的韩国裔女性Jennifer Jung，她拥有加拿大国籍，居住在圣迭戈。联邦检察官称，Jung在登记投票时虚假声称自己是美国公民，在2024年11月选举中投了票，并在之后的入籍面谈中就自己的投票记录作出虚假陈述。这些案件还引发了人们对加利福尼亚州选民登记系统的疑问。该系统在机动车管理局办理业务时会自动登记符合条件的申请人，除非申请人选择退出。州官员表示，在系统中表明自己不符合资格的申请人不会被登记。不过，加利福尼亚州此前曾承认发生过一些人被错误登记的个案。收到与选举有关的邮件并不一定意味着某人已登记为选民，而仅仅收到选票也不构成投票违法行为。但明知而虚假声称拥有美国国籍或非法投票，可能造成严重的移民后果。具体后果取决于多种情况，包括此人如何被登记、是否实际投票，以及是否曾虚假声称拥有美国国籍。加利福尼亚州允许被错误登记的人通过所在县的选举办公室取消登记，但取消登记并不一定能消除过去违法行为可能产生的移民后果……

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/2.title_zh: 2027：埃格巴集团拒绝独立国家选举委员会据称选择性执行最高法院裁决
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/2.body_zh:
埃格巴诚信组织（EIG）谴责独立国家选举委员会（INEC）选择性执法。10月29日星期四委员会召开会议后，该组织指责INEC在执法过程中标准不一。

该组织表示，INEC执行了最高法院关于州长候选人所属政党党员名册提交期限的裁决，却拒绝在奥贡州国民议会候选人案中采取同样措施。它补充道：“最高法院于2026年9月24日在INEC诉ZLP一案（SC/CV/495/2026）中裁定，《2026年选举法》第77(5)(6)(7)条具有强制性。”

该组织坚持认为，INEC在10月29日采取了选择性执法。它表示：“对于州长候选人：INEC严格执行规定——Isa Pantami（贡贝州PDP）——有条件获准参选；Abdulsalam Gwarzo（卡诺州NDC）——有条件获准参选；Ladi Adebutu（奥贡州PDP州长候选人）——被拒。

“INEC称‘奥贡州PDP候选人未能通过审核。’对于国民议会候选人，INEC拒绝执行相同规定。PDP在奥贡州提交的名册存在缺陷，并因此导致Adebutu被取消资格，但该名册却被用来保留Iyabo Obasanjo参议员（奥贡州中部PDP）及其他国民议会候选人的资格。这属于非法歧视。

“第77条并未区分州长和参议员。名册只有一份。如果该名册对州长候选人无效，那么对参议员候选人同样无效。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.summary_zh: 该提案还规定，在36个州议会中各增加3个女性席位，旨在扩大女性参与立法决策的范围，同时不取代现有选区或当选议员。兼任参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席的Bamidele表示，该提案是第10届全国议会正在进行的宪法修订工作的一部分。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body: • Says proposal allocates 37 seats each to Senate, House of Representatives •Three additional seats proposed for women in each state assembly The National Assembly has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats exclusively reserved for women in Senate and House of Representatives as part of ongoing efforts to address gender imbalance in Nigeria’s political representation. The proposal, which also provides for three additional seats for women in each of the 36 state Houses of Assembly, is designed to expand women’s participation in legislative decision-making without displacing existing constituencies or elected lawmakers. Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, disclosed the proposal on Monday while speaking at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposal formed part of the ongoing constitution amendment exercise being undertaken by the 10th National Assembly. He explained that the proposed arrangement would provide 37 additional seats in Senate and another 37 in House of Representatives, ensuring that every state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory would have one additional representative in each chamber. According to him, the proposed special seats are intended to provide women with greater access to elective positions and decision-making platforms, particularly against the background of their historically low representation in Nigeria’s legislative institutions. Bamidele disclosed that the Constitution Review Committee had also recommended three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. He stressed that the proposed seats would be exclusively reserved for women and would not affect existing electoral constituencies or displace any serving lawmaker. The arrangement, he added, would operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would undergo a comprehensive review. Bamidele explained, “This arrangement is proposed to run for a period of 16 years, four electoral cycles, before a comprehensive review. This is a sunset clause designed to ensure sustainability and to allow for the organic development of a more inclusive political culture.” The senate leader expressed confidence that the proposal would secure the necessary legislative backing, particularly from the state Houses of Assembly, whose approval is constitutionally required to complete the amendment process. “We are actively and strategically engaging with the State Houses of Assembly, as their concurrence is a constitutional sine qua non for bringing this reform to fruition,” he said. Bamidele described the proposed special seats as a fundamental democratic reform rather than a partisan political initiative, stating that a representative democracy cannot function effectively while excluding a substantial proportion of the population from legislative decision-making. He said the initiative followed extensive consultations and consensus-building, adding that the National Assembly deliberately commenced the constitutional review process early to allow sufficient time for scrutiny and wider stakeholder participation. He said the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the initiative had also been strengthened by advocacy from prominent figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. Bamidele stated that the under-representation of women in political institutions required deliberate legislative intervention. He said the proposed reform was intended to strengthen democratic inclusion and ensure that women’s interests received adequate attention in the formulation of public policies. He stated, “The special seat initiative is not a partisan endeavour. It is a historic imperative. “The rationale is anchored on a simple, yet profound, principle of constitutional law: the foundational precept of representative democracy. The senate leader also highlighted the need for legislative interventions to protect women, children, and other vulnerable groups, particularly in the areas of healthcare, education, and social protection. He maintained that government had a responsibility to provide adequate safeguards where prevailing market conditions, cultural practices, and institutional weaknesses failed to protect vulnerable citizens. On access to justice, Bamidele insisted that the country’s legal framework must respond effectively to emerging threats against women and children, stressing that justice should not remain a constitutional promise or a provision in the statute books. “Rather, it must be accessible, affordable, timely, and effective,” he said. Bamidele added, “A woman who suffers domestic violence must be able to seek protection without intimidation or social condemnation. A child who experiences abuse must be heard, protected from further harm, and provided with appropriate support. FIDA, Ekiti State Chapter, chaired by Mrs. Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, organised the Law Week with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children.” The event was attended by Chairman of House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba; Speaker of Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye; and other dignitaries. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.title_zh: 巴米德莱：国民议会提议为女性设立74个特别议席
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body_zh:
• 提议在参议院和众议院各增设37个席位 • 提议在每个州议会为女性增设3个席位

尼日利亚国民议会提议在参议院和众议院增设74个专门保留给女性的席位，以作为解决尼日利亚政治代表中性别失衡问题持续努力的一部分。该提案还规定在尼日利亚36个州议会各为女性增设3个席位，旨在扩大女性对立法决策的参与，同时不取消现有选区，也不取代现任议员。

参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员周一在由国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上公布了这项提案。巴米德莱同时担任参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席。他说，这项提案是第十届国民议会正在进行的宪法修订工作的一部分。他解释说，拟议安排将在参议院增加37个席位，在众议院再增加37个席位，确保联邦每个州及联邦首都领地在两院中各增加一名代表。

据他介绍，拟议中的专门席位旨在让女性有更多机会担任民选职位和参与决策平台，尤其是考虑到女性在尼日利亚立法机构中的代表比例历来较低。巴米德莱透露，宪法审查委员会还建议在每个州议会为女性增加3个席位。他强调，拟议席位将专门保留给女性，不会影响现有选区，也不会取代任何在任议员。

他还说，该安排将实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将进行全面审查。巴米德莱解释道：“这项安排拟实施16年，即4个选举周期，之后再进行全面审查。这是一项日落条款，旨在确保制度的可持续性，并为更具包容性的政治文化实现自然发展留出空间。”

这位参议院领袖表示有信心，该提案将获得必要的立法支持，尤其是各州议会的支持，因为根据宪法，完成修宪程序必须取得州议会的同意。他说：“我们正在积极且有策略地与各州议会沟通，因为取得它们的同意是推动这项改革实现的宪法必要条件。”

巴米德莱将拟议的专门席位描述为一项根本性的民主改革，而非党派政治行动。他表示，如果将相当大比例的人口排除在立法决策之外，代表制民主就无法有效运作。他说，这项倡议是在广泛征询意见和凝聚共识后提出的；第十届国民议会特意提前启动宪法审查程序，以便留出充足时间进行审查并扩大利益相关方的参与。他还表示，第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员等知名人士的倡导，也加强了第十届国民议会对这项倡议的投入。

巴米德莱指出，女性在政治机构中代表不足，需要立法机关有意采取干预措施。他说，拟议改革旨在加强民主包容性，确保女性利益在公共政策制定中得到充分关注。他表示：“专门席位倡议不是党派行为，而是历史的必然要求。其依据植根于宪法-law的一项简单却深刻的原则：代表制民主的基本原则。”

这位参议院领袖还强调，需要通过立法干预保护女性、儿童及其他弱势群体，尤其是在医疗保健、教育和社会保护等领域。他坚持认为，当 prevailing 市场状况、文化习俗和制度缺陷未能保护弱势公民时，政府有责任提供充分保障。

在司法可及性方面，巴米德莱坚称，该国法律框架必须有效应对针对女性和儿童的新兴威胁，强调司法不应仅仅停留在宪法承诺或法条之中。他说：“相反，司法必须易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效。”巴米德莱补充道：“遭受家庭暴力的女性必须能够寻求保护，而不受恐吓或社会谴责。遭受虐待的儿童必须有机会表达意见，受到保护以免进一步受到伤害，并获得适当支持。”

由阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹夫人担任主席的FIDA埃基蒂州分会组织了本届法律周活动，主题为“变化世界中的司法：应对影响女性和儿童的新挑战”。众议院信息与国家导向委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下、埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下及其他贵宾出席了活动。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body: •Demand deposits climb 71% •Analysts highlight cash dependence, financial inclusion challenges Currency held outside the banking system by Nigerians rose by 103.8 per cent to N4.923 trillion in September 2026 from N2.416 trillion in September 2023, highlighting the persistent demand for physical cash despite the expansion of electronic payment channels in the country. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, Money and Credit Statistics, also showed that currency outside banks increased by 10.3 per cent year-on-year from N4.465 trillion in September 2025 to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. The figures indicate that cash held outside the banking system has more than doubled in three years, reflecting the scale of currency demand within the economy and the challenges facing efforts to deepen the use of formal banking and electronic payment systems. A breakdown of the data showed that currency outside banks increased by 66.2 per cent from N2.416 trillion in September 2023 to N4.016 trillion in September 2024. The figure subsequently rose to N4.465 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 11.2 per cent from the corresponding period in 2024, before climbing further to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. According to analysts, the latest increase indicates that the preference for cash transactions remains significant, notwithstanding the growing adoption of mobile banking, electronic transfers, point-of-sale terminals and other digital payment platforms. Meanwhile, demand deposits in the banking system increased by 70.8 per cent to N39.124 trillion in September 2026 from N22.903 trillion in September 2023. The CBN data showed that demand deposits rose to N31.842 trillion in September 2024, representing an increase of 39.0 per cent against the corresponding period in 2023. The figure climbed further to N34.642 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 8.8 per cent year-on-year, before rising to N39.124 trillion in September 2026, representing a 12.9 per cent increase over September 2025. The growth in demand deposits indicates an expansion in funds held in bank accounts that are generally accessible for payments and withdrawals on demand. Reacting to this data, Clifford Egbomeade, Economic and Communications expert, said: “The simultaneous increase in demand deposits and currency outside banks points to the coexistence of formal banking balances and substantial demand for physical cash in Nigeria’s payment system. ‘‘However, the two indicators measure different components of monetary activity. Demand deposits represent bank-account balances, while currency outside banks represents cash held outside the banking system. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.title_zh: 银行外流通货币三年增长104%
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body_zh: •活期存款增长71% •分析人士指出对现金的依赖及普惠金融挑战 尼日利亚人存放在银行体系外的现金从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，增幅为103.8%，尽管该国电子支付渠道不断扩展，实体现金需求依然旺盛。尼日利亚中央银行CBN的货币与信贷统计数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，同比增幅为10.3%。这些数字表明，银行体系外持有的现金在3年内增长了一倍以上，反映出经济体内现金需求的规模，以及深化正规银行和电子支付系统使用所面临的挑战。数据明细显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。此后，这一数字在2025年9月升至4.465万亿奈拉，较2024年同期增长11.2%，随后在2026年9月进一步升至4.923万亿奈拉。分析人士称，最新增幅表明，尽管移动银行、电子转账、销售终端及其他数字支付平台的采用率不断提高，人们对现金交易的偏好仍然十分显著。与此同时，银行体系内的活期存款从2023年9月的22.903万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的39.124万亿奈拉，增幅为70.8%。CBN数据显示，活期存款在2024年9月升至31.842万亿奈拉，较2023年同期增长39.0%。这一数字在2025年9月进一步升至34.642万亿奈拉，同比增长8.8%，随后在2026年9月升至39.124万亿奈拉，较2025年9月增长12.9%。活期存款的增长表明，银行账户中的资金规模扩大，这些资金通常可按需用于支付和提取。针对这组数据，经济与传播问题专家Clifford Egbomeade表示：“活期存款与银行体系外流通的货币同步增长，表明尼日利亚支付体系中正规银行余额与对实体现金的大量需求并存。不过，这两个指标衡量的是货币活动的不同组成部分。活期存款代表银行账户余额，而银行体系外流通的货币则代表存放在银行体系外的现金。此处表达的意见并不反映Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Governor Francis Nwifuru of Ebonyi State says his administration has forwarded an executive bill to the state House of Assembly to make kidnapping a capital offence punishable by death without an option of alternative punishment. Mr Nwifuru said this on Friday during the funeral of the slain traditional ruler of Ndufu-Alike Community in Ikwo Local Government Area, Francis Igwe, Vanguard reported . “This should serve as a deterrent to those planning a kidnapping, whether for political reasons or otherwise,” the governor said. Mr Igwe, father of the immediate past Deputy Governor of Ebonyi State, Kelechi Igwe, was abducted on 1 March 1 while on his way to church. Mr Nwifuru, while speaking at the traditional ruler’s funeral, decried the moral deterioration among Nigerian youths. “I am worried about our present-day youths taking up leadership positions tomorrow. Some of our youths are not well informed, and they act so irrationally. “I am concerned because, with some of their attitudinal dispositions, there seems to be no future for our youths. “The youths need to have a rethink concerning certain actions of theirs, especially as concerns their attitudes towards community leaders,” he said. “They should desist from treating their leaders as holders of their destinies.” Mr Nwifuru vowed to implement any court decision against those arrested over the traditional ruler’s murder, stressing that the proposed legislation was intended to deter kidnapping in the state. He maintained that the traditional ruler’s murder should be the last of such incidents in Ikwo and other parts of the state. The governor described the late traditional ruler as “a forthright, vocal and astute parliamentarian” who represented his people effectively in the old Anambra State. He said the traditional ruler attracted development projects to his community, including the popular Folk Technical College, which has produced prominent Nigerians. In their tributes, former governors of the state, Sam Egwu and Martin Elechi, as well as former Senate President, Pius Anyim, described the deceased as a statesman, peacemaker, renowned educationist, administrator and passionate leader who left enduring legacies. They urged the family and the Ikwo people to take solace in his contributions to society. Speaking in his tribute, the slain traditional ruler’s first son and former deputy governor, Kelechi, described his father as a devoted family man and role model who guided him on family life, religion, politics and culture. He said the circumstances surrounding his father’s death remained difficult for the family to comprehend. The former deputy governor said the family was confident that the legacy of the slain traditional ruler would endure for generations to come. The offence attracts severe penalties, including life imprisonment and, in certain circumstances, the death penalty. Criminal Code Act and the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022 are the two principal laws that outlaw kidnapping and hostage taking. While the Criminal Code Act prescribes imprisonment of up to 10 years, the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, which addresses the offence in the context of terrorism, prescribes severe punishment, including death, where the offence resulted in the death of a victim. However, the punishment for kidnappings varies across the states in the country. PREMIUM TIMES reports that the applicable legislation on kidnapping is the Ebonyi State Internal Security Enforcement and Other Related Matters Law, 2009 (Cap. 55, Vol. 2)
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 州长要求对绑架者判处死刑，并将法案提交州议会
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 埃博尼州州长弗朗西斯·恩维富鲁表示，其政府已向该州众议院提交一项行政法案，拟将绑架定为可判处死刑且不得以其他刑罚替代的资本罪行。恩维富鲁先生于周五在伊克沃地方政府辖区恩杜富-阿利克社区遇害传统酋长弗朗西斯·伊格韦的葬礼上说了这番话，《Vanguard》报道称。州长说：“无论出于政治目的还是其他原因，这都应当对那些策划绑架的人形成威慑。”伊格韦先生是埃博尼州前副州长凯莱奇·伊格韦的父亲，他于3月1日前往教堂途中遭绑架。恩维富鲁州长在传统酋长葬礼上发言时，谴责了尼日利亚年轻人之间的道德滑坡。他说：“我担心我们当代的年轻人明天担任领导职务时，会出现一些问题。我们的一些年轻人见识不足，行事又十分不理性。令我担忧的是，从他们某些态度倾向来看，我们年轻人似乎没有未来。年轻人需要重新思考自己的某些行为，尤其是对社区领袖的态度，”他说，“他们不应再把领袖视决定自己命运的人。”恩维富鲁先生誓言执行法院针对因谋杀传统酋长而被捕者的任何裁决，并强调拟议立法的目的在于遏制该州的绑架行为。他坚持认为，传统酋长遇害应当成为伊克沃及该州其他地区此类事件中的最后一例。州长称已故传统酋长是“一位正直、敢于发声且精明的议员”，曾在旧阿南布拉州有效代表民众。他还 said，传统酋长为所在社区吸引了发展项目，其中包括颇受欢迎的民间技术学院，该学院培养出了多位尼日利亚杰出人物。在悼词中，该州前州长萨姆·埃格沃、马丁·埃莱奇以及前参议院议长皮乌斯·阿尼姆称逝者是一位政治家、和平缔造者、知名教育家、行政管理者和充满热情的领袖，留下了 enduring legacies。他们敦促其家人和伊克沃民众从他为社会作出的贡献中寻求慰藉。在悼词中，遇害传统酋长的长子、前副州长凯莱奇称父亲是一位忠于家庭的楷模，在家庭生活、宗教、政治和文化方面都给予他指导。他说，围绕父亲死亡的具体情况，家人至今仍难以理解。这位前副州长表示，家人相信，遇害传统酋长留下的精神遗产将世代延续。该罪行的刑罚严厉，包括无期徒刑，在某些情况下还可判处死刑。《刑法典》和《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》是禁止绑架和劫持人质的两部主要法律。《刑法典》规定最高可判处10年监禁，而从恐怖主义背景下处理该罪行的《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》则规定严厉处罚，如果犯罪行为导致受害者死亡，可判处死刑。不过，全国各州对绑架罪的处罚规定有所不同。《PREMIUM TIMES》报道称，适用于绑架案的立法是《2009年埃博尼州内部安全执法及其他相关事项法》（Cap. 55, Vol. 2）

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title: NASS committed to increasing women’s participation
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary_zh: ADO-EKITI——参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案清除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在全国议会和州议会为女性设置专门席位。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly. Bamidele, who represents Ekiti Central Senatorial District, said the proposed legislation was designed to address the persistent under-representation of women in Nigeria’s political institutions and ensure their participation in decisions affecting the country. He spoke as a guest speaker at the 2026 Law Week of the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter, held in Ado-Ekiti, with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children”. The Senate Leader said the proposed constitutional alteration would create 37 additional seats in the Senate and 37 in the House of Representatives, with one seat reserved for women in each state and the Federal Capital Territory. He added that the proposal also provided for three additional seats in each State House of Assembly, without displacing existing legislative seats. According to him, the arrangement is proposed to run for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which its impact would be reviewed. Describing the initiative as a historic intervention rather than a partisan project, Bamidele said a democracy that excluded a significant proportion of its population from decision-making could not claim to be fully representative. He disclosed that the National Assembly had commenced engagements with State Houses of Assembly to secure the constitutionally required concurrence for the proposed amendment. He said the process was being pursued through extensive consultations and consensus-building. Bamidele, who commended the advocacy of the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, said the 10th Assembly was determined to address historical gaps in women’s political representation. The lawmaker also identified globalisation, artificial intelligence, digitalisation, insecurity, economic instability and climate change as factors creating new challenges for women and children. He said women continued to face gender-based violence, economic exclusion, discrimination and inadequate healthcare, while children remained vulnerable to sexual abuse, trafficking, child labour, early marriage, malnutrition, educational deprivation and digital exploitation. He noted that poverty, unemployment, inadequate social protection, educational inequalities, social stigma and weak enforcement of existing laws had further compounded the challenges. Bamidele maintained that protecting women and children was not merely a humanitarian responsibility but a constitutional obligation and a critical investment in national development, economic productivity and social stability. He also highlighted legislative interventions of the 10th Assembly, including the four Tax Reform Acts of 2025, which he said exempted sanitary products, baby diapers and other essential products for women and children from Value Added Tax. He described the measure as a social justice intervention aimed at reducing the financial burden on low-income women and families. The Senate Leader urged FIDA to deepen its engagement with the National Assembly and other relevant institutions by identifying gaps in existing laws, proposing reforms and ensuring that government policies and budgetary provisions translated into tangible benefits for vulnerable Nigerians. He also challenged the organisation to hold the legislature accountable for implementing its commitments, particularly the proposed special seats for women and adequate funding for child protection, women’s healthcare and gender empowerment programmes. “A democracy that systematically excludes over half of its population from the decision-making tables that determine their future is, at best, a flawed democracy and, at worst, a veiled oligarchy. “The law is only as good as its implementation. Hold us accountable. Demand that the Special Seats Bill becomes law. Demand that appropriations for child protection and women’s health are not just passed, but released and utilised,” he said. In her keynote address, the Vice-Chancellor of Afe Babalola University, Ado-Ekiti, Professor Smaranda Olarinde, called for stronger legal and institutional frameworks to protect women and children against emerging forms of abuse, particularly those enabled by technology and economic vulnerabilities. Olarinde said the growing use of artificial intelligence and digital platforms had created new threats, including cyberstalking, online harassment, deepfake images, impersonation and the exploitation of children. She called for stronger collaboration among government, the judiciary, law enforcement agencies, universities, religious and traditional leaders, the media and civil society organisations to tackle gender-based violence and child abuse. The vice-chancellor also urged FIDA to move beyond advocacy to measurable outcomes, proposing a collaborative Women and Children Access to Justice Action Framework to improve legal protection, digital safety and support for survivors. In his remarks, the Chief Judge of Ekiti State, Justice Ogunmoye, commended FIDA for selecting Bamidele to deliver the lecture, describing him as well placed to address emerging issues requiring legislative and policy reforms to protect women and children. Earlier, the Chairperson of FIDA, Ekiti State chapter, Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, said the organisation would remain committed to promoting, protecting and preserving the rights of women and children. She said changing realities continued to present new challenges to their safety, dignity and fundamental rights, requiring stronger laws, institutions and collective responses to ensure access to justice. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body_zh: 阿多埃基蒂——参议院领袖、参议员奥佩耶米·巴米德莱表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案消除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在国民议会和州议会为女性设立专属议席。巴米德莱代表埃基蒂中央选区参议员区，他说，拟议立法旨在解决女性在尼日利亚政治机构中长期代表不足的问题，并确保女性参与影响国家的各项决策。他是在阿多埃基蒂举行的2026年国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会法律周活动上作为嘉宾发言的，主题为“变化中的世界中的正义：应对影响妇女和儿童的新挑战”。参议院领袖表示，拟议的宪法修订将在参议院增设37个议席，在众议院增设37个议席，每个州和联邦首都直辖区各保留1个女性席位。他补充说，该提案还将为每个州议会增加3个席位，而不会挤占现有立法席位。据他介绍，这项安排拟实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将对其影响进行评估。巴米德莱称，这项倡议是一项历史性干预，而非党派项目；如果一个民主制度将相当大比例的人口排除在决策之外，就不能声称自己具有充分的代表性。他透露，全国大会已开始与各州议会接洽，以取得宪法要求的修正案同意。他说，这一进程正通过广泛磋商和凝聚共识推进。巴米德莱赞扬了第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布的倡导工作，并表示第10届大会决心弥合女性政治代表方面的历史差距。这位议员还指出，全球化、人工智能、数字化、不安全局势、经济不稳定和气候变化正在给妇女和儿童带来新的挑战。他说，妇女仍面临基于性别的暴力、经济排斥、歧视和医疗保障不足，而儿童仍易遭受性虐待、人口贩运、童工、早婚、营养不良、教育匮乏和数字剥削。他指出，贫困、失业、社会保障不足、教育不平等、社会污名和现有法律执行不力进一步加剧了这些挑战。巴米德莱坚持认为，保护妇女和儿童不仅是人道主义责任，也是宪法义务，更是促进国家发展、经济生产力和社会稳定的关键投资。他还强调了第10届大会采取的立法措施，包括2025年的4部《税制改革法》，据他说，这些法律免除了卫生用品、婴儿纸尿裤和其他妇女及儿童必需品的产品增值税。他称，这项措施是一项社会公正干预，旨在减轻低收入妇女和家庭的经济负担。参议院领袖敦促FIDA加强与全国大会及其他相关机构的合作，找出现有法律中的缺口、提出改革建议，并确保政府政策和预算安排转化为弱势尼日利亚人切实可享的益处。他还要求该组织监督立法机关履行承诺，特别是落实拟议的女性专属议席，以及为儿童保护、妇女医疗保健和性别赋权项目提供充足资金。他说：“一个将超过一半人口系统性排除在决定其未来的决策机制之外的民主制度，充其量是一个有缺陷的民主制度，最坏的情况下，则是披着外衣的寡头政治。‘法律的好坏取决于执行。请监督我们。要求《专属议席法案》成为法律。要求儿童保护和妇女健康方面的拨款不仅获得批准，而且得到拨付和使用。’”阿多埃基蒂Afe Babalola大学校长斯马兰达·奥拉林德教授发表主旨演讲时，呼吁加强法律和制度框架，保护妇女和儿童免受新型虐待，尤其是借助技术以及经济脆弱性而滋生的虐待。奥拉林德说，人工智能和数字平台的日益使用带来了新的威胁，包括网络跟踪、网络骚扰、深度伪造图像、冒名身份以及对儿童的剥削。她呼吁政府、司法机关、执法机构、高校、宗教和传统领袖、媒体及公民社会组织加强合作，共同打击基于性别的暴力和儿童虐待。校长还敦促FIDA超越倡导工作，着眼可衡量的成果，并提议建立协作性质的“妇女与儿童司法获取行动框架”，以改善法律保护、数字安全和幸存者支持。埃基蒂州首席法官奥贡莫耶法官在发言中赞扬FIDA选择巴米德莱发表讲座，称他非常适合探讨需要通过立法和政策改革加以应对的新兴问题，以保护妇女和儿童。FIDA埃基蒂州分会主席阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹早些时候表示，该组织将继续致力于促进、保护和保障妇女及儿童的权利。她说，不断变化的现实持续给他们的安全、尊严和基本权利带来新挑战，需要更完善的法律、制度和集体应对措施，以确保每个人都能获得司法救济。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body: ABUJA — The National Assembly Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats for women in the Senate and House of Representatives, Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said. The proposal also provides for three additional seats reserved for women in each State House of Assembly, without displacing any existing seats. Bamidele, who represents Ekiti Central Senatorial District, disclosed this on Monday at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. He said the proposals were aimed at deepening women’s participation and representation in Nigeria’s political and governance processes. In a statement issued by his Media Directorate, Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of the Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposed special seats were part of the ongoing constitutional amendment process. Explaining the proposal, the Senate Leader said it would create 37 additional seats in the Senate and another 37 in the House of Representatives. According to him, if approved, each state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory will have one additional seat in each chamber of the National Assembly. He said the committee had also proposed three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. Bamidele said the arrangement was designed to operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would be subjected to a comprehensive review. He described the proposed duration as a sunset clause intended to allow the development of a more inclusive political culture. He said the committee was engaging with state Houses of Assembly, whose concurrence was constitutionally required for the proposed amendment to take effect. Bamidele said the initiative was not partisan but aimed at addressing the under-representation of women in decision-making. He added that the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the proposal had been strengthened by advocacy from key government figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. On the broader protection of women and children, Bamidele said laws must respond to emerging threats and ensure that victims of abuse had access to protection and justice. He said justice should be accessible, affordable, timely and effective, adding that women experiencing domestic violence and children subjected to abuse must be protected from intimidation and further harm. He also called for access to legal assistance, medical care and psychosocial support for victims, while perpetrators should be held accountable in accordance with due process and the rule of law. The event was attended by the Chairman of the House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba, and the Speaker of the Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye, among others. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title_zh: 尼日利亚国民议会提议为女性增加74个议席
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body_zh: 阿布贾——参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱表示，审查1999年宪法的国民议会委员会提议在参议院和众议院为女性增设74个议席。该提案还规定，每个州议会为女性保留3个额外议席，且不占用任何现有议席。代表埃基蒂中央选区的巴米德莱于星期一在国际女律师联合会埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上披露了上述信息。他说，这些提案旨在深化女性对尼日利亚政治和治理进程的参与和代表权。巴米德莱也是参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席，他在媒体指导部门发表的声明中表示，拟议的专门议席是正在进行的宪法修订程序的一部分。巴米德莱解释说，该提案将在参议院增设37个议席，并在众议院增设37个议席。他表示，如果获得批准，联邦的每个州和联邦首都特区将在国民议会两院中各增设1个议席。他说，委员会还提议每个州议会为女性增设3个议席。巴米德莱表示，这一安排拟实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将接受全面审查。他称，拟定期限属于日落条款，旨在促进形成更具包容性的政治文化。他说，委员会正在与各州议会沟通；根据宪法，修正案生效必须获得这些议会的同意。巴米德莱表示，此项倡议不具有党派倾向，而是旨在解决女性在决策过程中代表不足的问题。他补充称，在第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布等重要政府人士的倡议和推动下，第10届国民议会对该提案的支持得到加强。在保护妇女和儿童这一更广泛的议题上，巴米德莱表示，法律必须回应新出现的威胁，确保遭受虐待的受害者能够获得保护和司法救济。他说，司法救济应当易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效，并补充指出，遭受家庭暴力的妇女和遭受虐待的儿童必须得到保护，免受恐吓和进一步伤害。他还呼吁为受害者提供法律援助、医疗照护和社会心理支持，同时应按照正当程序和法治原则追究施害者的责任。出席活动的还有众议院信息与国家_orientation委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下，以及埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下等。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.body: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has increased the number of companies admitted into its virtual asset regulatory sandbox from 11 to 20 as it gathers information to guide the regulation of digital asset services in Ghana. The expansion is intended to give the regulator a broader understanding of the services being offered under the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act 1154), and help shape the licensing framework for the sector. Speaking at the Africa Virtual Assets Summit 2026, the Acting Director-General of the SEC, Dr James Klutse Avedzi, said the additional companies would provide the regulator with more data on the different activities taking place in the virtual asset industry. He identified tokenisation as one of the services covered by the regulatory framework, describing it as an established licensing category. “Tokenisation is an explicit licensing category, not an afterthought,” he said. Tokenisation involves converting ownership rights or interests in physical or financial assets into digital tokens that can be recorded and transferred using blockchain technology. Dr Avedzi disclosed that live tokenisation pilot projects were already underway, with Ghana exploring how blockchain technology could help formalise its largely informal gold supply chain. “Ghana is deliberately testing whether blockchain can formalise its large, partly informal gold supply chain,” he said. Some of the companies admitted into the expanded sandbox include Africoin Ghana, the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), The Blue Penguin Company, HSB Global Fintech and BSystems. Dr Avedzi said companies that satisfy the required compliance standards could apply for full licences after completing their participation in the sandbox. He explained that information gathered during the testing period would help the SEC develop licensing requirements and regulatory rules for the different virtual asset services. Despite the expansion of the sandbox, Dr Avedzi said several regulatory requirements for tokenised securities were still being developed. These include capital requirements, custody standards, disclosure obligations and investor protection measures. He also identified outstanding legal questions concerning property and title rights, the enforceability of claims represented by digital tokens, and the regulation of secondary markets for tokenised real-world assets. On the legislative front, he said the Securities Industry Act, 2016 (Act 929), was being amended to address potential classification challenges involving tokenised instruments. Dr Avedzi said Ghana was still completing its regulatory strategy and legislative framework, even as supervised testing of virtual asset services continued. A fully operational licensing regime is yet to be established. He projected that the first group of companies could graduate from the sandbox and obtain full licences between late 2026 and early 2027
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.title_zh: 加纳黄金局成为SEC扩大后的虚拟资产监管沙盒中的20家公司之一
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.body_zh: 证券交易委员会（SEC）已将获准进入其虚拟资产监管沙盒的公司数量从11家增至20家，以收集信息并指导加纳数字资产服务的监管工作。此次扩容旨在让监管机构更全面地了解《2025年虚拟资产服务提供商法》（第1154号法案）下提供的各项服务，并帮助制定该行业的许可框架。在2026年非洲虚拟资产峰会上，SEC代理总干事詹姆斯·克卢策·阿韦齐博士表示，新增公司将为监管机构提供更多数据，以了解虚拟资产行业中开展的不同业务。他指出，资产代币化是监管框架涵盖的服务之一，并将其描述为一个已经确立的许可类别。他说：“资产代币化是一个明确的许可类别，而非事后附加的事项。”资产代币化是指将实物资产或金融资产的所有权权利或权益转换为数字代币，并利用区块链技术进行记录和转让。阿韦齐博士透露，资产代币化试点项目已经在进行，加纳正在探索区块链技术如何帮助其规模庞大且部分非正式化的黄金供应链实现正规化。他说：“加纳正在有意识地测试区块链能否使规模庞大、部分非正式的黄金供应链正规化。”获准进入扩容后沙盒的公司包括Africoin Ghana、加纳黄金局（GoldBod）、The Blue Penguin Company、HSB Global Fintech和BSystems。阿韦齐博士表示，满足所需合规标准的公司完成沙盒参与计划后，可以申请完整许可证。他 explained? 在测试期间收集的信息将帮助SEC制定不同虚拟资产服务的许可要求和监管规则。尽管沙盒已经扩容，阿韦齐博士表示，代币化证券的若干监管要求仍在制定之中，包括资本要求、托管标准、披露义务和投资者保护措施。他还指出了一些尚待解决的法律问题，涉及财产权和所有权、数字代币所代表权利主张的可执行性，以及代币化现实世界资产二级市场的监管。在立法方面，他表示，《2016年证券行业法》（第929号法案）正在修订，以解决代币化工具可能面临的分类难题。阿韦齐博士表示，尽管虚拟资产服务的受监管测试仍在继续，加纳仍在完善其监管战略和立法框架。全面运行的许可制度尚未建立。他预计，首批公司将在2026年末至2027年初期间完成沙盒计划并取得完整许可证

https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliaments-.summary: The Parliamentary Committee on Human Rights has called on the Ministry of Education, the Ghana Education Service (GES) and the National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE) to reintroduce and strengthen safe disciplinary standards in second-cycle institutions across the country. It stressed the urgent need to reintroduce safe disciplinary standards to address the situation, warning that failure to do so could undermine Ghana’s efforts to achieve Sustainable Development Goal 4, which focuses on quality education.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliaments-.summary_zh: 人权议会委员会已呼吁教育部、加纳教育局（GES）和国家公民教育委员会（NCCE），在全国中等教育机构中重新推行并强化安全的纪律标准。委员会强调，为应对当前局势，迫切需要重新推行安全的纪律标准，并警告称，若不这样做，可能削弱加纳实现可持续发展目标4的努力，而该目标侧重于优质教育。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliaments-.body: The Parliamentary Committee on Human Rights has called on the Ministry of Education, the Ghana Education Service (GES) and the National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE) to reintroduce and strengthen safe disciplinary standards in second-cycle institutions across the country. The call follows a viral video allegedly showing some teachers of Techiman Senior High School assaulting a student, an incident the Committee has described as disturbing. In a press release issued on Monday, November 2, and signed by its Chairman, Ernest Yaw Anim, the Committee expressed concern over what it described as the increasing trend of indiscipline in second-cycle institutions, involving headteachers, housemasters, teachers and students. “The Committee takes a strong view of such action, as well as the increasing rate and trend of indiscipline stemming from second-cycle institutions in Ghana,” the statement said. It stressed the urgent need to reintroduce safe disciplinary standards to address the situation, warning that failure to do so could undermine Ghana’s efforts to achieve Sustainable Development Goal 4, which focuses on quality education. “The Committee believes there is an urgent need for the reintroduction of safe disciplinary standard measures to curb the rising culture of indiscipline,” it stated. The Committee further noted that the situation had implications for the protection of children’s rights under domestic and international laws, including Article 25(1) of the 1992 Constitution, Section 8 of the Children’s Act, 1998 (Act 560), and Article 28(2) of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child. Reaffirming its commitment to protecting the right to education, the Committee said it remained “deeply committed to preserving the sanctity of Education in Ghana” and ensuring that quality education was guaranteed as a fundamental human right for all
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliaments-.title_zh: 议会人权委员会呼吁在中学重新推行安全的惩戒措施
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliaments-.body_zh: 国会人权委员会已呼吁教育部、加纳教育署（GES）和国家公民教育委员会（NCCE），在全国中等教育机构中重新推行并加强安全的纪律标准。此前，一段据称显示特奇曼高级中学部分教师殴打学生的视频在网上广泛传播，委员会称这一事件令人不安。委员会在11月2日星期一发布的新闻公报中宣布了这一呼吁，公报由委员会主席欧内斯特·亚奥·阿宁签署。委员会对所谓的全国中等教育机构中纪律松弛现象日益加剧表示担忧，这种情况涉及校长、宿舍管理员、教师和学生。公报称：“委员会严厉谴责此类行为，也谴责加纳中等教育机构中源自纪律松弛且不断上升的比例和趋势。”委员会强调，必须 urgently 重新推行安全的纪律标准以应对这一问题，并警告称，如不采取措施，可能削弱加纳实现可持续发展目标4的努力，该目标侧重于优质教育。委员会表示：“委员会认为，迫切需要重新推行安全纪律标准措施，以遏制日益上升的纪律松弛文化。”委员会还指出，这一情况影响到依据国内法和国际法保护儿童权利，包括1992年《宪法》第25(1)条、1998年《儿童法》（第560号法案）第8条以及《联合国儿童权利公约》第28(2)条。委员会重申其保护受教育权的承诺，表示仍“深切致力于维护加纳教育的庄严性”，并确保所有人作为基本人权都能获得优质教育

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: GS E&C data breach exposes blind spots in Korea's smart apartments
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: “Sure, I’ve had my personal information exposed in the Coupang and SK Telecom data breaches, among many others. Our apartment complex, like many newer developments, relies on smart home services for everyday tasks. Apartments account for a staggering 65.8 percent of all homes in Korea, according to 2025 data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: “没错，在Coupang和SK Telecom等多起数据泄露事件中，我的个人信息曾被泄露。根据韩国数据与统计部2025年的数据，与许多较新的住宅项目一样，我们公寓综合体依赖智能家居服务处理日常事务。公寓占韩国全部住宅的65.8%，比例高得惊人。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: When Park, a 56-year-old homemaker living in an apartment complex in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, heard that GS Engineering & Construction (GS E&C) had recently detected unauthorized access to a system containing residents’ personal information, the news struck a nerve. “Sure, I’ve had my personal information exposed in the Coupang and SK Telecom data breaches, among many others. Over time, I found myself becoming less concerned. Everyone seemed to be getting hit, and it felt like I was just another number in a database,” she said. This time, however, it felt much closer to home, quite literally. “The information involved could reveal details about my own household. Our apartment complex, like many newer developments, relies on smart home services for everyday tasks. We use an app to track package deliveries and vehicle entry and exit, another to access the building, and I hear the sports center is introducing facial recognition for entry. If that kind of information gets exposed, it feels like someone might actually be able to track my every move.” Her concerns point to a growing vulnerability in a country where apartment living and digital technology are increasingly intertwined. Apartments account for a staggering 65.8 percent of all homes in Korea, according to 2025 data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. As residential complexes adopt digital systems for everything from identity verification and building access to household device controls, they are also collecting more detailed information about residents and their routines. The security implications came into focus last Wednesday, when GS E&C said it had detected unauthorized external access to a system used to manage reservations for apartment community facilities. The potentially exposed data goes beyond basic identifying details, such as residents’ names, dates of birth and contact information. It also includes information about their residential status, whether they are the head of their household and radio-frequency identification (RFID) card numbers. Passwords were also listed among the affected information, although the company said they were encrypted. The full extent of the exposure remains under investigation. Over the years, major construction companies have expanded their digital services for residents, offering platforms that combine smart home controls with building access, visitor registration and reservations for shared facilities. GS E&C operates its “Xi Home” platform, while Hyundai Engineering & Construction, Samsung C&T and Daewoo Engineering & Construction offer similar services across their apartment complexes. As these services have proliferated, however, information security may not have kept pace with the expansion, experts say, as construction has traditionally been viewed as a building-focused sector. The risks extend beyond the exposure of personal identifiers. RFID card numbers can be linked to systems controlling access to apartment buildings and shared facilities, while some complexes are starting to use facial recognition and other biometric data for entry. “RFID cards are used to control access to apartment buildings and shared facilities like saunas and gyms,” said Youm Heung-youl, an emeritus professor of information security at Soonchunhyang University. “The risks are even greater with facial recognition. Although there is no indication that biometric information was compromised in the GS E&C incident, its exposure could create further privacy risks, including the potential misuse of facial data in AI (artificial intelligence)-generated images.” The potential impact could also extend beyond a single apartment complex. “This is unlikely to be a problem limited to GS E&C. Other construction companies and public housing operators use similar systems. If multiple apartment complexes share a platform, a breach affecting one complex could spread to others. We need to examine whether these platforms are being managed securely,” he said. The professor called for a broader review of vulnerabilities in apartment management systems and their connections to external networks, noting that existing safeguards — including certified Internet of Things devices and separation between internal and shared networks — may not be sufficient
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: GS E&C数据泄露暴露韩国智能公寓的管理盲区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 当朴女士听说GS Engineering & Construction（GS E&C）最近发现有人未经授权访问了包含居民个人信息的系统时，这则消息触动了她的神经。现年56岁、居住在京畿道水原市一处公寓小区的朴女士是一名家庭主妇。她说：“当然，在Coupang和SK Telecom等许多公司的数据泄露事件中，我的个人信息已经曝光过。久而久之，我发现自己越来越不担心了。似乎每个人都会中招，感觉自己不过是数据库里的另一个数字。”但这一次，感觉真的近在咫尺，从某种意义上说就是如此。她说：“相关信息可能暴露我家的情况。我们小区和许多新建住宅区一样，日常事务依赖智能家居服务。我们用一个应用追踪包裹配送和车辆进出，用另一个应用进入大楼，听说体育中心还准备引入人脸识别用于入场。如果那类信息被曝光，感觉真有人可能追踪我的每一步行动。”她的担忧凸显出这个国家日益严重的一项风险：居住与数字技术的联系越来越紧密。根据数据统计部2025年的数据，公寓占韩国全部住宅的65.8%。随着住宅小区为身份核验、大楼出入和家用设备控制等各项事务采用数字系统，它们也在收集有关居民及其日常活动越来越详细的信息。上周三，GS E&C表示发现有人从外部未经授权访问了用于管理公寓社区设施预约的系统，信息安全 implications由此凸显。可能泄露的数据不只是居民姓名、出生日期和联系方式等基本身份信息，还包括其居住状态、是否为户主以及射频识别（RFID）卡号。密码也被列入受影响信息范围，不过该公司表示密码已加密。信息泄露的完整范围仍在调查之中。多年来，大型建筑企业不断扩展面向居民的数字服务，提供将智能家居控制与大楼出入、访客登记和公共设施预约相结合的平台。GS E&C运营其“Xi Home”平台，Hyundai Engineering & Construction、Samsung C&T和Daewoo Engineering & Construction也在各自的小区提供类似服务。然而专家表示，随着这些服务不断普及，信息安全可能未能跟上扩张步伐，因为建筑业传统上被视为以建筑为中心的行业。风险并不限于个人身份信息泄露。RFID卡号可以与控制公寓大楼和公共设施出入的系统关联起来，一些小区也开始使用人脸识别和其他生物识别数据入场。Soonchunhyang University信息security荣休教授Youm Heung-youl说：“RFID卡用于控制人员进入公寓大楼和桑拿、健身房等公共设施。使用人脸识别后，风险会更高。尽管目前没有迹象表明GS E&C事件中生物识别信息遭到泄露，但这类信息一旦曝光，可能引发进一步的隐私风险，包括人脸数据被滥用于人工智能（AI）生成图像的可能。”潜在影响还可能超出单个公寓小区。他说：“这不太可能只是GS E&C一家公司的问题。其他建筑企业和公共住房运营商也使用类似系统。如果多个公寓小区共用一个平台，影响一个小区的安全漏洞可能蔓延至其他小区。我们需要审查这些平台是否得到安全管理。”这位教授呼吁对公寓管理系统中的漏洞及其与外部网络的连接进行全面评估，并指出，现有防护措施——包括经过认证的物联网设备以及内部网络与共享网络之间的隔离——可能仍不充分

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title: $1 tril. in annual exports
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: Policymakers, businesses must translate figures for future Korea, Asia's export powerhouse, is poised to exceed $1 trillion in annual exports this year. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Policymakers, businesses must translate figures for future Korea, Asia's export powerhouse, is poised to exceed $1 trillion in annual exports this year. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources on Sunday announced that exports in October reached $115.3 billion, a 93.7 percent increase year-on-year. That puts the country's total exports in the first 10 months of the year at $930 billion. This means Korea is on track to reach $1 trillion in yearly exports as early as this month, which would make it the fourth country to do so after the United States, China and Germany. "It feels only like yesterday that we celebrated exporting $10 billion," President Lee Jae Myung posted on social media. "I thank the businesspeople and the workers on the production floor who have put in their utmost efforts." With that remark, the president spoke for many of those who lived through the heyday of industrialization, which now stands at the forefront of Korea's export-led economy. The export figures even drove up Korea's gross domestic product growth for the third quarter to 1 percent, an increase from the 0.6 percent in the second quarter and exceeding the Bank of Korea's (BOK) forecast of 0.3 percent. Korea's other leading exports, such as automobiles, petrochemicals and K-cosmetics, also posted increases in October. But economic policy and experience should compel Korea to tackle its chip dominance to diversify its leading export items to include materials and equipment, and to facilitate small and medium-sized companies exporting their products. Bold deregulation efforts, such as flexibility in weekly work-hour limits, should also be pursued in support of the Lee administration's three megaprojects for the advancement of the chip sector. To consumers, the $1 trillion figure may not bring much consolation, as daily livelihood and affordability issues grow in their households. Korea's private consumption fell 0.2 percent in the third quarter from the previous quarter, according to BOK data. This marked a downward trajectory since the beginning of the year, where it slowed from 0.6 percent in the first quarter and then to 0.4 percent in the second quarter. Korea's chip rally is fueled by the unprecedented investment boom in artificial intelligence (AI), but concerns that the boom is nearing its peak have been more persistent. Last week's decline of top AI and semiconductor firms on Wall Street prompted a resurgence of such concerns. Alphabet, Google's parent company, saw its shares slide 12.6 percent on Thursday when it did not meet third-quarter earnings expectations. U.S. chip giant Intel's stock prices also dropped nearly 29 percent on Friday, while another chipmaker, SanDisk, saw a 13 percent decline. Stock market volatility should not be the major gauge for the economy. However, for export-oriented Korea, the volatility on the bourses combined with continuing tensions in the Middle East loom as major challenges. On top of that, the persistent concerns over the AI and semiconductor peak should invariably be weighed. As optimistic export projections mix with not-so-encouraging numbers, now is the time for policymakers to work on putting forth a sustainable and innovative economic model. There is ample ability, capacity and information to do so, as those who lived through the heyday of growth did with much less
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 政策制定者和企业必须解读相关数据。如今，作为出口强国的韩国今年有望实现年出口额突破$1 trillion。贸易、工业和资源部周日宣布，10月出口额达到$115.3 billion，同比增长93.7 percent。这意味着该国今年前10个月的出口总额达到$930 billion。由此，韩国最早有望在本月实现年出口额达到$1 trillion，成为继美国、中国和德国之后第四个达到这一目标的国家。总统李在明在社交媒体上写道：“感觉我们庆祝出口额达到$10 billion仿佛还只是昨天的事。我感谢每一位为生产付出最大努力的商界人士和一线工人。”说这番话时，总统也代表了许多亲历韩国工业化鼎盛时期的人。如今，韩国以出口为导向的经济已走到前沿。出口数据甚至推动韩国第三季度国内生产总值增速升至1 percent，高于第二季度的0.6 percent，也超过韩国银行（BOK）预测的0.3 percent。韩国其他主要出口产品，如汽车、石化和K-cosmetics，10月出口额也均有增长。然而，经济表现和经验应促使韩国应对其芯片产业占据主导地位的局面，使主要出口品类多元化，纳入材料和设备，并帮助中小企业将产品出口海外。还应推行有力度的放松管制措施，例如放宽每周工时限制，以支持李政府推进芯片产业发展的三大超级项目。对消费者而言，$1 trillion这一数字或许难以带来多少安慰，因为家庭的日常生活开支和可负担性问题日益突出。根据韩国银行数据，韩国私人消费第三季度环比下降0.2 percent。自年初以来，私人消费增速持续回落，第一季度为0.6 percent，第二季度降至0.4 percent。韩国芯片产业的蓬勃发展得益于人工智能（AI）领域前所未有的投资热潮，但有关这轮热潮是否接近峰值的担忧始终存在。上周，华尔街主要人工智能和半导体企业股价下跌，再次引发此类担忧。谷歌母公司Alphabet的股价周四下跌12.6 percent，原因是其第三季度盈利未达到预期。美国芯片巨头Intel的股价周五也下跌近29 percent，另一家芯片制造商SanDisk的股价则下跌13 percent。股市波动不应成为衡量经济的首要指标。然而，对于以出口为导向的韩国而言，股市波动加上中东地区持续紧张的局势，构成了重大挑战。除此之外，也必须审慎权衡有关人工智能和半导体产业见顶的持续担忧。在乐观的出口预测与欠亮眼的数据交织之际，政策制定者现在应着手提出一种可持续且富有创新性的经济模式。实现这一目标所需的能力、资源和信息十分充足，与经济增长鼎盛时期相比，如今的条件要优越得多……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) on Monday welcomed President Lee Jae Myung's budget speech, while the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) criticized him for failing to address North Korea's threats and economic concerns. PPP lawmakers also staged a rally at the National Assembly ahead of Lee's speech on next year's budget proposal, condemning what they called a budget that disregards national debt and destroys the country's future. "President Lee came, said only what he wanted to say and left," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok wrote on Facebook. "He made no mention of real estate, the stock market or farmland, nor did he mention North Korea, the South Korea-U.S. alliance, public safety or judicial issues," Rep. Jang said. While Lee pledged to secure key military capabilities needed for the early transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the United States, he did not directly mention the alliance or inter-Korean ties in his speech. "President Lee's parliamentary speech was not a blueprint for restoring people's livelihoods but an irresponsible declaration of financial gambling that puts the future of South Korea at stake," Rep. Park said in a commentary. Meanwhile, the ruling party welcomed Lee's speech, vowing to pass the budget proposal by the Dec. 2 deadline. On his social media, DPK leader Kim Min-seok hailed the speech for presenting an "ambitious vision" of transforming South Korea into an "irreplaceable" global leader, stressing the need to ensure that the benefits of economic growth are shared by all. "As the president emphasized, we must make every effort to overcome inequality and polarization," Kim wrote on X. During his speech, Lee pledged bold investment in artificial intelligence (AI) and other future growth engine industries, calling for bipartisan support for the government's proposed record budget of 820.9 trillion won ($614.5 billion) for next year. The proposed amount marks a 12.8 percent increase from this year's budget, the highest growth rate on record
