https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: ABUJA — President of the Senate, Senator Godswill Akpabio, has expressed confidence that Akwa Ibom State will deliver the highest number of votes for President Bola Tinubu in the South-South region in the 2027 presidential election. Akpabio made the declaration on Sunday during a special church service at the International Christian Worship Centre, Uyo, organised to dedicate the All Progressives Congress (APC) 2027 election campaigns to God. In a statement by his Special Assistant on Media, Jackson Udom, the Senate President said Akwa Ibom indigenes, particularly APC members, must close ranks and present a united front to ensure the party’s success at the polls. He said the state had a responsibility to reciprocate the support President Tinubu had given him by mobilising votes for the President. According to him, the support of Tinubu contributed to his emergence as Senate President, making him the number three citizen in the country. “Whether you like him or not, he is there today. The only way to thank Mr President for that support is to give him all our votes. “From what I have seen here today, Akwa Ibom State will give Mr President the highest number of votes in the South-South region,” he said. In an address titled, “One Family, One Destiny, One Akwa Ibom Under God”, Akpabio said while the people acknowledged God’s sovereignty over their individual and collective destinies, they must also uphold righteousness, justice and mercy. He described Akwa Ibom as a Nigerian success story, attributing its progress to purposeful leadership, peace and development. The Senate President said development should not be measured only by roads and buildings but also by the bridges built between people and the hope restored in their lives. He urged political leaders and party members to sustain the state’s progress and ensure that its future achievements surpassed those already recorded. On party unity, Akpabio cautioned against divisions between old and new members of the APC, insisting that all members should be treated equally. “In the APC family, there should be no aborigines and no newcomers; no landlords and no tenants; no first-class members and no second-class members. There should be only one big family, united by a common purpose and a shared responsibility,” he said. Using a biblical reference from John 14:2, he said there was room for everyone in the party, regardless of when they joined or their political standing. He added that political ambitions should not override the welfare of the people, urging party members to conduct their campaigns in ways that respect human dignity. Akpabio further said the development of Akwa Ibom was inseparable from the progress of Nigeria, stressing that the state could not remain indifferent to insecurity and hardship in other parts of the country. “Nigeria is not merely the nation to which Akwa Ibom belongs; it is the larger destiny to which Akwa Ibom contributes,” he said. Earlier, Governor Umo Eno thanked the people for their support during the last election and appealed for increased support for Tinubu, Akpabio, himself and other APC candidates in the 2027 elections. Eno also pledged to continue serving the people with the fear of God if given another mandate. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: 2027年：阿克帕比奥预测蒂努布将在阿夸伊博姆获得最高南方选区票数
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 阿布贾——参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿kpabio表示，他确信在2027年总统选举中，阿夸伊博姆州将在南南地区为博拉·蒂努布总统争取到最多选票。阿kpabio于周日在乌约国际基督教敬拜中心举行的特别礼拜活动上作出上述表态。此次活动旨在将全进步大会党（APC）2027年选举竞选活动献给上帝。参议院议长在接受其媒体特别助理杰克逊·乌多姆的声明中表示，阿夸伊博姆本地居民，尤其是APC成员，必须团结一致，形成统一阵线，以确保该党在选举中获胜。他说，该州有责任通过动员选票支持蒂努布总统，以回报蒂努布总统此前对他的支持。据他所说，蒂努布的支持促成了他成为参议院议长，使他成为尼日利亚国内地位第三高的公民。他说：“无论你喜欢他还是不喜欢他，他今天都在那里。报答总统先生这种支持的唯一方式，就是把我们的全部选票投给他。‘从今天我在这里看到的情况来看，阿夸伊博姆州将在南南地区为总统先生投出最多选票。’”在一篇题为《在上帝之下，一个家庭、一个命运、一个阿夸伊博姆》的讲话中，阿kpabio表示，尽管民众承认上帝主宰着他们个人和集体的命运，但他们也必须秉持正直、公正和怜悯。他把阿夸伊博姆描述为尼日利亚的一个成功范例，并将该州的进步归功于有明确目标的领导、和平与发展。参议院议长表示，衡量发展不能只看道路和建筑物，还要看人与人之间架起的桥梁，以及他们生活中重新燃起的希望。他敦促政治领导人和党内成员维持该州的发展势头，确保其未来成就超越已经取得的成果。在谈及党内团结时，阿kpabio警告不要在APC新老成员之间制造分裂，坚持所有成员都应受到平等对待。他说：“在APC这个大家庭里，不应有原住民和新来者，不应有房东和租客，也不应有一等成员和二等成员。这个大家庭应当只有一个，大家由共同的目标和共同的责任团结在一起。”他引用《约翰福音》14章2节指出，无论党员何时加入该党，也无论其政治地位如何，党内都有容纳每个人的空间。他补充说，政治野心不应凌驾于民众福祉之上，并敦促党内成员以尊重人的尊严的方式开展竞选活动。Akpabio还表示，阿夸伊博姆的发展与尼日利亚的进步密不可分，强调该州不能对尼日利亚其他地区的不安全状况和困境无动于衷。他说：“尼日利亚不仅仅是阿夸伊博姆所属的国家；它也是阿夸伊博姆为之作出贡献的更大命运。”此前，州长乌莫·埃诺感谢民众在上次选举期间给予的支持，并呼吁在2027年选举中进一步支持蒂努布、阿kpabio、他本人以及其他APC候选人。埃诺还承诺，如果再次获得授权，他将继续怀着对上帝的敬畏服务民众。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.title: NACCIMA, Trendsbridge lead Nigerian delegates to 140th Canton Fair in China, explore cutting-edge developments in technology, fashion, other
https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.snippet:
NACCIMA, Trendsbridge lead Nigerian delegates to 140th Canton Fair in China, explore cutting-edge developments in technology, fashion, others

Delegates of the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (@NACCIMA30) have explored the latest developments in technology, Artificial Intelligence, telemedicine, as well as fashion products, machines and household materials at the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou, China.

The fair welcomes hundreds of thousands of exhibitors, manufacturers, companies and buyers from several countries of the world across its three phases.

Holding twice a year, NACCIMA has consistently mobilised representation for Nigeria at the international fair, leading delegates to experience new possibilities, uncover fresher business perspectives, and connect with global manufacturers to support local growth and development.

In collaboration with Trendsbridge Travels and Tours Limited, NACCIMA ensured Nigerian delegates participated in the third phase of the fair, which began October 31st and lasted till November 4th 2026.

The 140th Canton Fair featured a huge number of booths across designated areas. In one of them dedicated to Intelligent Medicine, exhibitors displayed how robots and AI are being incorporated into medical procedures to improve efficiency and precision.

Speaking on the sidelines of the fair, the National Public Relations Officer of NACCIMA, Mrs Madinat Adigun-Oladotun, reaffirmed the commitment of the Association to promoting platforms that encourage industry, commerce, and global partnerships for the Nigerian business community.

The National PRO said Nigeria can draw many insights from China, particularly in their organisation of the Canton Fair, which has stood the test of time and continues to expand annually.

https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.title_zh: NACCIMA与Trendsbridge率领尼日利亚代表团参加中国第140届广交会，考察科技、时尚等领域的最新发展
https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.snippet_zh:
NACCIMA与Trendsbridge带领尼日利亚代表团参加中国第140届广交会，考察科技、时尚等领域的最新发展

尼日利亚商会、工业、矿业与农业协会（@NACCIMA30）的代表团在中国广州举行的第140届广交会上，了解了科技、人工智能、远程医疗以及时尚产品、机械设备和家居材料的最新发展。

本届广交会分为三个阶段，吸引了来自世界多个国家的数十万家参展商、制造商、企业和采购商。

NACCIMA每年举办两次活动，并持续组织尼日利亚代表团参加这一国际展会，带领 Delegates 体验新机遇、发掘更新的商业视角，并与全球制造商建立联系，以支持尼日利亚本地增长与发展。

NACCIMA与Trendsbridge Travels and Tours Limited合作，确保尼日利亚代表团参加本届广交会第三阶段的活动。该阶段于10月31日启动，持续至2026年11月4日。

第140届广交会在各指定区域设置了大量展位。其中一个展区专注于智能医疗，参展商展示了机器人和人工智能如何被应用于医疗流程，以提高效率和精确度。

NACCIMA全国公共关系负责人玛迪纳特·阿迪贡-奥拉_dotun女士在展会场边发言时，重申协会致力于推动平台建设，鼓励尼日利亚商界开展行业、商业和全球合作。

这位全国公共关系负责人表示，尼日利亚可以从中国汲取许多经验，尤其是中国组织广交会的方式。广交会经受住了时间的考验，并每年持续扩大规模。

https://x.com/_chiefagbabiaka/status/211.snippet:
Over 200 Chinese investors attend NACCIMA investment forum in Guangzhou

A large number of Chinese investors and business leaders attended the third edition of the Business and Investment Forum organised by the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (@NACCIMA30 ) in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China, on Monday, November 3, 2026.

The Chinese investors cut across various sectors of the economy, including agribusiness, mining and mineral processing, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, renewable energy, manufacturing, among others.

The high-level event, organised in collaboration with the China Chamber of International Commerce (CCOIC), the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT), and the Window of Canton, was on the sidelines of the 140th Canton Fair.

The forum also attracted top business executives and public sector leaders in Nigeria, who pitched various projects, ideas, and investment-ready proposals to the Chinese delegation for partnerships and execution.

Speaking at the event, the National President of NACCIMA, Engr. Jani Ibrahim, mni, OON, urged Chinese investors to do more businesses, investments, and partnerships with Nigeria.

“Across China, there is a famous saying that if you want to get rich, first build the road. Nigeria and China have built the road. We have have walked together for 55 years. Let us measure the next chapter not
in memoranda signed, but in many more factories opened, jobs created, and containers sailing from Lagos to Guangzhou,” the National President said.

Engr. Ibrahim added that the Nigerian economy is now steadier and more stable. He noted that Nigeria presents a market of over 200 million people, which also extends to about 1.3 billion people of the African free trade area.

According to the NACCIMA President, Nigeria is naturally the gateway to Africa. He called for investments and partnerships in Nigeria's energy, minerals, agriculture, agriculture, digital and health systems, saying NACCIMA is ever ready to offer guidance and facilitation services.

Earlier in her opening remarks, the Consul General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, Amb. Mairo Musa Abbas, said the potential of the relationship between Nigeria and China has been largely untapped.

“Our objective is to move beyond conventional trade, which is largely characterized by the exchange of finished products, towards a more productive partnership driven by investment, local manufacturing, technology transfer, industrial development and job creation,” she said.

“This is particularly important as Nigeria pursues economic reforms under His Excellency President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, aimed at diversifying the economy, strengthening domestic production, expanding exports and creating an enabling environment for private-sector investment.”

Amb. Abbas said the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou remains committed to promoting economic diplomacy, facilitating trade and investment, and strengthening institutional relationships between Nigerian and Chinese businesses within its jurisdiction.

“We will continue to work closely with NACCIMA, CCPIT, CCOIC, Window of Canton and other relevant institutions to facilitate business introductions, identify investment opportunities and provide appropriate guidance to Chinese investors interested in Nigeria. We equally encourage Nigerian businesses to utilize the Consulate as a platform for exploring opportunities within our jurisdiction in China.”

Vice President of CCPIT Guangzhou, Huang Xiaofeng, welcomed the Nigerian delegation to China, restating their commitment to partnering with NACCIMA and the Nigerian Consulate in Guangzhou to deepen the economic cooperation between the two countries.

He recalled that an MoU has already been signed with NACCIMA to sustain the B2B event for greater impact.

https://x.com/_chiefagbabiaka/status/211.snippet_zh:
超过200名中国投资者参加广州NACCIMA投资论坛

星期一，即2026年11月3日，大批中国投资者和企业领袖在中华人民共和国广州参加了尼日利亚商会、工业、矿业和农业协会（@NACCIMA30）组织的第三届商业与投资论坛。

中国投资者来自经济各行各业，包括农业企业、采矿和矿物加工、制药、汽车、可再生能源和制造业等领域。

这场高层活动由中国国际商会（CCOIC）、尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆、中国国际贸易促进委员会（CCPIT）和琶洲窗口合作举办，时间与第140届广交会同期。

论坛还吸引了尼日利亚的知名企业高管和公共部门领袖，他们向中国代表团推介了各种项目、理念和可供投资的方案，以寻求合作与落实。

NACCIMA全国主席工程师Jani Ibrahim（mni，OON）在活动上敦促中国投资者与尼日利亚开展更多贸易、投资和合作。

“中国有一句名言：要想富，先修路。尼日利亚和中国已经修好了道路。我们已经携手同行了55年。让我们不要用签署的备忘录来衡量下一个篇章，而要用更多开办的工厂、创造的就业岗位，以及从拉各斯驶往广州的集装箱来衡量，”全国主席说。

Ibrahim工程师补充说，尼日利亚经济如今更加稳健、更加稳定。他指出，尼日利亚拥有一个超过2亿人口的市场，这一市场还延伸至非洲自由贸易区约13亿人口。

NACCIMA主席表示，尼日利亚天然是非洲的门户。他呼吁投资者在尼日利亚的能源、矿产、农业、农业、数字和卫生系统领域投资并建立合作关系，并表示NACCIMA随时准备提供指导和促进服务。

尼日利亚驻广州总领事Mairo Musa Abbas大使早些时候在开幕致辞中表示，尼日利亚与中国之间的关系潜力尚未得到充分开发。

*Guangzhou: NACCIMA B2B event attracts large turnout of Chinese investors, business leaders*

A large number of Chinese investors and business leaders attended the third edition of the Business and Investment Forum organised by the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (NACCIMA) in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China, on Monday, November 3, 2026.

The Chinese investors cut across various sectors of the economy, including agribusiness, mining and mineral processing, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, renewable energy, manufacturing, among others.

The high-level event, organised in collaboration with the China Chamber of International Commerce (CCOIC), the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT), and the Window of Canton, was on the sidelines of the 140th Canton Fair.

The forum also attracted top business executives and public sector leaders in Nigeria, who pitched various projects, ideas, and investment-ready proposals to the Chinese delegation for partnerships and execution.

Speaking at the event, the National President of NACCIMA, Engr. Jani Ibrahim, mni, OON, urged Chinese investors to do more businesses, investments, and partnerships with Nigeria.

“Across China, there is a famous saying that if you want to get rich, first build the road. Nigeria and China have built the road. We have have walked together for 55 years. Let us measure the next chapter not
in memoranda signed, but in many more factories opened, jobs created, and containers sailing from Lagos to Guangzhou,” the National President said.

Engr. Ibrahim added that the Nigerian economy is now steadier and more stable. He noted that Nigeria presents a market of over 200 million people, which also extends to about 1.3 billion people of the African free trade area.

According to the NACCIMA President, Nigeria is naturally the gateway to Africa. He called for investments and partnerships in Nigeria's energy, minerals, agriculture, agriculture, digital and health systems, saying NACCIMA is ever ready to offer guidance and facilitation services.

Earlier in her opening remarks, the Consul General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, Amb. Mairo Musa Abbas, said the potential of the relationship between Nigeria and China has been largely untapped.

“Our objective is to move beyond conventional trade, which is largely characterized by the exchange of finished products, towards a more productive partnership driven by investment, local manufacturing, technology transfer, industrial development and job creation,” she said.

“This is particularly important as Nigeria pursues economic reforms under His Excellency President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, aimed at diversifying the economy, strengthening domestic production, expanding exports and creating an enabling environment for private-sector investment.”

Amb. Abbas said the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou remains committed to promoting economic diplomacy, facilitating trade and investment, and strengthening institutional relationships between Nigerian and Chinese businesses within its jurisdiction.

“We will continue to work closely with NACCIMA, CCPIT, CCOIC, Window of Canton and other relevant institutions to facilitate business introductions, identify investment opportunities and provide appropriate guidance to Chinese investors interested in Nigeria. We equally encourage Nigerian businesses to utilize the Consulate as a platform for exploring opportunities within our jurisdiction in China.”

Vice President of CCPIT Guangzhou, Huang Xiaofeng, welcomed the Nigerian delegation to China, restating their commitment to partnering with NACCIMA and the Nigerian Consulate in Guangzhou to deepen the economic cooperation between the two countries.

He recalled that an MoU has already been signed with NACCIMA to sustain the B2B event for greater impact.

Top dignitaries at the event included the Vice Chancellor of the University of Ilorin, Prof. Wahab Olasupo Egbewole, SAN; NACCIMA First Deputy President, Dr. Emi Membere-Otaji, OON; National Vice President, Barr. Jasper Nduagwuike, mni; President, Kaduna Chamber of Commerce, Alhaji Farouk Suleiman; NACCIMA China Relations Executive, Alhaji Zakirudeen Oladotun; National Public Relations Officer, Hajiah Madinat Adigun-Oladotun; Special Adviser to the National President, Mr. Sulaiman Adoga.

Other major highlights of the event were the networking session and the exhibition booths featuring the University of Ilorin, Nigerian Office for Trade Negotiations, Lekki Worldwide Investments Ltd, Alaro City, and UNASCO Aviation Services Ltd.

Signed:
Mrs Madinat Adigun-Oladotun 
National Public Relations Officer
NACCIMA 
November 3, 2026

她说：“这一点尤为重要，因为尼日利亚正在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统阁下（GCFR）领导下推进经济改革，旨在推动经济多元化、强化国内生产、扩大出口，并为私营部门投资营造有利环境。”

Abbas大使表示，尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆将继续致力于推动经济外交，促进贸易与投资，加强辖区内尼日利亚与中国企业之间的机构联系。

她说：“我们将继续与NACCIMA、CCPIT、CCOIC、窗口公司及其他相关机构密切合作，为双方企业牵线搭桥、发掘投资机会，并向来华投资尼日利亚的中国投资者提供适当指导。我们同样鼓励尼日利亚企业利用总领事馆这一平台，探索我们在中国辖区内的各类机遇。”

CCPIT广州副理事长黄小峰欢迎尼日利亚代表团访华，并重申他们承诺与NACCIMA及尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆合作，深化两国经济合作。

他提到，CCPIT已经与NACCIMA签署了一份谅解备忘录，以持续举办企业对接活动，扩大活动影响力。

出席活动的其他重要嘉宾包括伊洛林大学校长Wahab Olasupo Egbewole教授（SAN）；NACCIMA第一副主席Emi Membere-Otaji博士（OON）；全国副主席Jasper Nduagwuike律师（mni）；卡杜纳商会主席Alhaji Farouk Suleiman；NACCIMA中国关系执行主管Alhaji Zakirudeen Oladotun；全国公共关系官Hajiah Madinat Adigun-Oladotun；全国主席特别顾问Sulaiman Adoga先生。

活动的其他主要亮点是交流联谊环节，以及展示伊洛林大学、尼日利亚贸易谈判办公室、Lekki Worldwide Investments Ltd、Alaro City和UNASCO Aviation Services Ltd的展台。

Madinat Adigun-Oladotun女士

NACCIMA
2026年11月3日

https://x.com/voiceofnigeria/status/2117.snippet:

https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.title: Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s fai
https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet:
Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s failures and justify its anti-China agenda.

Let’s be clear: China is not responsible for the Philippine government’s repeated policy failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

The 2018 oil and gas cooperation MOU preserved both sides’ legal positions and created no binding obligation for joint development. After years of negotiations, the Philippine side terminated the talks. You cannot rewrite that history simply to make China the villain.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

Tarriela, stop exploiting the South China Sea issue for political attention and personal advancement.

China is not the enemy of the Filipino people. The real disservice to the Philippines is a political establishment that would rather manufacture an enemy than pursue genuine development and regional cooperation.

China will not surrender its legitimate rights and interests simply to satisfy the political ambitions of anti-China politicians.

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title: Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kun
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet:
Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kundi ang China. As a matter of fact, ang Constitution pa nga ang pumigil para hindi unfairly ma-exploit ang ating likas na yaman!

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

Hindi rin Constitution ang humarang sa survey ng M/V Veritas Voyager sa Recto Bank noong Marso 2011. Mga barko ng China Marine Surveillance iyon, at ayon sa 2016 Arbitral Award, nilabag ng China ang ating sovereign rights sa non-living resources ng ating continental shelf sa Recto Bank (UNCLOS Art. 77; Award ¶716, ¶1203.B(8)).

Kung may dapat sisihin kung bakit hindi natin mapakinabangan ang sarili nating langis at gas, hindi ang ating Constitution kundi ang China. 

Agree din po ako sa sinabi ninyo maging bulldog tayo para sa mamamayang Pilipino at hindi maging tuta para sa iisang pamilya!

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title_zh: 参议员先生，您错了，是两个政府启动了联合勘探。但有错的不是我们的宪法，而是…
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet_zh:
参议员先生，是你们错了：有两个政府推动联合勘探。但有过错的不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。事实上，还是《宪法》阻止了我们的自然资源遭到不公平的开发！

我们只纠正一下您提到的分享安排：

1. JMSU，2005年（总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约）

签字的不是总统，而是菲律宾国家石油公司（PNOC），中国海洋石油有限公司（CNOOC）和越南石油（PetroVietnam）也参与其中。三方权利平等，因此菲律宾在面积142,886平方公里的协议区内只有三分之一的话语权，而该区域大部分位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内。地震数据也由三方共同所有，在我国政府披露之前，还须取得CNOOC和越南石油的书面同意。

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

2011年3月，“Veritas Explorer”号在Recto Bank进行测量时，阻碍行动的也不是《宪法》。那些船只属于中国海警，而根据2016年仲裁裁决，中国侵犯了我国对Recto Bank大陆架非生物资源的主权权利（《联合国海洋法公约》第77条；裁决书第716段、第1203.B(8)段）。

如果非要追究我们为什么无法从自己的石油和天然气资源中获益，过错方不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。

我也赞同您的说法：为了菲律宾人民，我应做斗牛犬，而不做一个家族的奴仆！

The map satirizes EU policy: direct Russian pipeline gas labeled "bad," while the same resource flows to China as "good."

Logic is geopolitical. After 2022 cutoffs weaponized dependence, EU cut pipeline imports ~90% (share from ~40% to ~10-15%). Remaining LNG under old contracts is being phased out fully by Jan 2027, pipeline by late 2027, to deny Russia leverage and war revenue without instant market shock.

China takes Power of Siberia at capacity (~39 bcm) at steep discounts; long-haul LNG routes are costly and tanker-limited, so volumes stay lower. Costly for EU industry, but deliberate decoupling rather than pure idiocy.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title: India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base.
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet:
India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base. That part of your argument is valid. But attributing the trade imbalance almost entirely to India's structural weaknesses is an incomplete analysis.

In FY26, India exported $19.47 billion to China while importing $131.63 billion. This is not just a manufacturing issue. It is also a question of reciprocal market access.

If Chinese companies enjoy access to India's vast market, Indian businesses should have comparable opportunities in China. Indian exporters continue to face regulatory and non tariff barriers.

India also has legitimate reasons to reduce excessive dependence on a country with which it has unresolved strategic and border tensions. Supply chain diversification is risk management, not necessarily protectionism.

India must become more competitive, but China must also make its market more accessible. Trade cannot be judged only by how efficiently one country sells. Reciprocity, transparency and mutual trust matter too.

A balanced trade relationship requires responsibility from both sides, not a lecture directed at India alone.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title_zh: 印度确实需要加强其制造业基础。
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度确实需要夯实制造业基础。您论证中的这一点是成立的。但将贸易失衡几乎完全归因于印度的结构性弱点，分析并不完整。

2025—2026财年，印度向中国出口194.7亿美元，而从中国进口1316.3亿美元。这不仅仅是制造业问题，也涉及市场准入的对等性。

如果中国企业能够进入印度庞大的市场，印度企业也应当在中国获得同等机会。印度出口商仍面临监管和非关税壁垒。

印度也有充分理由降低对一个与其存在未解决的战略和边界紧张局势国家的过度依赖。供应链多元化属于风险管理，未必意味着保护主义。

印度必须提高竞争力，但中国也必须让本国市场更易进入。评价贸易不能只看一个国家销售商品的能力。互惠、透明和相互信任同样重要。

平衡的贸易关系需要双方共同承担责任，而不是只对印度进行说教。

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.title: Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics?
https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet:
Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics? Already viewed by > 450,000

Media headlines thrive on sensationalism and panic, but national security is governed by cold terrain friction, historical legalities, and strategic calculus and military prowess.

In a recent deep-dive discussion on Ankit Inspires India I, alongside my fellow veteran Maj Gen Sanjay Meston, dismantled prevailing ambiguities and viral social media narratives surrounding India’s northern borders—revealing what routine media reporting misses by anchoring our analysis strictly in professional military experience and verifiable open-source research.

Key Insights from the Discussion

1. Deconstructing "Face-Offs" vs. Incursions: The Line of Actual Control is not a mutually demarcated international border; it is an alignment marked by differing perceptions and overlapping patrol limits. Stand-offs occur when simultaneous patrols encounter each other along disputed pockets—managed strictly through structured protocols and Confidence Building Measures (CBMs), not spontaneous tactical collapse.

2. The Arunachal Reality & Historical Context: From the legal framework of the 1914 Simla Convention and the McMahon Line to the 1962 conflict dynamics and Major Bob Khathing’s consolidation of Tawang, Indian sovereignty over Arunachal Pradesh is unassailable. Viral maps and satellite imagery often mistake border village infrastructure on China’s side for incursions, missing the substantial multi-tier defense and infrastructure India has operationalized along the watershed.

3. Operational Command and Synergy: The frontlines are anchored by the Indian Army holds primary operational command and dominates key tactical heights, integrating paramilitary forces like ITBP seamlessly.

4. The Strategic Dilemma: Why hasn't the border been resolved? Both nations face insurmountable domestic political costs regarding territorial trade-offs. Furthermore, at the macro-strategic level, Beijing is acutely aware that a kinetic conflict with India offers zero strategic dividends—it risks disrupting critical sea lines of communication across the Indian Ocean and disproportionately benefits other global powers.

"At the macro-strategic level, a full-scale kinetic conflict offers no strategic victory for Beijing. The terrain friction of Himalayas serve as India’s defensive asset, and any major misadventure by China risks its maritime lifelines across Indian Ocean while serving third-party geopolitical interests." Shashi Asthana

解码实际控制线：为什么头条耸人听闻的报道忽略了印度-中国边境动态的地面现实？浏览量已超过45万

媒体头条靠耸人听闻和制造恐慌而兴盛，但国家安全由严酷的地形摩擦、历史法律依据、战略考量和军事能力所主导。

在最近一次安基特启发印度频道的深度讨论中，我与退役少将桑杰·梅斯顿一同拆解了围绕印度北部边境的普遍模糊认识和病毒式社交媒体叙事——通过严格锚定在专业军事经验和可验证开源研究上的分析，揭示了常规媒体报道所忽略的内容。

讨论要点

1. 解构“对峙”与“入侵”：实际控制线并非双方共同划定的国际边界；而是由不同认知和重叠巡逻范围所标示的一条线。当双方巡逻队在有争议的地段同时相遇时就会发生对峙——这些对峙通过结构化的协议和建立信任措施（CBMs）严格管理，而非战术突然崩溃。

2. 阿鲁纳恰尔邦的现实与历史背景：从1914年西姆拉会议和麦克马洪线的法律框架，到1962年冲突动态以及鲍勃·卡廷少校对达旺的巩固，印度对阿鲁纳恰尔邦的主权不可动摇。病毒式传播的地图和卫星图像常常将中方一侧的边境村庄基础设施误认为是入侵，忽略了印度沿分水岭已投入使用的多层次防御和基础设施。

3. 作战指挥与协同：前线由印度陆军掌握主要作战指挥权并主导关键战术高地，同时无缝整合印度边防部队等准军事力量。

4. 战略困境：为什么边界问题尚未解决？两国在领土让步方面都面临难以逾越的国内政治代价。此外，在宏观战略层面，北京清楚地意识到与印度发生动能冲突不会带来任何战略红利——这会危及印度洋关键海上交通线，并不成比例地使其他全球大国受益。

“在宏观战略层面，全面动能冲突不会给北京带来任何战略胜利。喜马拉雅山脉的地形摩擦是印度的防御资产，中国任何重大冒险都可能危及其穿越印度洋的海上生命线，同时服务于第三方地缘政治利益。”沙希·阿斯塔纳

https://x.com/seala_ai/status/2116967254.snippet:
In October, shipments of Russian oil from Baltic and Arctic seas ports to China via Northern Sea Route continued

Launch of Vostok‑Oil became a key factor in the growth of shipments along the eastern route of Northern Sea Route this year.

Using the Arctic route for supplies from the Baltic reduces the voyage time to China by half (from 51 days from Ust‑Luga to Qingdao around the Cape of Good Hope to 27 days via the Northern Sea Route). 

Even seasonal use of NSR helps to improve economy of Russian crude oil exports. At the same time, navigation through the Bering Strait will be closed in November and flows will be reset.

https://x.com/seala_ai/status/2116967254.snippet_zh:
10月，经北方海路由波罗的海和北极海港口运往中国的俄罗斯石油运输仍在持续。

东方石油（Vostok-Oil）项目启用成为今年北方海路东部航线运输量增长的关键因素。

利用北极航线从波罗的海向中国运输物资，可将航行时间缩短一半（经好望角从乌斯季卢加到青岛需51天，经北方海路则需27天）。

即使只是季节性地使用北方海路，也有助于提高俄罗斯原油出口的效益。与此同时，白令海峡将于11月关闭，运输流向将重新调整。

#北方海路 #北极 #石油 #Seala码头

https://x.com/grok/status/21169638347284.title: Trade volume with China has increased overall, driven by rising imports.
https://x.com/grok/status/21169638347284.snippet:
Trade volume with China has increased overall, driven by rising imports.

Nepal imported Rs 425 bn from China in FY 2025/26, up 24.7% from Rs 341 bn the prior year. Exports stayed tiny at ~Rs 1.9 bn (often declining). 

Current FY 2026/27 shows continued growth; Mustang alone cleared Rs 26 bn in imports (incl. 6501 EVs) in 3.5 months—already far above its full prior-year total—amid border shifts.

https://x.com/grok/status/21169638347284.snippet_zh:
与中国的贸易总量总体增长，主要由进口增加推动。

尼泊尔在2025/26财年从中国进口4,250亿卢比，较上一年度的3,410亿卢比增长24.7%。出口额仍然很少，约为19亿卢比（而且往往在下降）。

当前2026/27财年继续保持增长；仅马士让一地在3.5个月内就完成了260亿卢比的进口额清关（包括6,501辆电动汽车），已远高于其上一年度的全年总额；与此同时，贸易口岸也发生了转移。
